elnaz/1.jpg.description: View from an airplane window during a flight, showcasing a sunset or sunrise over a layer of clouds. The wing and engine of the aircraft are visible.

elnaz/10.jpg.description: A romantic beachside dinner setup with a couple embracing in the foreground. A small table covered with a white tablecloth is set on the sand, adorned with wine glasses, a bottle of champagne in a bucket, and lit by two candle stands. The ocean stretches out in the background under a cloudy, dusky sky.

elnaz/100.jpg.description: A high-angle, slightly obscured view through a window reveals a grand, ornate building with classical architectural elements. The building features a two-story facade with arched windows and detailed ornamentation, including columns and sculpted reliefs. A river or large waterway is visible in the background, lined with buildings and a bridge. The foreground shows a paved courtyard or plaza. The overall mood is somewhat muted due to the overcast sky.

elnaz/101.jpg.description: A display of three pairs of Puma shoes in different colors. From top to bottom: a brown and cream pair, a pink and white pair, and a black and white pair. All shoes are a low-top design with the Puma logo prominently displayed on the sides. They are displayed on white shelves against a white wall.

elnaz/102.jpg.description: A view of a fairytale-like castle with multiple turrets and a central tower, framed by a decorative fountain in the foreground. People are walking around the area, suggesting a theme park or entertainment venue. The sky is overcast, providing soft lighting. The architecture is ornate, with a mix of stone and colorful detailing.

elnaz/103.jpg.description: A woman stands with her back to the camera in a lavishly decorated room, likely a museum or palace, adorned with ornate gold frames and paintings. She is wearing a black dress with a white apron-like detail and sheer black stockings. Her long, wavy brown hair cascades down her back, and she has a black headband. The room features a polished wooden floor and intricate architectural details.

elnaz/104.jpg.description: A couple wearing adorable animal ear headbands pose for a selfie inside a Universal Studios store. The woman wears Po's ears from Kung Fu Panda, while the man sports a fluffy pink headband with ears. The store is filled with merchandise from various movies like 'Shrek' and 'How to Train Your Dragon', creating a lively and playful atmosphere.

elnaz/105.jpg.description: A man is posing with a vintage, white Cadillac in what appears to be a theme park or outdoor entertainment area. He's leaning on the hood of the car, looking towards the camera. In the background, there are other people, trees, and architectural structures with a distinct, possibly European, style. The car has a California license plate reading 'NRN 401'.

elnaz/106.jpg.description: A young woman with dark hair and red lipstick stands in a lavishly decorated room, likely a museum or palace, with ornate gold frames and paintings adorning the walls. She is wearing a black dress with a white accent piece that creates a unique asymmetrical design. She is looking towards the camera with a slight smile, and her hand is raised as if in thought or contemplation. The room's warm lighting highlights the gold details and creates a sophisticated atmosphere.

elnaz/107.jpg.description: A rectangular pizza with tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, and what appear to be sliced sausages or pepperoni, served on a black rectangular plate. Two small Heinz sauce packets (one tomato ketchup and one chili sauce) are positioned next to the pizza. The background shows a Universal Studios Singapore branded surface.

elnaz/108.jpg.description: A young woman stands in front of a building resembling a classic movie studio, holding a large pink pig plush toy. She is wearing a black tank top, white shorts, and white sneakers, with her hair down. The building is a two-story structure with a beige and dark trim color scheme, featuring windows adorned with American flags. A banner with a portrait and text is visible on the left side of the frame. Another person is seated on a red carpet to the left of the frame.

elnaz/109.jpg.description: A vibrant, retro diner scene with red neon signs illuminating the interior. The diner features a classic 1950s aesthetic with turquoise and red color scheme, chrome accents, and red vinyl booths. Tables and chairs are arranged for dining, and several patrons are visible enjoying meals. The building has a curved facade and a ceiling of translucent blocks.

elnaz/11.jpg.description: A beautifully set dining table for a festive occasion, likely New Year's Eve or Christmas. A decorated Christmas tree stands prominently in the background, illuminated with warm white lights. The table is covered with a white lace tablecloth and laden with a variety of dishes, including a cake with '2024' written on it, fruit, pastries, and other delicacies. Elegant glassware and place settings complete the scene, enhanced by the glow of candles and a grand chandelier. The room features ornate curtains and a sophisticated ambiance.

elnaz/110.jpg.description: A close-up photograph of a reproduction of Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa, framed in an ornate, golden frame. The painting depicts a woman in Renaissance attire, known for her enigmatic smile and subtle expression. The background features a hazy landscape. The image is well-lit and captures the details of both the painting and the frame.

elnaz/111.jpg.description: A young woman stands in front of a building designed to resemble NBC Studios at Rockefeller Center, likely at Universal Studios. She is wearing a black t-shirt, white shorts, and white sneakers, and has a pink plush toy in her arms. The building has a detailed facade with windows adorned with American flags. Another person is seated on a bench in the background.

elnaz/112.jpg.description: A vibrant street scene in Seoul, South Korea, showcasing a narrow alleyway densely packed with buildings adorned with bright neon signs and advertisements in multiple languages. The street is wet, suggesting recent rain, and a mix of pedestrians are walking along the sidewalk. The signs are predominantly in Korean and English, with some Chinese characters visible. A white taxi is partially visible in the foreground, and the overall atmosphere is energetic and bustling.

elnaz/113.jpg.description: A woman with styled hair and makeup takes a selfie at what appears to be a restaurant or bar. She's wearing a black long-sleeved top and has a white furry accessory around her shoulders. The background shows other patrons and tables.

elnaz/114.jpg.description: A close-up shot showcases a bouquet of flowers arranged in a decorative paper bag. The bouquet features a mix of colors including orange, white, and pink blooms, with a striking bird-of-paradise flower adding height and visual interest. The bag is white with a red design. The background reveals a cityscape with tall buildings and trees in autumnal colors, visible through a window framed by white curtains. A radiator is also visible below the window.

elnaz/115.jpg.description: A top-down view of a person standing on Gene Kelly's star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. The star is a five-pointed bronze star embedded in a dark, speckled sidewalk. The person is wearing white sneakers and light-colored shorts, with one foot partially obscuring the star. The star features Kelly's name and a small circular emblem depicting his face.

elnaz/116.jpg.description: A woman stands in front of the illuminated Eiffel Tower at night, wearing a luxurious white fur coat and a black turtleneck. She is smiling and wearing red lipstick and glasses. The background features bare trees and a dimly lit pathway.

elnaz/117.jpg.description: A cozy scene at Carette, a Parisian tea salon. A hand holds a cup of hot chocolate, while a silver teapot and a small plate of cookies sit on a white tablecloth. The Carette logo is visible on the cup and a menu is partially visible in the foreground. The overall ambiance is warm and inviting.

elnaz/118.jpg.description: A white plate filled with chunks of fresh pineapple. The pineapple is cut into long, rectangular sticks, and appears juicy with some liquid at the bottom of the plate. The plate is resting on a white surface, likely a tablecloth or bedsheet.

elnaz/119.jpg.description: A close-up shot of French onion soup served in a traditional ceramic ramekin. The soup is topped with a browned, bubbly cheese crust, likely Gruyère or a similar cheese. It's presented on a white plate with a blue rim that has the word 'Cafe' written on it. There's a small bread roll and silverware visible in the periphery.

elnaz/12.jpg.description: A close-up shot features a spiral-cut potato on a stick, held in front of a scenic backdrop resembling a canal in Venice, Italy, likely at the Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas. The potato is golden brown and crispy, appearing freshly cooked. The background shows a waterway with turquoise water, ornate buildings with arched windows, and a black wrought iron fence. A hand in a black sleeve holds the potato, emphasizing its length and spiral shape.

elnaz/120.jpg.description: A young woman stands in front of a large, ornate castle with a fountain in the foreground. The castle is multi-tiered with numerous spires and detailed architectural features. The woman is wearing a white top and shorts with chunky sneakers, and is waving with a smile. The sky is cloudy.

elnaz/121.jpg.description: A young woman stands on a paved walkway at Universal Studios, posing for a photo. She is wearing a black spaghetti-strap top, white high-waisted shorts, and white sneakers, with a small white shoulder bag. The background features the iconic Universal Studios archway and buildings, including a theater displaying showtimes. The sky is cloudy.

elnaz/122.jpg.description: A collection of luxury perfumes displayed on a tiered shelf. The perfumes include brands like Victoria's Secret (Bombshell), Dior (Miss Dior and a smaller bottle), Chanel (Chance), Ariana Grande, and Sol de Janeiro. The bottles are a mix of shapes and colors, predominantly pink and clear, with black caps and accents. The display is set against a white and black color scheme.

elnaz/123.jpg.description: A low-angle, nighttime photograph of the illuminated Eiffel Tower in Paris. The tower is glowing with a warm, golden light, contrasting against the dark sky. People are visible at the base of the tower, appearing as blurred figures. The base of the tower is also illuminated with colorful lights, including blue and green. The image is slightly tilted, giving a dynamic perspective.

elnaz/124.jpg.description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a marble sculpture depicting a cherubic figure. The figure, likely a young boy or angel, is sculpted with remarkable detail, showcasing smooth skin, defined musculature, and a serene expression. The figure is raising both arms, seemingly holding or supporting a draped fabric above its head. The sculpture is part of a larger composition, as evidenced by the partial view of another sculpted figure to the left. The lighting is soft and diffused, highlighting the texture of the marble and creating subtle shadows. The background is blurred, suggesting an indoor museum or gallery setting.

elnaz/125.jpg.description: A photograph captures a grand hall within a museum, showcasing a collection of classical sculptures. The central focus is a statue of a woman, likely Roman or Greek in origin, positioned atop a reddish-brown, ornate base and framed by a set of columns. The statue is depicted with one arm raised in a gesture. The hall features a high, intricately decorated ceiling with arches and columns, and a polished, light-colored floor. Additional sculptures are visible on either side, displayed on dark pedestals. The lighting is subdued, highlighting the sculptures and architectural details.

elnaz/126.jpg.description: A nighttime view of a pathway lined with tall palm trees, illuminated by spotlights at their bases. The pathway leads towards a modern building with a distinctive ribbed facade and distant city skyline. People are strolling along the path, enjoying the ambiance. The lighting creates a dramatic effect, highlighting the trees and pathway while casting shadows.

elnaz/127.jpg.description: A low-angle shot at night showcases a dense grouping of tall palm trees, their fronds illuminated with a warm, golden light. The trunks are smooth and rise vertically, creating a canopy overhead. In the background, blurred city lights and buildings suggest an urban setting. People are visible walking amongst the trees, adding a sense of scale and activity. The overall mood is serene and tropical, despite the urban backdrop.

elnaz/128.jpg.description: A close-up shot of a pale green Ladurée gift box. The box is rectangular and features a decorative laurel wreath border in burgundy around a central oval containing the brand name 'LADURÉE' in a stylized font. Above the name, it reads 'Maison fondée en 1862' and below it 'Paris'. The box rests against a fluffy, light-colored surface, possibly a cushion or upholstery. The background is a dark, glossy surface, likely part of furniture.

elnaz/129.jpg.description: A woman stands in front of the Louvre Museum in Paris at night, wearing a fluffy white coat and a black and white dress. The iconic glass pyramid is illuminated behind her, along with the ornate architecture of the palace. She is leaning on a metal barrier, smiling at the camera.

elnaz/13.jpg.description: A close-up shot of a screen displaying mathematical equations and notations, likely from a textbook or study material. The equations involve trigonometric functions like cosine, sine, and tangent, along with angles expressed in degrees and potentially radians. There's a circled portion highlighting the expression '2sin((π-α)/2)cos(π/2)' and a subsequent line stating 'sinα <= sinλ'. A website address 'www.bestau.online' is also visible.

elnaz/130.jpg.description: A woman poses for a nighttime photo in front of the Marina Bay Sands and the Louis Vuitton store in Singapore. She is leaning against a railing with the city skyline and water reflecting the lights in the background. She is wearing a black button-up top and white shorts.

elnaz/131.jpg.description: A woman with long dark hair is smiling and looking at the camera while wrapped in a fluffy white and black trimmed coat. She is positioned in front of a nighttime cityscape, with the Eiffel Tower visible in the distance. The photo appears to be taken from a high vantage point, possibly a rooftop or balcony.

elnaz/132.jpg.description: A close-up view of a marble statue depicting a male figure, likely an angel or Cupid, with detailed sculpting of the torso, arms, and face. The figure is nude, with a serene expression and curly hair. One wing is visible, and a draped fabric is partially visible on the right side. The statue is set against an ornate architectural background with columns and decorative elements. The lighting highlights the texture of the marble and casts shadows, adding depth to the image.

elnaz/133.jpg.description: A woman is holding a black fan with a portrait of another face printed on it, partially obscuring her own face. She is wearing a fluffy white coat and has manicured nails. The background appears to be an indoor space with a textured wall and another person in the distance.

elnaz/134.jpg.description: A woman with dark hair pulled back in a bun is smiling at the camera while seated in a restaurant. She is wearing a light-colored jacket and a white top. Her hands are clasped in front of her. The restaurant has red booths and a bar in the background with blue lighting.

elnaz/135.jpg.description: A plate featuring a generous pile of golden, crispy french fries resting atop a dark, greenish-brown sauce. The sauce appears to be a stew or gravy, possibly containing meat or vegetables. The plate is white with a red rim, and a yellow napkin is visible to the side. A wine glass is also partially visible in the background. The setting suggests a restaurant meal.

elnaz/136.jpg.description: A low-angle shot captures the imposing facade of the Temple of Portunus in Rome, Italy. The temple, a well-preserved example of Roman architecture, features a classical design with a prominent portico supported by tall, Corinthian columns. The structure is constructed from stone, displaying a weathered and aged appearance. A cross is visible atop the temple's roof. The image is bathed in sunlight, creating strong shadows and highlighting the texture of the stone. The foreground shows remnants of ancient ruins and a small patch of greenery.

elnaz/137.jpg.description: A breathtaking, high-angle view of the ornate ceiling of a Baroque church, likely in Italy. The ceiling is covered in a vast and detailed fresco depicting numerous figures, angels, and biblical scenes, all rendered in rich, warm colors. The composition is dynamic and dramatic, with figures appearing to ascend towards a central, illuminated point. The architecture features elaborate molding, columns, and a large dome with a circular oculus. The overall effect is one of grandeur, religious devotion, and artistic mastery.

elnaz/138.jpg.description: A top-down view of a plate of spaghetti with a rich, red tomato sauce, garnished with fresh herbs. The plate is branded with 'Da Fortunata Osteria' and 'Miami'. It appears to be a casual dining setting, with a glimpse of a table and napkin.

elnaz/139.jpg.description: A low-angle shot captures the majestic facade of the Pantheon in Rome, Italy. The image focuses on the massive Corinthian columns supporting the portico, with the cylindrical drum of the building rising behind them. The weathered stone and intricate details of the architecture are highlighted, while a cloudy sky provides a dramatic backdrop. People are visible entering and exiting the building, adding a sense of scale and activity.

elnaz/14.png.description: A woman is surfing a wave, appearing to be in mid-air as she rides the crest. She's wearing a black swimsuit and is positioned on a blue surfboard. The ocean is choppy with whitecaps, and the sky is a clear blue with a few clouds. The photo captures a dynamic moment of action and skill.

elnaz/140.jpg.description: A nighttime photograph showcases a large, illuminated sculpture resembling a coiled snake with a star atop its head, positioned in front of a grand, white classical building with a clock tower. The sculpture is lit from within with warm white lights, creating a striking contrast against the dark night sky. People are gathered on the steps and surrounding areas, observing the display. The building features ornate architectural details and a symmetrical design. Streetlights line the lower portion of the scene, adding to the overall illumination.

elnaz/141.jpg.description: A charming street scene in Italy, likely near the Leaning Tower of Pisa. A shop with a turquoise facade and overflowing with souvenirs is in the foreground, with the tower visible down the narrow cobblestone street. Potted flowers add vibrant color to the scene, and buildings line both sides of the street, adorned with greenery. The warm lighting suggests either early morning or late afternoon.

elnaz/142.jpg.description: A low-angle shot captures the imposing Arch of Septimius Severus in Rome, Italy. The ancient structure, constructed of large stone blocks, features a prominent archway and detailed inscriptions. The sky above is a vibrant blue with scattered clouds, highlighting the arch's weathered texture and historical significance. Foliage peeks through the archway at the bottom of the frame.

elnaz/143.jpg.description: A breathtaking interior view of a Baroque church, showcasing a lavishly decorated ceiling and dome. The ceiling is covered in intricate frescoes depicting numerous figures, likely saints and angels, amidst swirling clouds and golden light. The architecture features tall, ornate columns with Corinthian capitals, framing the view and leading the eye upwards towards the dome. The color palette is rich and warm, dominated by golds, blues, and reds. The image captures the grandeur and spiritual atmosphere of the church's interior.

elnaz/144.jpg.description: A stunning upward view of a Christmas installation inside a grand department store. A large, conical tree-like structure covered in shimmering, reflective material and colorful lights dominates the center of the frame. The store's interior features a beautiful, ornate architecture with multiple levels, polished floors, and a glass dome ceiling illuminated with blue and purple lights and additional suspended light fixtures. The scene evokes a festive and luxurious atmosphere.

elnaz/145.jpg.description: A close-up shot of a plate of seafood, featuring mussels and shrimp. The seafood appears to be cooked, possibly grilled or sautéed, with a slightly oily sheen. The mussels are dark and glossy, while the shrimp have a reddish-brown color. Some of the shrimp still have their shells on.

elnaz/146.jpg.description: A lavishly set table with a white tablecloth is covered in a variety of food items. There are several plates and platters filled with appetizers and desserts. The platters include what appears to be cheese, crackers, olives, dips, and various pastries. Several plates are filled with red berries, and there's a platter with what looks like mini quiches or savory pastries with a creamy topping. Wine glasses are placed around the table, suggesting a celebratory or social gathering. The table is also decorated with golden accents and silverware.

elnaz/147.jpg.description: A serene outdoor scene featuring a swimming pool, lounge chairs, and palm trees under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. A green and white striped umbrella provides shade over a small table. A person is visible near the pool, enjoying the sunny day. The architecture of a building with a white facade is visible in the background.

elnaz/148.jpg.description: A woman is playfully leaning back, seemingly hanging off a ledge, with the illuminated Burj Khalifa in the background. She's wearing a white shirt and denim shorts, smiling at the camera. Another person is partially visible in the lower left corner.

elnaz/149.jpg.description: A woman stands in a luxurious shopping mall, pushing a shopping cart filled with purchases. She is wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and denim pants. The cart holds shopping bags from Louis Vuitton and Fendi, indicating a high-end shopping spree. The background features a lavish interior with gold decorations and storefronts for Van Cleef & Arpels and other luxury brands.

elnaz/15.jpg.description: A young woman stands on a sandy beach next to a large, textured rock formation. She is wearing a white top and shorts with sandals, and has a red flower in her hair. The beach is covered in small rocks and shells, and the ocean is visible in the background. The lighting suggests it's either early morning or late afternoon.

elnaz/150.jpg.description: A sunlit pathway leads towards a distant, ornate building, likely a palace or grand hotel, framed by lush greenery and palm trees. A person in a blue shirt and shorts is walking along the path. The foreground features a tiled walkway and manicured landscaping. The sky is a clear, bright blue.

elnaz/151.jpg.description: A picturesque, narrow cobblestone street descends towards a stunning coastal view in Italy. Buildings line both sides of the street, adorned with vibrant pink bougainvillea and potted plants. The street leads the eye towards a sparkling blue sea and dramatic cliffs. The scene evokes a sense of tranquility and Mediterranean charm.

elnaz/152.jpg.description: A beautifully presented spread of small bites and a refreshing drink. Three square plates hold individual portions: one with what appears to be salmon and a creamy topping, another with salmon atop a green spread, and a third with fried pork rinds skewered with a sprig of mint. A glass of bright yellow liquid, likely juice or a smoothie, sits centrally. A partially visible rolled flatbread is also on the table.

elnaz/153.jpg.description: A woman is taking a selfie while sitting on a Pilates reformer machine in a studio. She is wearing a black sports bra and leggings, and white slippers with bear designs. The studio has a modern aesthetic with wood floors, silver Pilates equipment, and linear lighting.

elnaz/154.jpg.description: A woman stands in what appears to be a luxury shopping mall, holding shopping bags from Louis Vuitton, Fendi, and Cartier. She is wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and dark pants, with a cheerful expression. The background is decorated with gold tinsel, suggesting a festive atmosphere. She is also wearing light-colored sneakers.

elnaz/155.jpg.description: A woman in a white outfit leans against a black metal railing, holding shopping bags from Louis Vuitton and Cartier. The background features a luxurious shopping mall interior with gold tinsel and store fronts for Van Cleef & Arpels and other high-end brands. The woman appears to be posing for a photo, with a relaxed and stylish demeanor.

elnaz/156.jpg.description: A couple stands hand-in-hand on a Parisian street, with the Eiffel Tower visible in the background. The woman is wearing a short white dress and a long veil, with elegant heels. The man is dressed in a white shirt and black trousers. The street is lined with classic Parisian buildings and parked cars, creating a romantic and urban atmosphere.

elnaz/157.jpg.description: A couple walks hand-in-hand down a Parisian street, with the Eiffel Tower visible in the distance. The bride is wearing a white wedding dress and veil, while the groom is in a white shirt and black trousers. The street is lined with buildings and parked cars, creating a classic European cityscape.

elnaz/158.jpg.description: A vibrant and colorful bouquet of flowers in a clear glass vase. The arrangement features a mix of deep purple, pink, and white chrysanthemums, along with delicate yellow filler flowers and lush green foliage. A small red card with white text is attached to the vase, partially visible. The bouquet is positioned against a neutral gray and white background, creating a visually appealing contrast.

elnaz/159.jpg.description: A meticulously organized makeup drawer showcasing a luxurious collection of high-end cosmetics. Brands like Dior, Chanel, Gucci, Hourglass, and Sensu are prominently featured. The drawer is filled with palettes, foundations, powders, lipsticks, and other beauty essentials, all neatly arranged and suggesting a sophisticated beauty routine. Tissue paper is used to keep items clean and organized.

elnaz/16.jpg.description: A large group of young women are posing for a photo in what appears to be a theater or auditorium. They are seated and crouching on the steps leading up to the seats, with some standing on the upper levels. The theater has tiered seating and wooden paneling on the walls. Most of the group is wearing dark clothing, with a few wearing white or lighter colors. The lighting is warm and creates a cozy atmosphere.

elnaz/160.jpg.description: A couple, a woman in a white wedding dress and a man in a white t-shirt and black pants, pose in front of a dark wooden door in a building's facade. The woman leans back against the man, who is looking at the camera with a slight smirk, while she glances over her shoulder. The scene is bathed in natural light, creating a warm and intimate atmosphere. The building's exterior is a muted beige color, providing a contrasting backdrop to the couple's attire.

elnaz/161.jpg.description: A close-up shot shows a person holding a vibrant bouquet of flowers, including red tulips, peach roses, and a cluster of small white daisies. The bouquet is wrapped in brown paper. The person is wearing a light blue button-down shirt and a tan coat, and carrying a light blue shoulder bag with a chunky silver chain. The background shows a blurred street scene.

elnaz/162.jpg.description: A couple walks down a Parisian street with the Eiffel Tower visible in the background. The woman is wearing a white dress and heels, while the man is in a white t-shirt and black pants. The street is lined with classic Parisian buildings and parked cars, creating a romantic and picturesque scene.

elnaz/163.jpg.description: A woman in a white wedding dress and veil stands on a Parisian street, facing away from the camera and looking towards the Eiffel Tower in the distance. The street is lined with buildings and parked cars, creating a classic urban backdrop. The lighting is soft and diffused, giving the image a romantic and slightly muted tone.

elnaz/164.jpg.description: A couple poses for a portrait in front of a large, ornate wooden door. The woman is wearing a white dress and a sheer veil, with her arm around the man's shoulder. She is looking back at the camera with a smile. The man is wearing a white t-shirt and black pants, and is looking slightly off-camera with his hands in his pockets. The setting appears to be a European city, with a stone building and a doorway with a number '2' above it.

elnaz/165.jpg.description: A couple walks down a Parisian street with the Eiffel Tower visible in the background. The man, dressed in a white t-shirt and black pants, gestures with his hand while walking, and the woman, in a white dress and heels, walks beside him with a slight smile. The street is lined with buildings and parked cars, creating a classic European city scene. The lighting is soft and diffused, suggesting an overcast day.

elnaz/166.png.description: A close-up shot shows a person holding a large, lush bouquet of peach and light orange roses. The bouquet is wrapped in brown paper and adorned with Celine branded paper and a small handwritten note. The background is a neutral, possibly white or light gray, surface.

elnaz/167.jpg.description: A breathtaking upward view of a highly ornate church ceiling, showcasing a vast and detailed fresco painting. The artwork depicts numerous figures, seemingly angels and saints, swirling around a central, luminous point. The painting is rendered in rich, warm colors – golds, reds, and blues – and features a dramatic use of light and shadow. The architecture surrounding the fresco is equally elaborate, with sculpted columns, intricate moldings, and a dark, contrasting color palette. The image captures the grandeur and spiritual atmosphere of a Baroque church interior.

elnaz/168.jpg.description: A woman stands in front of the iconic Sleeping Beauty Castle at Disneyland Paris, wearing a white faux fur coat and Mickey Mouse ears with gold accents. She is smiling and wearing red lipstick. The castle is a pastel pink and blue, with intricate architectural details. The foreground features a neatly manicured lawn with red plants. The sky is overcast.

elnaz/169.jpg.description: A low-angle shot captures the majestic Temple of Portunus in Rome, Italy. The temple, a well-preserved example of Roman architecture, features a classical design with a prominent portico supported by large, fluted columns. The structure is built on a raised platform, revealing remnants of earlier constructions below. The building is constructed of stone and is bathed in sunlight, creating strong shadows that highlight the columns and architectural details. A clear blue sky with a few clouds provides a striking backdrop. A small cross adorns the roof.

elnaz/17.jpg.description: A top-down view of a beautiful flower arrangement in a basket, held by someone wearing brown pants. The bouquet features a mix of pink roses, white chrysanthemums, and eucalyptus greenery. A pink ribbon with 'Bouvar' printed on it is attached to the basket handle.

elnaz/170.jpg.description: A captivating view framed by the ancient brickwork of a Roman structure. The image showcases a rounded archway opening onto a landscape of trees and distant hills under a cloudy sky. The interior of the structure is characterized by rough, aged brick walls with metal supports, creating a sense of historical depth and enclosure. People are visible in the distance, suggesting a public space or park. The lighting is dramatic, with strong contrasts between the dark interior and the bright exterior.

elnaz/171.jpg.description: A stylish family of three stands in front of a luxury car and ornate architectural details. The parents, dressed in black, are holding hands with their young son, also in black. The setting appears to be a high-end resort or hotel, with a glimpse of a sunset and palm trees in the background. The overall aesthetic is sophisticated and fashionable.

elnaz/172.jpg.description: A captivating view of the Roman Forum framed by an ancient archway. The image showcases a blend of architectural detail and historical landscape. The archway, constructed from weathered brick, provides a dramatic foreground, contrasting with the expansive view of the Forum beyond. The scene includes remnants of columns, buildings, and a vibrant blue sky with scattered clouds. A metal railing in the foreground adds a modern element to the ancient setting.

elnaz/173.jpg.description: A woman wearing Mickey Mouse ears and a white faux fur coat poses in front of Sleeping Beauty's castle at Disneyland Paris. She is smiling and looking at the camera, with the castle slightly blurred in the background under a cloudy sky. There are people walking in the background and greenery along the pathway.

elnaz/174.jpg.description: A high-angle shot captures the Arch of Titus in Rome, partially obscured by scaffolding for restoration. The ancient structure stands prominently in the foreground, surrounded by a plaza filled with tourists. The sky is a vibrant blue with scattered clouds, casting shadows across the scene. Green spaces and distant buildings complete the Roman landscape.

elnaz/175.jpg.description: A framed tapestry depicting a scene from Disney's Sleeping Beauty. Maleficent, as a dragon, looms over a small, vulnerable Aurora who is holding a golden orb. The tapestry is framed with an ornate, dark wood border decorated with floral and geometric designs. The scene is set against a backdrop of a castle or fortress.

elnaz/176.jpg.description: A low-angle shot captures the stunning architecture of Rome, featuring the dome of a church bathed in warm sunlight and the towering, intricately carved Column of Marcus Aurelius. The contrast between the ornate church and the ancient column highlights the city's rich history. A dramatic, cloudy blue sky provides a beautiful backdrop. The foreground shows a glimpse of people and a shadowed wall.

elnaz/177.jpg.description: A woman wearing Minnie Mouse ears and a fluffy white coat poses in front of Sleeping Beauty's castle at Disneyland Paris. She is smiling and looking towards the camera, with a blurred background showcasing the iconic castle and a cloudy sky. Red flowers are visible in the foreground.

elnaz/178.jpg.description: A woman in a flowing white dress is lying on a concrete surface, possibly near water, with a stone wall visible in the background. She is looking towards the camera with a dramatic expression, and wearing gold earrings. The lighting is somewhat dim, casting long shadows.

elnaz/179.jpg.description: A woman dressed in a white Grecian-style gown with gold arm cuffs and a headpiece poses for a photo. She is smiling and looking at the camera, with her long, wavy brown hair cascading over her shoulder. The photo appears to be taken indoors, possibly at an event or photoshoot, with a decorative white and black tiled floor and ornate white architectural details in the background.

elnaz/18.jpg.description: A woman in a traditional Chinese Hanfu dress performs on stage. She is wearing a red vest with gold detailing over a long, flowing white dress. She has a delicate headpiece and her arms are extended in a graceful pose. Another performer in similar attire is partially visible behind her, also with arms raised. The stage is lit with blue and orange hues, creating a dramatic effect.

elnaz/180.png.description: A still life composition featuring a small artificial Christmas tree decorated with red ribbon, a bulb with sprouting greenery (likely a hyacinth or amaryllis), a handwritten card, and a small animal figurine (possibly a fox or raccoon). The items are arranged on a gray surface.

elnaz/181.jpg.description: A couple embraces in a cozy kitchen, both wearing matching black and white striped pajamas. The woman has her hair pulled back with a claw clip, and they are standing in front of a light-colored kitchen island with decorative elements like a small vase of blue flowers, books, and a candle on a shelf above. The overall mood is warm and intimate.

elnaz/182.jpg.description: A woman in a black long-sleeved athletic shirt and boxing gloves takes a selfie in a gym. She's holding her phone up to capture the image, and the reflection in the mirror shows other people participating in a workout class. The gym has a modern aesthetic with dark blue and white accents.

elnaz/183.jpg.description: A woman wearing black boxing gloves and a black long-sleeved shirt is standing in a gym, holding a phone in one hand and with the other hand raised in a boxing stance. She appears to be recording herself or taking a photo. The gym has a modern aesthetic with dark walls and reflective surfaces. Another person is visible in the background.

elnaz/184.jpg.description: A single white plumeria flower with a yellow center rests on a sandy beach. The sand is a light brown color and has some small shell fragments mixed in. The flower is positioned slightly off-center in the frame, with strong sunlight casting a distinct shadow.

elnaz/185.jpg.description: A close-up, low-angle shot of black boxing gloves hanging against a dark gray wall. The gloves are branded with 'Everlast' in white lettering. One glove is more in focus, showing the textured surface and stitching, while the other is slightly blurred in the background. A portion of a jump rope is visible in the lower left corner.

elnaz/186.jpg.description: A woman with long dark hair is playfully making a kissy face at the camera while standing in front of the Kazan Cathedral in Saint Petersburg, Russia. She is wearing a light yellow outfit consisting of a long-sleeved cardigan and a low-waisted skirt. The background features a lush green park and a clear blue sky.

elnaz/187.jpg.description: A striking, unconventional portrait of a woman in a long white dress, partially submerged in water. The image is split diagonally, with the lower left showcasing the water and the woman's lower body, and the upper right displaying a vibrant blue sky with fluffy white clouds. The woman is lying down, with her head and one arm raised, creating a dynamic and artistic composition. The scene appears to be near a pier or dock, with visible structures and a hint of a cityscape in the background. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the texture of the water and the delicate fabric of the dress.

elnaz/188.jpg.description: A woman with long red hair is posing in a white, flowing dress in an ornate outdoor setting. She is holding a white rectangular object, possibly a tablet or a piece of art, in front of her. The background features a white architectural structure with columns and intricate metalwork railings, along with a reflective, dark-colored surface resembling polished stone or a wet pavement. The image is taken from a slightly elevated perspective, creating a unique and artistic composition.

elnaz/189.jpg.description: A stunning nighttime view of a modern home's driveway featuring a black BMW convertible and a white Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon parked underneath a covered carport. The carport's ceiling is illuminated with recessed lighting, casting a warm glow on the vehicles. The architecture is sleek with clean lines and a combination of smooth, light-colored surfaces and textured stone accents. Lush greenery frames the scene, enhancing the luxurious atmosphere.

elnaz/19.jpg.description: A still life featuring En Su Solu perfume bottles and a chain on a white surface, accented by a black box and a vase of white flowers. The lighting is dramatic, creating strong shadows and highlights, emphasizing the minimalist aesthetic.

elnaz/190.jpg.description: A first-person perspective shot from a moving vehicle, likely a car, traveling along a winding road through a mountainous landscape. A person with long hair is visible in the foreground, with their hair being blown by the wind from the open window. Their arm is raised, suggesting a feeling of freedom and enjoyment during the drive. A vehicle is seen ahead on the road. The scenery consists of lush green trees and rocky cliffs.

elnaz/191.jpg.description: A pair of New Balance 530 sneakers in a predominantly white and gray color scheme. They feature a chunky sole, white laces, and the iconic New Balance 'N' logo in gray on the side. The shoes are shown in their box, with a glimpse of a sock inside.

elnaz/192.jpg.description: A rear view of a cream-colored Bentley convertible driving down a palm tree-lined street, likely in California. The road stretches into the distance, flanked by tall palm trees and lush greenery. The bright blue sky with a few clouds adds to the luxurious and sunny atmosphere.

elnaz/193.jpg.description: A person is shown typing on a laptop, with holographic data visualizations floating above the keyboard. The visualizations include a world map, charts, graphs, and abstract data displays, suggesting data analysis, cybersecurity, or futuristic technology concepts. The image has a cool, tech-focused aesthetic.

elnaz/194.jpg.description: A group of four people are gathered around a table, intently studying architectural plans and material samples. They appear to be in a collaborative discussion, likely related to a construction or interior design project. The plans are spread out on the dark-colored table, and one person is pointing at a specific detail. There are coffee cups present, suggesting a working session. The overall mood is focused and professional.

elnaz/195.jpg.description: A first-person view from a speeding boat at night, showcasing a woman relaxing on the bow with a city skyline illuminated in the background. The boat is equipped with blue accent lighting, and the water is churning from the speed. The scene evokes a sense of luxury, freedom, and nighttime adventure.

elnaz/196.jpg.description: A high-angle shot of a roulette table in a casino. The green felt layout displays the numbers 1-36, along with the 0 and 00 spaces. A croupier stands to the right of the table, with a player placing bets on the left. In the background, there's a blurred view of other casino games and patrons, along with a screen displaying 'Roulette'. The table is surrounded by a decorative rope barrier.

elnaz/197.jpg.description: A blurry, dynamic image showing a group of people riding bicycles at night. The motion blur suggests a fast pace, and the lighting is dim, with a warm glow from a street lamp and a hint of blue light in the background. The focus is on the movement and the feeling of speed.

elnaz/198.jpg.description: A person is sitting on the floor surrounded by luxury shopping bags and abundant floral arrangements. The bags appear to be from Hermès, Chanel, and another brand with a pink logo. The person is covering their face with their hands, possibly overwhelmed or playfully reacting to the gifts. The scene is set in a well-lit room with a minimalist aesthetic, featuring light wood floors and sheer curtains.

elnaz/199.jpg.description: A luxurious dining experience with a breathtaking nighttime view of a city skyline, likely Dubai with the Burj Khalifa prominently visible. The table is set with fine dining elements including wine glasses, salads, and what appears to be a meat dish. A designer handbag and a small lamp add to the upscale ambiance.

elnaz/2.jpg.description: A woman in a black abaya sits with her back to the camera, facing the Kaaba in Mecca, Saudi Arabia. The Kaaba is draped in black cloth with gold embroidery, and surrounded by pilgrims in white Ihram clothing. Cranes are visible in the background, along with the illuminated mosque and surrounding structures. The scene is captured at night.

elnaz/20.jpg.description: A woman with long, wavy hair adorned with a small red flower stands on a sandy beach. She is wearing a cream-colored, one-shoulder dress with a high slit, revealing her legs. The background features a rocky cliff face and a glimpse of the ocean. The lighting suggests it's either early morning or late afternoon.

elnaz/200.jpg.description: A long hallway is filled with a cascade of red confetti, creating a festive and celebratory atmosphere. The confetti appears to be falling from above, covering the floor and partially obscuring the view down the hallway. The hallway features tiled flooring, white walls, and dark wood trim. Artwork hangs on the walls, and a glimpse of a decorated Christmas tree is visible at the end of the hallway.

elnaz/201.jpg.description: A couple stands amidst a breathtaking scene of hundreds of illuminated sky lanterns rising into the night sky. They are holding a large lantern aloft, with a temple or pagoda visible in the distance. The scene is filled with a warm, orange glow from the lanterns, creating a magical and festive atmosphere. The crowd is dense, suggesting a large-scale celebration or festival, likely the Yi Peng Lantern Festival in Thailand.

elnaz/202.jpg.description: A picturesque street scene in Istanbul, Turkey, featuring a view of the Süleymaniye Mosque in the background. The narrow cobblestone street is lined with buildings and vintage cars, with a waterfront view of the Golden Horn and boats passing by. Red Turkish flags are visible, adding to the cultural atmosphere. The scene is bathed in warm sunlight with a cloudy sky.

elnaz/203.jpg.description: A beautiful gift arrangement featuring a bouquet of pink carnations and a box of Ferrero Rocher chocolates. The flowers are wrapped in light pink paper with a black ribbon, and the chocolates are presented in a gold box. The gifts are leaning against a dark-colored surface, likely a car interior.

elnaz/204.jpg.description: A luxurious scene unfolds on a sleek white yacht adorned with abundant pink peonies. A woman in a cream-colored dress and a man in a white t-shirt are the focal point, with the man appearing to be presenting the woman with a small gift or ring. Several woven baskets overflow with more peonies, enhancing the romantic and opulent atmosphere. The yacht is docked on calm water, bathed in the warm glow of the setting sun.

elnaz/205.jpg.description: A visually rich and romantic scene featuring a collection of vintage-looking letters and envelopes scattered across a wooden surface. Red glittery hearts and loose rose petals are interspersed among the paper, creating a Valentine's Day or love-themed aesthetic. The letters appear to be handwritten in a cursive script, adding to the nostalgic and intimate feel. The overall composition is warm and inviting, evoking feelings of affection and sentimentality.

elnaz/206.jpg.description: A romantic bedroom setup featuring a large bed covered in rose petals and surrounded by floating pink and rose gold balloons. Several gift boxes are arranged on the bed, some containing flowers and chocolates. The room has large windows offering a city view, and neutral-toned curtains. The overall aesthetic is soft, sweet, and celebratory, likely for a special occasion like Valentine's Day or a birthday.

elnaz/207.jpg.description: A breathtaking interior view from a high-rise apartment, showcasing a comfortable living space with a neutral-toned sofa and rug, bathed in the warm glow of a stunning sunset over a sprawling cityscape. Large windows offer an unobstructed panorama of the city skyline, with the sun positioned perfectly to create a dramatic and inviting atmosphere. The room features minimalist decor with subtle accents of greenery and wood.

elnaz/208.jpg.description: A vibrant street scene in Norway, likely Bergen, featuring colorful wooden buildings and numerous Norwegian flags strung across the street. A tall brick tower with a green dome dominates the background. The buildings are painted in shades of red, yellow, and white, creating a picturesque and festive atmosphere. People are strolling along the sidewalk, and shops with awnings line the street.

elnaz/209.jpg.description: A romantic scene featuring a pathway of tea light candles and scattered red rose petals on a dark wood floor. The candles are arranged in a winding line, creating a warm and intimate atmosphere. Soft lighting and a blurred background enhance the romantic feel.

elnaz/21.jpg.description: A smiling woman holds a large arrangement of flowers and two smaller bouquets, likely after a performance or event. The flowers are predominantly pink and white, with roses and other blooms. She is wearing a black top and appears to be on a stage with a dark backdrop.

elnaz/210.jpg.description: A stunning long exposure photograph captures a picturesque coastal village nestled between a steep mountain and calm waters, all illuminated by a vibrant green aurora borealis. The village consists of traditional red and white wooden houses built on stilts over the water. The night sky is filled with stars, enhancing the magical atmosphere. The foreground features rocky terrain and the dark, reflective water.

elnaz/211.jpg.description: A scuba diver interacts with a dolphin in a vibrant blue underwater environment. The diver, fully equipped with a wetsuit, mask, fins, and oxygen tank, extends their hand towards the dolphin, seemingly offering a touch or interaction. The scene is set amidst coral and marine vegetation, with sunlight filtering through the water creating a dappled effect. The dolphin appears curious and engaged, approaching the diver.

elnaz/212.jpg.description: A luxurious breakfast setting with a stunning view of the Eiffel Tower in Paris. Two glasses of orange juice with strawberries, croissants, and a small plate with what appears to be cheese or pate are arranged on a silver tray on a marble table. The terrace is decorated with comfortable chairs and cushions, and lush greenery. The sky is a beautiful mix of blue and golden hues, suggesting either sunrise or sunset.

elnaz/213.jpg.description: A vibrant and healthy breakfast spread on a white plate. It features two slices of avocado toast topped with tomato slices and sprouts, two perfectly fried eggs with golden yolks, segments of orange, a pile of pomegranate seeds, a handful of blueberries, and slices of kiwi. The plate is set against a neutral, textured background, likely a couch or bed, and a hand with a neutral manicure is visible in the lower left corner.

elnaz/214.jpg.description: A luxurious nighttime scene featuring a bottle of Dom Pérignon champagne and two champagne flutes on a balcony overlooking a harbor filled with yachts and the illuminated cityscape of Monaco. The scene is bathed in the soft glow of city lights and the cool tones of the night sky. The balcony's white railing frames the stunning view, creating a sense of exclusivity and celebration.

elnaz/215.jpg.description: A breathtaking scene unfolds on the African savanna as a safari vehicle filled with tourists encounters a majestic male lion during a stunning sunset. Zebras graze peacefully in the golden grasslands, while a vibrant pink and orange sky illuminates the landscape. The sun, a glowing orb, hangs low on the horizon, casting a warm glow over the entire scene. The composition highlights the beauty of wildlife and the thrill of a safari adventure.

elnaz/216.jpg.description: An opulent dining experience set on a terrace overlooking the stunning Dubai skyline, prominently featuring the Burj Khalifa. A beautifully set table with a white marble-like surface is adorned with fine china, gold cutlery, and crystal glassware filled with champagne. Plates showcase perfectly cooked steak accompanied by fresh salads and a creamy dip. A bucket of champagne and a floral arrangement with candles add to the romantic and luxurious ambiance. The scene captures a sophisticated and memorable evening.

elnaz/217.jpg.description: A breathtaking nighttime view of Monaco, showcasing a luxurious harbor filled with yachts and a winding coastal road lined with parked cars. The scene is framed by the elegant architecture of a building with a curved balcony, offering a glimpse into the opulent lifestyle of the region. The city lights twinkle against the backdrop of a dark, mountainous landscape and a pale moonlit sky.

elnaz/218.jpg.description: A majestic male lion stands in a golden savanna landscape at sunset, gazing directly at the viewer. In the background, a herd of elephants grazes peacefully, while birds soar through the warm, sunlit sky. The scene is bathed in a warm, golden light, creating a sense of tranquility and wild beauty.

elnaz/219.jpg.description: A vibrant scene of African wildlife in a grassy savanna. A tall giraffe stands prominently, its long neck reaching towards the sky. Below it, a zebra with striking black and white stripes looks towards the camera. Several impala, with their reddish-brown coats and curved horns, graze in the foreground and background, completing the diverse wildlife composition. The landscape features scattered trees and a cloudy sky.

elnaz/22.jpg.description: A white open box filled with Mixit skincare products. The products are in sleek, white and gold packaging. Visible items include Mango Cleansing Oil, Anti-Brightness Serum, and Vitamin C Enzyme Powder. The box itself is white and appears to be made of cardboard. The overall aesthetic is minimalist and modern.

elnaz/220.jpg.description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a dolphin partially submerged in clear, turquoise water. The dolphin is looking directly at the camera with a cheerful expression, appearing to 'smile'. Water droplets cover its smooth, grey skin. The sunlight creates shimmering reflections on the water's surface.

elnaz/221.jpg.description: A picturesque scene from a balcony in Paris, France, overlooking the Eiffel Tower. A cup of coffee and a croissant sit on a small table alongside a tablet displaying a stock market chart with green and red candlesticks. The warm morning light illuminates the buildings and the iconic tower, creating a serene yet focused atmosphere.

elnaz/222.jpg.description: A stunning nighttime view of the Dubai skyline reflected in the calm waters of an infinity pool. The Burj Khalifa dominates the center of the frame, surrounded by other illuminated skyscrapers. Comfortable lounge chairs and a vibrant orange cocktail in the foreground add to the luxurious atmosphere.

elnaz/223.jpg.description: A close-up shot showcases a luxurious stack of gold bracelets on a wrist. The bracelets include a sleek, modern T-shaped cuff, a delicate chain bracelet with a YSL charm, a tennis bracelet adorned with sparkling stones, and two Dior CD-logo bracelets, one with a floral design. The overall aesthetic is opulent and fashionable, highlighting a mix of designer brands and styles.

elnaz/224.jpg.description: A woman in a bright red suit stands on a stage, viewed from behind, addressing a large audience in a dimly lit auditorium. A spotlight shines down on her, highlighting her as the central figure. The audience is visible in the blurred background, seated and facing the stage.

elnaz/225.jpg.description: An aerial view from an airplane window showcasing a stunning tropical island with turquoise waters, white sand beaches, and rocky coastlines. The wing of the plane is visible in the upper left corner, framing the picturesque landscape below. The ocean displays varying shades of blue, indicating different depths and currents. The island is lush with green vegetation.

elnaz/226.jpg.description: A nighttime view of a large, luxurious yacht named 'Tulipa' docked in a marina. The yacht is predominantly white with black accents and features multiple levels and intricate detailing. A smaller boat with illuminated steps is visible in the foreground, partially obscuring the view of the yacht's hull. The water reflects the ambient light, creating a shimmering effect. The sky is a soft blue, indicating dusk or dawn.

elnaz/227.jpg.description: A first-person view from a jet ski speeding across the water towards a vibrant sunset. The turquoise jet ski's handlebars and a portion of an arm are visible in the foreground, with the water creating a dynamic blur. The sky is a mix of dark clouds and golden sunlight breaking through, creating a dramatic and beautiful scene.

elnaz/228.jpg.description: A high-angle shot shows a workspace set up on a white table, likely outdoors, with a view of the ocean. A laptop displaying a landscape photo is open, surrounded by study materials like a yellow legal code book, papers, and highlighters in various colors (yellow, pink, and green). A small butterfly figurine rests on the table alongside a black purse. The setting is under a white architectural structure with a palm tree visible in the distance, under a cloudy sky.

elnaz/229.jpg.description: A luxurious display of wealth featuring a Rolex watch presented in its green box, surrounded by stacks of US hundred-dollar bills, an American Express card, a Mercedes-Benz car key, a Versace perfume bottle, and a diamond-encrusted bracelet. The overall aesthetic is one of opulence and high-end lifestyle.

elnaz/23.jpg.description: A view from an airplane window on a rainy day. Raindrops cover the window, obscuring the view of the airport tarmac. Several airplanes are visible parked at gates, along with airport buildings and a control tower in the distance. The overall scene is muted and gray due to the weather.

elnaz/230.jpg.description: A woman stands near a large window at an airport, looking out at the tarmac where an Air Canada plane is visible. The sun is setting, casting a warm glow through the window and creating a silhouette of the woman. She is holding a cup, likely coffee or tea, and has two suitcases nearby. The scene evokes a sense of travel, anticipation, and perhaps a touch of melancholy.

elnaz/231.jpg.description: A dimly lit, upscale restaurant setting with a focus on a table set for dining. The table is adorned with fine china, glassware filled with a golden liquid, and a small, decorative container. The background features a bar with bottles and a striking art installation of hanging, illuminated shapes. A large portrait is visible on the left, and blurred figures of other diners add to the ambiance. The overall mood is luxurious and intimate.

elnaz/232.jpg.description: A vibrant outdoor scene at a beachside bar or club, likely in a Mediterranean location. A large crowd of people are enjoying drinks and socializing as the sun sets over the water. Palm trees frame the view, and the atmosphere is lively and festive, illuminated by warm lighting from candles and other sources. The setting appears upscale and relaxed.

elnaz/233.jpg.description: A beautifully arranged picnic setup on a sandy beach. A low wooden table holds a selection of food including cheeses, grapes, and what appears to be cured meats. There are bottles of wine, sparkling water, and two wine glasses. The table is set on a striped blanket, and the background shows the ocean and sand.

elnaz/234.jpg.description: A wide-angle shot from the audience at a large conference or event. The stage is visible, featuring a speaker and large screens displaying graphics and branding. The venue is a spacious, modern arena with a high ceiling and dramatic lighting, filled with rows of attendees. The lighting is predominantly blue, creating a dynamic and energetic atmosphere. The word 'RISE' is prominently displayed on a screen below the speaker.

elnaz/235.jpg.description: A woman with long dark hair and red lipstick sits in a white chair on a stage with a black backdrop featuring the Forbes logo. She is wearing a black suit with wide-leg trousers and no visible shirt underneath the jacket. Her legs are crossed, and she appears to be engaged in a discussion or presentation.

elnaz/236.jpg.description: A group of people are sitting in a circle, holding hands. Each person is wearing colorful beaded bracelets. The image is taken from a top-down perspective, focusing on the hands and bracelets. The clothing visible suggests a casual setting.

elnaz/237.jpg.description: A cozy and inviting indoor scene featuring a Netflix movie night. A large flat-screen TV displays the show "Ghosts". In front of the TV is a low wooden table laden with a delicious spread: sushi rolls, chocolate, and what appears to be a dip with crackers. Two glasses of wine and a small cup of coffee add to the relaxing atmosphere, while flickering candles provide soft lighting. The overall aesthetic is warm, intimate, and perfect for a relaxing evening.

elnaz/238.jpg.description: Screenshot of Kaspi Gold notifications showing two recent replenishments to a Kaspi Bank account. The first replenishment was for 40,000 Tenge, and the second was for 100,000 Tenge. Both notifications indicate the replenishment was done via a Kaspi ATM, and the current available balance is 19,951,425.59 Tenge.

elnaz/239.jpg.description: A large sum of Kazakhstani Tenge banknotes is spread out on a white, quilted surface. The bills are bundled in various denominations – 5000, 2000, 1000, and 100 Tenge – and are held together with what appears to be clear plastic wrap. A hand is holding a bundle of 100 Tenge notes. The bills feature images of Kazakh landmarks and cultural symbols.

elnaz/24.jpg.description: A vibrant, eye-level view of Times Square in New York City. The street is bustling with pedestrians and vehicles, including a classic yellow taxi cab in the foreground. Towering skyscrapers line both sides of the street, adorned with massive, illuminated billboards displaying advertisements for various brands like Samsung, Coca-Cola, and others. The overall atmosphere is energetic and iconic, capturing the essence of this famous landmark.

elnaz/240.jpg.description: A cozy Harry Potter movie night setup! The screen displays the title of the first film, 'Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone'. In front of the screen, a wooden tray holds a delightful assortment of snacks: popcorn in striped containers, Haribo candies, and themed Harry Potter chocolates in decorative boxes. Two mugs, one filled with a creamy beverage topped with whipped cream and sprinkles, complete the magical atmosphere. Fairy lights frame the television, adding to the warm and inviting ambiance.

elnaz/241.jpg.description: A close-up shot shows two Kazakh passports held in a hand, with a boarding pass visible in the background. The passports are dark teal and feature intricate designs, including a golden emblem on the front. The background includes the 'AirAstana' logo and a glimpse of a person in a brown jacket. The image suggests travel or identification.

elnaz/242.jpg.description: A romantic dinner setup overlooking a breathtaking sunset in Santorini, Greece. A white table is adorned with a plate of pasta, grilled meat, wine glasses filled with red wine, and scattered rose petals. The scene is set beside a glowing blue infinity pool, with whitewashed buildings and the Aegean Sea stretching into the distance under a vibrant orange and blue sky.

elnaz/243.jpg.description: A breathtaking view from inside a vehicle, likely a safari jeep, as two giraffes curiously approach. The scene is bathed in the warm glow of a setting sun, with acacia trees framing the dirt road ahead. The interior of the vehicle, with its leather seats and dashboard, provides a unique perspective on the African savanna.

elnaz/244.jpg.description: A close-up shot of a dolphin interacting with people at an aquarium or marine park. The dolphin is partially out of the water, appearing to smile with its mouth open, and is reaching towards a person's hand. Another dolphin swims in the background. The water is a bright turquoise color, and there's a rocky edge to the pool.

elnaz/245.jpg.description: A woman is surrounded by a massive quantity of pink packages and boxes, seemingly overwhelmed by orders. The packages are poly mailers and cardboard boxes, all in a consistent pink color scheme, and many are labeled with shipping addresses. She is sitting amidst a pile of the poly mailers, with stacks of boxes forming walls around her. The scene suggests a successful small business or a large-scale operation.

elnaz/246.jpg.description: A vibrant, high-angle shot captures the electrifying atmosphere of a large-scale music festival at night. A massive, intricately designed stage is the focal point, illuminated with dazzling lights and adorned with a central emblem. Above the stage, a spectacular fireworks display explodes in a shower of orange and white sparks, creating a dramatic backdrop. The foreground is filled with a dense crowd of concertgoers, many holding up their phones to capture the moment. The overall scene is energetic and celebratory, showcasing the excitement and communal experience of a live music event.

elnaz/247.jpg.description: A first-person view from inside a movie theater. The image shows legs stretched out in front of a row of seats, with a container of popcorn and a bag of Life Savers Gummies in the foreground. The movie screen displays a scene with a figure in red. The theater is dark, with only the screen providing illumination.

elnaz/248.jpg.description: A smiling woman wearing a red helmet and a white crop top sits on an ATV in a lush, natural environment. The background consists of dark, earthy walls covered in roots and vegetation, suggesting a jungle or forest setting. She is looking at the camera with a cheerful expression, and her arm rests on the ATV's handlebars.

elnaz/249.jpg.description: A vibrant, immersive view from a concert, likely Taylor Swift's Eras Tour, filled with a sea of illuminated phones held aloft by the audience. Confetti rains down from above as the artist performs on a distant stage, bathed in purple and blue lighting. The sheer number of phones creates a dazzling effect, highlighting the energy and excitement of the live performance.

elnaz/25.jpg.description: A vibrant photograph showcases the iconic red architecture of a Japanese temple, likely in Kyoto, with the Japanese flag (Hinomaru) waving prominently in the foreground. The flag's white field and red disc contrast beautifully against the clear blue sky. The temple's intricate wooden structure and curved roofline are partially visible, framed by lush green foliage. People can be seen in the lower portion of the image, suggesting a popular tourist destination.

elnaz/250.jpg.description: A Canon PowerShot G7X Mark III digital camera is displayed on top of its packaging box. The camera is black and features a prominent lens with markings indicating its zoom capabilities (8.8-36.8mm, 1:1.8-2.8). The box is also black and features the 'PowerShot G7X Mark III' branding.

elnaz/251.jpg.description: A large outdoor music festival with a massive stage and a huge crowd of people enjoying the performance. The audience is spread across a grassy field, many sitting on blankets and enjoying the sunset. The stage is brightly lit with colorful visuals, and the sky is filled with dramatic orange and pink clouds.

elnaz/252.jpg.description: A wide-angle shot from a high vantage point within a large arena during a concert. The stage is at the far end, with a massive crowd filling the floor and tiered seating. Dramatic pyrotechnics in the shape of large 'W's are erupting from the stage, creating a fiery spectacle. The arena is dimly lit, with spotlights focused on the stage and pyrotechnics. People in the foreground are holding up phones to record the event.

elnaz/253.jpg.description: A breathtaking view from inside a cave hotel in Cappadocia, Turkey. Numerous hot air balloons float in the sky above a valley of unique rock formations. The interior features comfortable seating with plush pillows and a beautiful rug, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere. The cave opening frames the stunning landscape, enhanced by soft lighting from hanging lanterns.

elnaz/254.jpg.description: A breathtaking view of the Italian coastline at sunset, featuring a rustic stone table set for a romantic dinner. Two pizzas and glasses of white wine sit in the foreground, overlooking a picturesque bay with colorful buildings clinging to the cliffs. The warm hues of the setting sun reflect on the water, creating a stunning and inviting atmosphere.

elnaz/255.jpg.description: A hand holds a large, thick stack of Indonesian Rupiah banknotes. The bills appear to be a mix of denominations, with a prominent display of the 1000 Rupiah note featuring a portrait. The stack is substantial, suggesting a significant amount of currency. The background shows a simple, neutral setting with a glimpse of a tiled surface.

elnaz/256.jpg.description: A behind-the-scenes shot of a photoshoot in a minimalist white studio. A photographer is kneeling, focused on a model who is seated on a black chair. Dramatic lighting creates strong shadows and highlights, emphasizing the model's pose and the starkness of the environment. The model is wearing a black outfit and has her hair pulled back. Studio equipment, including a light stand and camera, are visible.

elnaz/257.jpg.description: A high-angle view from inside a large stadium during a soccer match. The stadium is packed with spectators, predominantly wearing red, surrounding a vibrant green field where players are in action. The stadium's architecture features a curved, white roof with visible support structures and lighting. A large video screen displays game information. The sky is overcast with hints of sunset colors.

elnaz/258.jpg.description: A young woman with long, reddish-brown hair sits on stone steps flanked by intricately carved statues of mythical creatures. The scene is set within a lush, green environment with hanging vines and trees. Several monkeys are present, with one approaching the woman and another perched on a statue. The architecture appears to be Balinese or Southeast Asian in style.

elnaz/259.jpg.description: A lavish spread of Turkish breakfast items is laid out on a green marble table. The photo is taken from a first-person perspective, with a person in a grey jacket partially visible in the background. The table is covered with numerous small plates and dishes containing a variety of foods including grilled meats, cheeses, olives, pastries, fried eggs, french fries, salads, and sauces. There are also two glasses of orange juice. The presentation is abundant and suggests a leisurely, social meal.

elnaz/26.jpg.description: A vibrant image showcases the Brazilian flag waving proudly in the foreground, set against a stunning backdrop of a bay, lush green hills, and the iconic Sugarloaf Mountain in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. A beach with people enjoying the sun is visible along the bay. The clear blue sky completes the picturesque scene.

elnaz/260.jpg.description: A young woman with a bright smile is sitting on a metal structure overlooking lush, terraced rice paddies in Bali, Indonesia. She is wearing a light-colored bikini and appears to be slightly wet, possibly after a swim. The background features dense greenery and palm trees under a cloudy sky. A sign reading 'ALAS HARUM BALI' is visible in the distance.

elnaz/261.jpg.description: A woman with long brown hair, wearing a black dress, poses in a dimly lit environment. She is angled with her head tilted, looking towards the camera, with a red lip and subtle makeup. The background features a blurred image of a building with warm lighting, reflected in a dark, glossy surface. The composition is dramatic and stylish, with a focus on the subject's elegance and the contrast between light and shadow.

elnaz/262.jpg.description: Two people playing basketball outdoors as the sun sets. One person is shooting the ball while the other watches, with a vibrant orange and yellow sky in the background. The basketball court is blue with yellow lines.

elnaz/263.jpg.description: A woman sits on a stone ledge surrounded by monkeys in a lush, green environment. She is wearing a striped shirt and shorts, with a yellow flower tucked behind her ear. Three monkeys are visible, one looking directly at the camera, another looking up, and a third partially obscured. The background is filled with dense foliage and tree roots.

elnaz/264.jpg.description: A wide shot from the stands of a large stadium during a soccer match. The field is bright green and filled with players, while the stands are packed with a predominantly orange-clad crowd. The stadium has a modern design with a complex lighting system. A person with long dark hair is in the foreground, facing the field.

elnaz/265.jpg.description: A wide-angle shot captures the dynamic atmosphere inside the Barclays Center during a basketball game. The Brooklyn Nets are playing against a team in white uniforms, with players actively engaged in the game on the court. The massive, high-definition scoreboard dominates the view, displaying game statistics and a vibrant backdrop. Spectators fill the stands, creating a lively and energetic environment. The arena's modern design, with its black and silver color scheme, is prominent, and branding from sponsors like 'Born in Brooklyn' and 'Expoint' is visible throughout.

elnaz/266.jpg.description: A bustling square in Istanbul, Turkey, is covered in a large flock of pigeons. The cobblestone pavement is almost entirely obscured by the birds. In the background, there's a restaurant named 'Mado' and 'Bosphor Terrace Grill', with people walking around. A tree stands near the edge of the square, decorated with red ribbons. The scene captures a common sight in the city, where pigeons are abundant and often interact with pedestrians.

elnaz/267.jpg.description: A group of women are sitting in a circle on a sandy beach, appearing to be engaged in a gathering or retreat. They are mostly wearing light-colored clothing, and some have wraps or blankets. A scattering of pink flowers is in the center of the circle. The background features a calm, turquoise ocean and a soft, cloudy sky at dusk. Palm fronds frame the top of the image.

elnaz/268.jpg.description: A yoga instructor gently assists a student in a restorative yoga pose, likely a supported child's pose. Several other students are practicing nearby on yoga mats. The setting appears to be outdoors, possibly on a wooden deck or platform, with a natural background of greenery.

elnaz/269.jpg.description: A group fitness class is in progress, likely a yoga or Pilates variation, utilizing hanging straps and foam rollers. Participants are performing a lunge-like pose with arms raised, some using blocks for support. The studio has a modern, minimalist aesthetic with dark accents and dim lighting.

elnaz/27.jpg.description: A high-angle, long exposure shot of the famous Shibuya crossing in Tokyo, Japan, at night. The image captures the bustling pedestrian scramble with blurred figures crossing the street, illuminated by a vibrant array of neon signs and digital billboards. The long exposure creates light trails from vehicles, adding to the dynamic energy of the scene. The buildings surrounding the crossing are densely packed with advertisements and signage, typical of the urban landscape of Shibuya.

elnaz/270.jpg.description: A dynamic shot of a rider on a sleek, black horse galloping across a lush green field. The horse is mid-stride, showcasing its powerful movement, while the rider maintains a focused posture. The background features a line of trees and a slightly overcast sky, adding to the natural and energetic feel of the image.

elnaz/271.jpg.description: A first-person perspective shot of a horse and rider riding down a gravel path towards a setting sun. The rider is wearing a black jacket and helmet, and the horse in front is a dark color, while the horse being ridden is a chestnut color. White fencing lines the path, and trees are visible in the background. The warm light of the sun creates a peaceful and serene atmosphere.

elnaz/272.jpg.description: A breathtaking view of Cappadocia, Turkey at sunrise. Numerous hot air balloons fill the sky above the unique rock formations and cave dwellings, creating a magical and serene atmosphere. The warm hues of the rising sun paint the sky in shades of orange, pink, and purple, illuminating the landscape and the white-washed buildings.

elnaz/273.jpg.description: A woman poses next to a large advertisement for Gisou's new Honey Milk 5-in-1 Styling Cream, displayed on a bus stop shelter in a city. The ad features a close-up of a woman with long, flowing hair holding the product. The woman posing with the ad is wearing a red dress and heels, and appears to be playfully interacting with the advertisement. A red double-decker bus is visible in the background, along with pedestrians and buildings.

elnaz/274.jpg.description: A woman with long, dark hair stands beside a large, black horse in a grassy field. She is leaning against the horse, appearing to embrace it, with her head near the horse's neck. She is wearing a black leather jacket and dark jeans. The sky is overcast, creating a muted, natural light.

elnaz/275.jpg.description: A person is seated on a yoga mat in a studio with aerial silks hanging from the ceiling. The studio has a minimalist aesthetic with white walls and wooden floors. The image is reflected in a large mirror, creating a symmetrical composition.

elnaz/276.jpg.description: A high-angle shot shows a yoga class in progress. Participants are seated on yoga mats, spaced apart, and performing a seated twist. Many are using bolsters for support. The room is bright and airy, with large windows and a minimalist aesthetic. Wooden blocks are also used as props.

elnaz/277.jpg.description: A woman with long, flowing hair rides a beautiful chestnut horse across a grassy field. The horse is in motion, appearing to canter or gallop, with its mane and tail flowing in the wind. The background features a dense forest, and the scene is bathed in warm sunlight, creating a dynamic and picturesque image.

elnaz/278.jpg.description: A digitally rendered image showcasing a large, immersive cinema experience with multiple screens displaying various scenes from historical and dramatic films. The cinema is filled with rows of dark seats, occupied by blurred figures representing the audience, all focused on the expansive display. The screens showcase scenes from films like 'Dunkirk', '1917', 'The Last of Us', 'All Quiet on the Western Front', and a period drama with a group of people. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the screens and creating a sense of immersion.

elnaz/279.jpg.description: A close-up shot inside a movie theater, focusing on a large bucket of popcorn and two red Cinemark drink cups. The screen in the background is displaying a scene with people walking. The theater's walls are a dark red, and the seats appear to be black leather.

elnaz/28.jpg.description: A stunning high-angle view of Dubrovnik, Croatia, showcasing its iconic city walls dramatically bordering the turquoise Adriatic Sea. The ancient city, with its terracotta rooftops, is nestled against a backdrop of rugged, green mountains under a cloudy sky. Rocky outcrops punctuate the coastline, adding to the dramatic landscape. The clear, blue water contrasts beautifully with the stone walls and vegetation.
