A platter of colorful cut vegetables (red peppers, cucumbers, carrots) with dips sits between the glasses. In the foreground, a small, round dish holds a visually appealing appetizer with a dark base, topped with green leaves and sprinkled with what appears to be seeds or grains. A bottle of San Pellegrino sparkling water is visible in the background, along with beach chairs and a parasol. The overall atmosphere is luxurious and relaxed.

elnaz/456.jpg.description: Two people are making snow angels in a snowy field. They are lying on their backs with arms and legs outstretched, creating the impression of angels. The snow is covering the ground, and there are footprints visible around them. Trees are visible in the background.

elnaz/457.jpg.description: A close-up shot shows an open copy of the Quran, the holy book of Islam, resting on a light gray surface. The pages are filled with Arabic calligraphy, showcasing verses from the scripture. The book is slightly angled, revealing the intricate text and its black ink on a cream-colored page. The overall aesthetic is peaceful and reverent.

elnaz/458.jpg.description: A well-organized walk-in closet featuring a combination of hanging clothes and shoe shelving. The closet is painted white and has a built-in system with multiple hanging rods and shelves. Clothes are neatly arranged by color and type, including pants, jeans, sweaters, and shirts. Shoe shelves are filled with a variety of footwear, including heels, boots, and flats. Storage boxes are also incorporated into the shelving system.

elnaz/459.jpg.description: A close-up, overhead shot showcasing a dense collection of luxury car keys. The keys are predominantly black, with some featuring brand logos in silver, red, or other colors. Brands visible include BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Alfa Romeo, and Maserati. The arrangement is tightly packed, creating a visually striking pattern of automotive luxury.

elnaz/46.jpg.description: A picturesque view of Tallinn, Estonia at dusk. A cobblestone path leads towards a towering medieval stone tower, flanked by buildings with red tile roofs. Warm light spills from the windows of the buildings and from a vintage-style lamppost in the foreground, contrasting with the soft pink and orange hues of the twilight sky. The scene evokes a sense of history and tranquility.

elnaz/460.jpg.description: A silver MacBook Air is displayed open on top of its white retail box. The laptop is positioned on a black leather-like surface. The screen is dark, showing a black display. The keyboard is visible, with black keys and a silver chassis. The Apple logo is visible on both the laptop and the box.

elnaz/461.jpg.description: A collection of souvenir magnets representing various cities and countries. The magnets are predominantly shaped to depict iconic landmarks and cityscapes, including Vienna, Prague, New York, Frankfurt, Dresden, Berlin, Budapest, Ohrid, and others. They feature a mix of architectural details and colorful designs. Some magnets are 3D, while others are flat with printed images. The overall arrangement suggests a travel-themed display.

elnaz/462.jpg.description: A collage of images showcasing various global destinations, including Spain, London, Al Madinah, Mecca, Italy, Greece, Bali, Ukraine, Scotland, France, Los Angeles, Sweden, Australia, Japan, the US, and Canada. Each image is presented within a circular frame, accompanied by the country or city name and its respective flag.

elnaz/463.jpg.description: A well-organized, glass-enclosed display cabinet showcases a large and diverse collection of perfume bottles. The bottles vary in shape, size, and color, ranging from classic designs to more artistic and whimsical forms. The cabinet has multiple glass shelves, maximizing storage and visibility. The collection includes both full-sized bottles and smaller samples/travel sizes, suggesting a dedicated perfume enthusiast. Notable bottles include a pumpkin-shaped fragrance, a rabbit-shaped bottle, and several designer brands.

elnaz/464.jpg.description: A close-up shot showcases Apple AirPods Pro with their charging case partially open. The earbuds are white and nestled within the white charging case, which is also open to reveal the earbuds. The lid of the case is slightly raised, displaying a minimalist design. The image is well-lit and focuses on the sleek, modern aesthetic of the Apple product.

elnaz/465.jpg.description: A woman with long brown hair is posing for a photo outdoors, likely on a boardwalk or promenade. She's wearing a strappy top and light-wash denim overalls. She's looking down and slightly to the side, with one hand resting on her head. In the background, there are palm trees, buildings, and people seated at tables. The sky is a clear, bright blue.

elnaz/466.jpg.description: A luxurious walk-in closet featuring glass-fronted cabinets with dark trim and warm interior lighting. The closet is organized with hanging clothes, shelves for handbags and accessories, and shoe storage at the bottom. The overall aesthetic is sophisticated and well-curated, showcasing a collection of high-end fashion items. The flooring is a neutral carpet, and a bench is visible on the right side.

elnaz/467.jpg.description: A stack of five American Express credit cards is displayed. The cards represent various types, including Business, Platinum, and cards featuring historical figures. The colors vary, including gold, blue, red, and dark brown with a portrait of a Roman figure. The cards are laid on a white surface.

elnaz/468.jpg.description: A man in a black shirt and jeans stands on a stage, holding a microphone and facing forward. Behind him, a group of children in traditional white and orange costumes with elaborate headwear hold bouquets of flowers. The stage appears to be decorated with white confetti or petals. The background is a dark, possibly black, curtain or wall.

elnaz/469.jpg.description: A group of three people are standing on a moving escalator in a modern building. The escalator has black steps with yellow safety markings. The woman on the left is wearing a long white dress, while the two men are dressed in more casual attire – one in a cream-colored jacket and the other in a dark jacket and pants. The building's interior features dark gray and black accents, with some red and green lighting visible in the upper right corner.

elnaz/47.jpg.description: A charming street scene in Tallinn, Estonia, featuring colorful historic buildings with distinctive architecture. The street is paved with cobblestones and leads towards a tall, ornate church tower. Buildings are painted in shades of pink, yellow, and green, creating a vibrant and picturesque atmosphere. The perspective is a narrow street view, emphasizing the height of the buildings and the depth of the street.

elnaz/470.jpg.description: A cluttered workbench with various electronic components, including Arduino boards, breadboards, jumper wires, and small circuit boards. A blue parts container is visible, along with several assembled circuit boards and loose components. The setup suggests a prototyping or electronics project in progress.

elnaz/471.jpg.description: A man in a black shirt and khaki pants stands on a stage, holding a microphone and addressing a group of performers dressed in traditional white and orange costumes with elaborate headwear. The performers are holding bouquets of flowers. The stage is dark, with scattered flower petals on the floor. The photo appears to be taken from the audience's perspective.

elnaz/472.jpg.description: A black Canon PowerShot G7X camera is submerged in a container filled with uncooked white rice. The container appears to be a white plastic bucket or tub, and is sitting on a surface with a black and white striped pattern. A portion of a foot and a gold-colored strap are visible in the top left and bottom left corners of the image, respectively.

elnaz/473.jpg.description: A dramatic stage performance featuring a male and female dancer. The woman is lifted in a graceful pose by the man, her white dress flowing around her. She wears a tiara, and both dancers are dressed in costumes that suggest a historical or folkloric theme. The background is a stark black, highlighting the dancers and the scattered 'snow' or confetti on the stage.

elnaz/474.jpg.description: A woman is taking a selfie in what appears to be a hotel room. She's wearing a grey tank top and white shorts, and a beaded bracelet. The room features a large bed with a white mosquito net, wooden furniture, and light-colored walls and tile flooring. The photo is taken with a mobile phone, which is visible in the frame.

elnaz/475.jpg.description: A serene bedroom scene featuring a large bed draped with a sheer, white mosquito net. The bed is positioned near large windows covered with light, flowing curtains, allowing ample natural light to fill the room. The floor is tiled and reflects the light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. A glimpse of the outdoors is visible through the windows, suggesting a peaceful and relaxing environment.

elnaz/476.jpg.description: A dramatic stage photograph featuring two actors in elaborate costumes, likely from a theatrical production. The man on the left wears a brown tunic-style shirt and vest with dark trousers, gazing off to the side with a thoughtful expression. The woman on the right is dressed in a cream-colored gown and a long, ornate black coat trimmed with fur, her hand raised to her forehead in a gesture of contemplation or distress. The background is a stark black, highlighting the costumes and the actors' expressions. The lighting is focused, creating a sense of mystery and drama.

elnaz/477.jpg.description: A group of dancers performs a traditional folk dance on a stage. They are dressed in ornate white and orange costumes with fur-trimmed hats, and are arranged in a circular formation with arms raised. The stage is dark with a blue floor and scattered confetti or petals.

elnaz/478.jpg.description: A wide shot of a film or video set during production. Several crew members are visible, one operating a camera on a tripod, another adjusting equipment, and a third looking at a monitor. The set is dimly lit with overhead lighting and a large, hanging fabric light diffuser. Various camera accessories, cases, and cables are scattered around the floor, indicating active filming. The walls are dark, and there's a ladder and some boards in the background.

elnaz/479.jpg.description: A well-equipped gym interior featuring rows of dumbbells and weight racks. The space is modern with dark walls and flooring, accented by bright overhead lighting. Mirrors line the walls, creating a sense of spaciousness and allowing for form check during workouts. The equipment appears to be in excellent condition, suggesting a professional and dedicated fitness environment.

elnaz/48.jpg.description: A stunning aerial view of Rovinj, Croatia, at dusk. The old town is nestled on a peninsula, surrounded by the Adriatic Sea and filled with closely packed buildings illuminated by warm lights. A prominent church tower rises above the rooftops, guiding the eye. The harbor is densely populated with boats, creating a picturesque scene.

elnaz/480.jpg.description: A man in a business suit is depicted leaping across the face of a large clock. The clock's hands point to approximately 1:50, suggesting a sense of urgency or running out of time. The image conveys themes of time management, pressure, and the struggle to keep up with deadlines.

elnaz/481.jpg.description: A still life photograph featuring traditional red Chinese envelopes (hongbao) decorated with gold calligraphy and floral patterns. The envelopes are arranged on a dark woven surface alongside a red tassel and a blurred red container, evoking a festive and prosperous atmosphere associated with Lunar New Year celebrations. The lighting is soft and warm, highlighting the intricate details of the envelopes and the rich red color.

elnaz/482.jpg.description: A stunning low-angle shot captures a traditional Chinese pagoda illuminated with warm red lighting against a darkening blue sky. The multi-tiered structure features intricate rooflines with upturned eaves and delicate railings. Red lanterns hang along the sides, adding to the vibrant and cultural aesthetic. The building's wooden framework is visible, highlighting its architectural details. The lighting emphasizes the pagoda's form and creates a dramatic contrast with the evening sky.

elnaz/483.jpg.description: A dimly lit room with the word "Stand Up" in large, illuminated red letters on the back wall. Red chairs are arranged in rows facing the stage, with audience members present. Camera equipment is visible in the foreground, suggesting a recording or live broadcast of a stand-up comedy performance. The ceiling is a grid of black metal structures with spotlights.

elnaz/484.jpg.description: A humorous scene depicts a Santa Claus mannequin or figure relaxing on a lounge chair outdoors. It's dressed in a full Santa suit, complete with a hat and beard, and is wearing sunglasses. The figure is covered with a light-colored towel and appears to be enjoying a sunny day. The setting is a modern outdoor patio or beach club with white furniture, palm trees, and a shaded structure overhead. A person is visible in the background.

elnaz/485.jpg.description: This digital artwork depicts a network of interconnected consciousness, visualized as glowing figures in meditative poses contained within spherical bubbles connected by branching, neural-like pathways. The image evokes themes of interconnectedness, mindfulness, and the collective unconscious. The figures appear serene and illuminated, suggesting inner peace and enlightenment. The overall aesthetic is ethereal and spiritual, with a dark background emphasizing the glowing elements.

elnaz/486.jpg.description: A creatively designed wall featuring a film reel aesthetic. A large film strip with images of Paris and Thailand is mounted on the wall, accompanied by a film reel attached to the side. Above the film strip, a row of Edison-style light bulbs hang from the ceiling, casting a warm glow. The overall effect is a vintage, cinematic ambiance.

elnaz/487.jpg.description: A captivating image showcasing a gnarled, ancient tree with branches heavily draped in moss, set within a misty forest. The tree's roots are exposed and intertwined, creating a dramatic and almost otherworldly scene. The fog softens the background, highlighting the texture and age of the tree. The lush green grass in the foreground provides a vibrant contrast to the muted tones of the forest.

elnaz/488.jpg.description: A large stack of Kazakhstani Tenge banknotes, predominantly 1000 Tenge notes, is visible. The bills are bundled and appear to be freshly printed, with a clear view of the ornate designs and security features. The stack is leaning against a dark surface, likely a table or counter.

elnaz/489.jpg.description: A close-up shot showcases a certificate ('ГРАМОТА' in Russian) presented to Verpovskaya Eva for successfully completing a dance season (2024/25). The certificate has a black background with white star-like designs and the logo of 'Созвездие танца' (Constellation of Dance). It's signed by Чупова Валерия Сергеевна and Хабарова Амина Сергеевна. The certificate is placed on top of several clear plastic card holders, also with a similar design, and a small card with the username 'trk: mariamores' is visible at the bottom left corner. The bottom right corner features the logo 'MARLAMORES' with the text 'мастер индивидуальных образов'.

elnaz/49.jpg.description: A high-angle, slightly blurred photograph showcases a dense cityscape of Tallinn, Estonia, dominated by red tile roofs. The image is taken from a high vantage point, likely a tower, looking down on a square surrounded by historic buildings. A tall, cylindrical tower is prominently featured in the foreground, with a collection of small, red, square structures arranged around it on the square below, possibly a temporary installation or art exhibit. The buildings are a mix of architectural styles, all contributing to the city's charming, old-world aesthetic. The overall tone is muted and slightly overcast, suggesting a cool or damp day.

elnaz/490.jpg.description: A gaming setup bathed in red lighting. It features a wide curved monitor displaying a first-person shooter game, a black desk with a black keyboard and mouse, a PC tower with internal RGB lighting visible through a side panel, and a black and red gaming chair. The room itself is dark, with red accent lighting highlighting the desk, PC, and surrounding walls, creating an immersive gaming atmosphere.

elnaz/491.jpg.description: A sun-drenched forest scene with tall trees and dappled light filtering through the canopy. Sunlight streams down, illuminating the forest floor covered in leaves and scattered rocks. The atmosphere is peaceful and serene, evoking a sense of tranquility and natural beauty.

elnaz/492.jpg.description: A promotional image for Día del Teatro (Day of Theatre) featuring a hand drawing back a heavy, red velvet curtain against a stark black background. The text "Día del Teatro" is written in elegant, white calligraphy to the right of the curtain. The Re/Max logo and tagline "ESTÁS EN TU CASA" are located at the bottom of the image.

elnaz/493.jpg.description: A vibrant and stylish content creation setup. A white table is centered in front of a dark purple wall adorned with artificial vines and a neon sign reading "Heyyy HR! BY TIMEKA GREEN". A ring light is positioned on the table, along with a large light panel to the right. The table also displays various props including a miniature planet, books, candles, and small decorative items. A small shelf unit to the left holds more props and accessories. The overall aesthetic is modern, playful, and geared towards content creation, likely for social media or online videos.

elnaz/494.png.description: A series of black and white photographs showcasing a modern, minimalist aesthetic. The images feature women in flowing white dresses, some adorned with striking accessories like a crystal-covered face covering. The setting appears to be a grand estate with manicured gardens. The photos capture a sense of elegance, mystery, and contemporary fashion.

elnaz/495.jpg.description: A sun-drenched forest path winds through a dense stand of tall trees. Sunlight filters through the canopy, creating dramatic light and shadow play on the forest floor and illuminating dust motes in the air. The path is covered in dirt and fallen leaves, suggesting a well-trodden trail. Lush green vegetation grows on either side, adding to the serene and natural atmosphere.

elnaz/496.jpg.description: A high-angle shot showcases a black camera with a large lens resting on a white bedsheet, positioned below a black laptop displaying photo editing software. The laptop screen shows a color grading interface with various controls and a preview image. A red USB drive is also visible on the bedsheet, connected to the laptop via a cable. The overall aesthetic suggests a photographer or videographer at work, likely editing and reviewing their photos or videos.

elnaz/497.jpg.description: A serene and modern living room featuring a neutral color palette. A light beige sofa with textured cushions sits opposite a light wood TV console mounted on a muted green wall. A large potted plant adds a touch of nature, positioned near a window with sheer curtains. A natural fiber rug grounds the space, complementing the warm wood tones and creating a cozy atmosphere. The TV is backlit, adding a subtle glow to the wall.

elnaz/498.jpg.description: A dimly lit stage features two comfortable armchairs, one upholstered in a striped yellow fabric and the other in a textured pink material. Each chair faces forward and is positioned with a microphone on a stand in front of it, suggesting a podcast or interview setup. The background is a dark, vertically-lined curtain, and the floor is a neutral tone.

elnaz/499.jpg.description: A collection of traditional Chinese cultural elements, including flowers (lotus, chrysanthemum), a scroll, clouds, a red lantern, a fan, a tiger, and a 'double happiness' symbol. The color scheme is predominantly red and gold, signifying good fortune and celebration.

elnaz/5.jpg.description: A woman is taking a selfie while holding a large bouquet of flowers. She is wearing a black outfit with white ruffled sleeves. The flowers are a mix of light pink, white, and peach tones, and are presented in a round arrangement with ribbon accents. The background appears to be a mirror-lined space, possibly a dressing room or studio, with a phone visible in her hand, seemingly used to capture the image.

elnaz/50.jpg.description: A picturesque view of a Swiss village nestled in a valley, with snow-capped mountains rising in the background. Traditional wooden chalets with flower boxes dot the landscape, and a fast-flowing river runs alongside a grassy path where hikers are walking. The warm light of the setting sun illuminates the mountain peaks and the village, creating a serene and idyllic scene.

elnaz/500.jpg.description: A serene beach scene at dusk. Gentle waves roll onto a sandy shore under a gradient sky transitioning from orange near the horizon to a cool blue overhead. The water is a beautiful turquoise color, and foamy white waves are visible in the foreground.

elnaz/501.jpg.description: A scenic view of a cove with turquoise water and a small sandy beach. Lush green cliffs rise on either side, topped with vegetation and a small building with a red roof. The sky is cloudy, casting a soft light over the scene. A few people are visible enjoying the beach.

elnaz/502.jpg.description: A woman is taking a selfie in a fitting room while wearing a fluffy, off-white faux fur jacket and light wash, wide-leg jeans. She is holding her phone up to take the picture. The fitting room has maroon curtains and a full-length mirror. A pair of black shoes are visible on the floor.

elnaz/503.jpg.description: A group of three young men are posing for a photo while bowling. Two of them are holding bowling balls, one red and one maroon. They are all smiling and appear to be enjoying themselves. They are dressed casually, with two wearing light-colored pants and the third wearing dark pants and a grey shirt. The background shows a bowling alley with hanging lights and a sign that reads "Hungry Rabbit". The photo has a slightly grainy, vintage aesthetic.

elnaz/504.jpg.description: A close-up shot showcases a red, rectangular gift box and a red, circular tin filled with Turkish delight. Both containers feature a portrait of Hacı İsmail Hakkızade Şekerci Mustafa, a historical figure, surrounded by text indicating the year 1864. The box is open, revealing a stack of the sweet confection inside. The background is a light-colored, textured surface.

elnaz/505.jpg.description: A captivating scene of two camels adorned with colorful textiles walking along a sandy beach at sunset. The sky is ablaze with warm orange and yellow hues, creating a stunning backdrop. One camel is carrying a rider, while the other is decorated with intricate patterns on its saddle and coverings. The gentle waves of the sea lap at the shore, and a pier with people can be seen in the distance. The image evokes a sense of cultural immersion and tranquility.

elnaz/506.jpg.description: A group of five Asian men are posing for a photo at a bowling alley. They are all wearing white t-shirts and light-colored pants, with some wearing sneakers. Several of them are holding bowling balls – one is maroon, one is red, and another is yellow. The background shows the interior of the bowling alley, with hanging lights and a sign that reads "Hungry Rabbit". The photo has a vintage, slightly grainy aesthetic, reminiscent of film photography.

elnaz/507.jpg.description: A woman stands on a cliff overlooking a vast blue ocean. She is wearing a light-colored, loose-fitting outfit with a halter neck design, and her hair is pulled back. The scene is bathed in warm sunlight, casting shadows and highlighting her features. The landscape includes rocky cliffs and tall grasses, with a small structure visible in the distance on another cliff.

elnaz/508.jpg.description: A picturesque coastal scene featuring rocky formations rising from the turquoise water. Waves gently crash onto a sandy beach, while a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds provides a stunning backdrop. The rocks are covered in sparse vegetation, adding a touch of green to the landscape. The overall impression is one of tranquility and natural beauty.

elnaz/509.jpg.description: A scenic coastal view featuring turquoise water meeting rugged cliffs covered in lush green vegetation. A small building with a red roof sits atop the cliff on the left side of the frame. The sky is a mix of blue and cloudy patches, creating a dynamic atmosphere. The foreground shows dry grasses and sparse vegetation clinging to the cliff edge.

elnaz/51.jpg.description: A rainy street scene in what appears to be a city, likely Seoul, South Korea, judging by the South Korean flag prominently displayed. The wet pavement reflects the lights of a passing green bus and surrounding buildings. The sky is overcast and grey, creating a moody atmosphere. Trees with autumn foliage line the street.

elnaz/510.png.description: A woman with long dark hair is joyfully running along a sandy beach, with waves gently washing over her feet. She's wearing a light-colored, sleeveless dress. Behind her is a dramatic cliff face with vegetation growing on it. The water is a beautiful turquoise color, and the sky is overcast.

elnaz/511.jpg.description: A woman in a flowing dress walks into the turquoise water of a tropical beach, facing dramatic rock formations. The sky is a mix of blue and fluffy white clouds. The water is foamy and clear, highlighting the natural beauty of the scene.

elnaz/512.jpg.description: A wide shot of a television or film set. The set is designed to resemble a cozy living room with a brown couch, coffee table, and various props. Multiple studio lights are suspended from the ceiling and positioned on stands, illuminating the scene. Two cameras are positioned in the foreground, ready to capture the action. The walls are painted in a combination of beige and green. The floor is covered with a brown carpet.

elnaz/513.jpg.description: A behind-the-scenes shot of a photoshoot in a minimalist white studio. A photographer is kneeling, focused on a model who is seated on a black chair. Dramatic lighting creates strong shadows and highlights, emphasizing the model's pose and the starkness of the environment. The model is wearing a black outfit and has her hair pulled back. Studio equipment, including a light stand and camera, are visible.

elnaz/514.jpg.description: A dramatic low-angle shot from inside a hot air balloon basket as the burner is ignited. Flames roar upwards into the balloon's opening, illuminating the woven basket and the crew preparing for flight. The balloon itself is a vibrant mix of orange and dark green panels. In the background, a unique landscape of rock formations suggests Cappadocia, Turkey. The scene is captured under a cloudy sky, hinting at an early morning or late evening flight.

elnaz/515.png.description: A group of women walk in a line, all wearing white dresses with draped shoulder details. The dresses are backless and some are accessorized with pearl strands. The women have their hair pulled back, and some are wearing headpieces. The image appears to be from a fashion show or event, with a watermark indicating the brand @litchi brand.

elnaz/516.jpg.description: A person is in mid-air, appearing to be bungee jumping or participating in a similar extreme sport. They are extending their arms as if flying, with a guide assisting from a platform. The platform overlooks a vast, hilly landscape with a hazy horizon. The scene is bathed in bright sunlight, creating a dramatic and adventurous atmosphere.

elnaz/517.jpg.description: Two people in racing gear and helmets are in go-karts, appearing to be celebrating or acknowledging each other. They are inside a go-kart track with red and black decor. The go-kart in the foreground has the number '5' on it and is black with yellow accents. The other kart is partially visible in the background.

elnaz/518.jpg.description: A close-up shot of a DJI Osmo Mobile gimbal holding a smartphone. The phone's screen displays a landscape scene, likely being recorded. The gimbal is black and has a sleek, modern design. The background is a blurred, textured surface, possibly a wall or column, with a light color.

elnaz/519.jpg.description: A close-up shot shows a well-worn passport open, displaying numerous entry and exit stamps from the Dominican Republic. The stamps span dates from 2014 to 2018, indicating frequent travel. A hand with a painted fingernail holds the passport against a silver metallic surface, likely inside an airplane or train.

elnaz/52.jpg.description: A vibrant scene of Nyhavn harbor in Copenhagen, Denmark. Colorful buildings line the waterfront, reflecting in the calm water. Several boats are docked, and a Danish flag waves prominently in the foreground. The sky is blue with scattered clouds, creating a picturesque and lively atmosphere.

elnaz/520.jpg.description: A first-person view from atop a dark-colored horse, showing the horse's neck and back, along with the rider's legs and a portion of their upper body. The horse is equipped with a brown saddle and bridle. Another horse is partially visible in the background, also saddled. The ground appears to be covered in gravel or dirt.

elnaz/521.jpg.description: A mobile music production setup featuring an iPad running music production software, a Focusrite audio interface, a microphone, and headphones. The setup is laid out on a white surface with various cables connecting the components.

elnaz/522.jpg.description: A person practices a yoga pose, seemingly a variation of a handstand with a high leg extension, against a breathtaking backdrop of mountains bathed in the warm glow of a sunset or sunrise. The sky is a vibrant orange, reflecting on the snow-capped peaks. The person is silhouetted against the light, emphasizing the connection between human form and the grandeur of nature. The foreground consists of grassy vegetation.

elnaz/523.png.description: A long hallway with a series of busts on pedestals lining both sides. The hallway is painted in a light cream color, with rounded pillars and a classical architectural style. The image is taken from a low angle, emphasizing the length of the hallway and the sculptures. A watermark for @lichi_brand is visible in the center of the image, with text in Russian reading "НЕВЕРОЙТНО КРАСИВАЯ ЛОКАЦИЯ" (Incredibly beautiful location).

elnaz/524.jpg.description: A woman is taking a selfie while wearing a face mask outdoors. She is wearing a striped shirt and has dark hair. The background features modern architecture, including a spherical building and a building with angled glass panels. There are planters with greenery and a paved walkway.

elnaz/525.jpg.description: A collection of Kinder Surprise eggs featuring a Stranger Things theme. The eggs are predominantly red and white with the 'Stranger Things' and 'Kinder' logos prominently displayed. A Funko Pop figure of Vecna stands in the background.

elnaz/526.png.description: A captivating shot from the Future of Greece fashion show by lichi_brand. The image features a model in a striking outfit walking in front of a classical-style building adorned with columns, framed by lush, white rose bushes. The scene evokes a dreamlike atmosphere, enhanced by the song 'Only When I’m Dreaming' by Minnie Riperton.

elnaz/527.jpg.description: A top-down view of a breakfast or brunch spread. On the left is a cup of coffee with a foamy crema. In the center is a white, ornate dish holding a slice of bread covered in cream cheese and topped with bright red salmon roe (caviar). To the right is a decorative plate with four pieces of what appears to be blini or small pancakes, accompanied by a small dish of dark jam or jelly and a tiny metal serving spoon. The table is marble.

elnaz/528.jpg.description: A young woman with long brown hair rides a pale horse in a field. She is wearing a light-colored shirt, a brown belt, and appears to be enjoying a peaceful ride. The background is blurred, suggesting a natural outdoor setting.

elnaz/529.jpg.description: A striking portrait of a person transformed with elaborate Avatar-inspired makeup and hair. The skin is painted a cool blue, mimicking the Na'vi from the film, with intricate white and red patterns resembling bioluminescent markings.  The hair is styled in long, dark braids adorned with feathers and beads, and pointed ear prosthetics complete the otherworldly look. The subject's gaze is intense, enhanced by dramatic eye makeup.

elnaz/53.jpg.description: A breathtaking view of a lush green meadow in the Swiss Alps, complete with grazing cows and traditional wooden chalets. A majestic waterfall cascades down the mountainside in the background, creating a picturesque and serene landscape under a partly cloudy sky.

elnaz/530.jpg.description: A smiling woman stands on a boat, leaning against the railing with a blurred cityscape of Istanbul in the background. She is wearing a long olive green coat with a fur-trimmed collar and cuffs, and grey pants. The water is choppy, and the sky is overcast. The photo appears to be taken during a boat tour on the Bosphorus.

elnaz/531.png.description: A woman in traditional Kazakh attire is posing with her hands raised, seemingly in a dance or performance. She is wearing a bright yellow dress with a dark bodice and a headdress adorned with feathers and decorative elements. The background is a dark stage, and another person is partially visible on the left, also in traditional clothing. The image is a screenshot from a TikTok post by khamelyan22, with statistics showing 721 likes, 15 comments, and 5 shares.

elnaz/532.jpg.description: A beautiful bouquet of small, fluffy flowers, primarily in shades of pink and white, is tied with a pink ribbon and a white ribbon with the word 'ROSE' printed on it. The bouquet is positioned against a white wall and a window frame, casting a soft light on the arrangement.

elnaz/533.jpg.description: A flatlay featuring a selection of luxury and skincare products. A tube of Rhode lip treatment in a muted rose color, a pot of Chanel highlighting powder with a golden sheen, and a bottle of Giorgio Armani Luminous Silk foundation are arranged on a textured, light brown surface. The background includes a blurred glimpse of a Sanam Beauty Lab logo.

elnaz/534.png.description: A captivating image showcasing a dancer in traditional Kazakh attire. The dancer, dressed in a vibrant red outfit adorned with intricate gold detailing, gracefully extends their arms upwards, creating a visually striking composition against a stark white background. The image is part of a publication by NU_KIYE, the official account of Nazarbayev University.

elnaz/535.jpg.description: A low-angle shot captures a tender moment between two people dressed in what appears to be a 1920s-themed outfit. One person, wearing a brown vest and white shirt, is embracing another who is adorned with multiple strands of pearls and a dark headpiece. The background shows an outdoor setting with trees and a glimpse of other people, possibly at an event. The sun is setting, casting a warm glow on the scene.

elnaz/536.png.description: A woman with long dark hair is seen in a dimly lit setting, seemingly performing or posing with two white, curved objects held above her head. She is wearing a shimmering, possibly sequined, top. The background is dark, with what appears to be a stage or studio setting with dark curtains or panels on either side. The image is a screenshot from a TikTok post by khamelyan22, with visible TikTok interface elements like likes, comments, shares, and a promotion button.

elnaz/537.jpg.description: A woman in a dark brown coat is lying down near a table, looking up at the camera with a slight smile. She is holding two pink takeaway coffee cups. A black purse with a chain strap is visible over her shoulder. The scene appears to be outdoors, possibly a cafe or restaurant with holiday decorations, including a gift box and string lights. There are branded elements visible, including 'Broadway Burger' and 'Lancôme'.

elnaz/538.jpg.description: A striking portrait featuring a young woman with long, flowing dark hair, positioned closely with a dark-colored horse. The woman is dressed in a white blouse with intricate embroidered details and a black choker. The horse's head is prominent, filling much of the frame and creating a strong visual connection with the subject. The image has a slightly muted, artistic tone, enhanced by the Remini AI watermark.

elnaz/539.jpg.description: A beautifully set table at Bestia restaurant, featuring a dark green placemat and tableware. The image showcases a charcuterie board with cured meats, breadsticks, and what appears to be olives or nuts, alongside a plate of fresh oysters served on ice with lemon wedges. A personalized place card with the name 'Eliana' and a wax seal adds a personal touch to the elegant setting. Silverware is neatly arranged to the side.

elnaz/54.jpg.description: A low-angle shot captures the ornate architecture of Christiansborg Palace in Copenhagen, Denmark. The palace features a striking combination of red brick and green copper roofs, with a tall, slender tower on the left and symmetrical turrets framing the central gateway. A Danish flag flies prominently from the palace's central structure. The foreground shows a paved courtyard leading to the palace entrance, flanked by decorative sculptures and a low barrier. The sky is a vibrant blue with fluffy white clouds, enhancing the building's grandeur.

elnaz/540.jpg.description: A close-up shot shows two simit, a traditional Turkish street food resembling a ring-shaped bread covered in sesame seeds, held in a hand. They are presented on a piece of pink and green patterned paper. The background is blurred, revealing a bustling street scene in Istanbul, Turkey, with buildings and pedestrians. Turkish and other flags are strung across the street.

elnaz/541.jpg.description: A striking portrait of a woman with large, white feathered wings, standing outdoors in a winter setting. She is dressed in a black dress and poses against a backdrop of a city skyline and a snowy landscape. The lighting is soft and diffused, suggesting either dusk or dawn, with a pale pink and purple sky. The woman has long, dark hair and wears red lipstick, creating a contrast with the white wings. The scene evokes a sense of ethereal beauty and contrasts the delicate wings with the harsh winter environment.

elnaz/542.jpg.description: A woman with long brown hair, wearing a black dress, poses with large white feather wings. She is standing on a snowy outdoor platform with a railing, looking towards the camera. In the background is a large, ornate building with warm lighting. The sky is a pale blue, suggesting dusk or dawn.

elnaz/543.jpg.description: A young woman with long, wavy brown hair poses with large, white feathered wings. She is wearing a short, black slip dress and appears to be crouching or sitting on a snowy rooftop or elevated platform. The background features blurred buildings with warm lighting, suggesting dusk or evening. The overall aesthetic is ethereal and striking.

elnaz/544.png.description: A woman is holding up a long, thick braid of brown hair. The braid is approximately 65cm long and is being offered as a complete set of braids. The price ranges from 55,000 to 65,000 rubles depending on the chosen stylist and the length of the client's hair. The background appears to be a concert venue, possibly related to Dua Lipa's 'Illusion' tour.

elnaz/545.jpg.description: A large bouquet of vibrant red tulips is nestled inside a white bathtub. The bouquet is wrapped in layers of gray and black paper. The bathtub is white and sits against a backdrop of wood-paneled walls. A showerhead is visible in the upper left corner.

elnaz/546.jpg.description: A display of various Starbucks coffee bean bags is shown, arranged in two rows on shelves. The top row features Pike Place Roast, Colombia Narino, Sumatra, and Caffè Verona, along with Espresso Roast. The bottom row mirrors the top row with the same varieties. The bags are predominantly brown and gold in color, with detailed designs and the Starbucks logo prominently displayed. Green Starbucks cups are visible at the bottom of the frame.

elnaz/547.jpg.description: A close-up shot of a floral arrangement in a dark grey glass vase. The bouquet features a prominent, dusty-purple artichoke flower surrounded by clusters of delicate white flowers resembling stock or similar blooms. A single, dark purple petal adds a contrasting touch. The arrangement sits on a light-colored, round table with a dark center. The background is a textured red wall.

elnaz/548.jpg.description: A collection of SHIK Studio makeup and skincare products is displayed against a black background. The products include a mascara, a concealer, a lip oil, a serum, and a dual-ended eyeliner/brow pencil. A small white dish holds a brush. The packaging is minimalist, primarily in neutral tones with the SHIK Studio logo.

elnaz/549.jpg.description: A large, dense bouquet of vibrant red tulips is nestled within layers of gray and white wrapping paper. The bouquet is placed inside a white, possibly ceramic, container or tub. The tulips appear to be tightly packed, creating a full and visually striking arrangement. The background shows a wooden surface, suggesting a rustic or natural setting.

elnaz/55.jpg.description: A picturesque view of Nyhavn harbor in Copenhagen, Denmark. Traditional colorful buildings line the waterfront, reflected in the rippling water. Several boats are docked, with a Danish flag prominently displayed in the foreground. A black boat with a ladder and rigging is in the front, partially obscuring the view of other vessels. The sky is a soft, muted tone, suggesting either sunrise or sunset.

elnaz/550.jpg.description: A woman with long, reddish-brown hair is leaning over a railing, looking down. She is wearing a maroon long-sleeved shirt, overalls, and sunglasses. The photo is taken from a low angle, with the railing and a decorative structure visible below. The background shows a blurred view of a building and a cloudy sky.

elnaz/551.jpg.description: A charming street-side cafe scene in Istanbul, Turkey. Two glasses of Turkish tea are set on a small, black metal table with a woven placemat and a small stack of napkins. The cafe is nestled between colorful buildings – one yellow, one green, and one red – with vines cascading down the facades. Pedestrians stroll along the cobblestone street, and in the background, the Galata Tower is visible. A waiter in a green uniform is partially visible on the right side of the frame.

elnaz/552.jpg.description: A beautifully arranged dessert table featuring tiered stands and decorative elements. The table is covered with a brown and beige cloth, adorned with pearl strands and floral arrangements. The tiered stands hold a variety of treats including macarons, cream puffs, and what appear to be chocolate-covered pastries. Silver platters display additional desserts like popcorn and baked goods with a dark glaze. A person in a white shirt is partially visible in the background.

elnaz/553.jpg.description: An indoor tennis court with a dark reddish-brown surface and a black net. A light blue curtain covers the back wall, and the ceiling is a complex network of metal beams and lighting fixtures. A tennis ball holder with a yellow ball is visible in the foreground.

elnaz/554.jpg.description: Two horses, one brown and one black, stand in a snowy field, eating hay from a trough. Both horses are saddled and appear to be resting. In the background, a snow-covered mountain range and bare trees are visible under a cloudy, grey sky. A wooden structure is also present on the left side of the frame.

elnaz/555.jpg.description: A young woman with long dark hair poses for a selfie with a brown and white horse. She is wearing a black puffer jacket and is making a kissy face. The horse is close to the camera, with its nose almost touching the lens. The background shows a winter landscape with mountains and bare trees under a pale blue sky.

elnaz/556.jpg.description: A couple stands in front of a vibrant Chinese-style pagoda adorned with numerous red lanterns. The man is wearing a black short-sleeved shirt and white shorts, while the woman is in a black tank top and a white dress. The pagoda features intricate architectural details and a multi-tiered roof. Several other people are visible in the background, enjoying the area. The sky is partly cloudy.

elnaz/557.jpg.description: A close-up portrait of a woman with long, wavy, light brown hair. She is looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression and wearing a subtle lip gloss. The background appears to be a modern indoor space with white and gray elements, including chairs and a large window. There's a person visible in the background, seated at a table.

elnaz/558.jpg.description: A moody, atmospheric interior shot featuring a view of a snowy, foggy landscape through a large window. The interior is dimly lit with dark wood paneling and furniture. A small round table with two chairs is visible outside, covered in snow. Inside, a table is set with what appears to be condiments and a menu. A tall, slender plant stands to the right of the frame, adding a touch of greenery to the otherwise muted color palette. The overall feeling is one of quiet solitude and winter chill.

elnaz/559.jpg.description: A still life composition featuring a round table draped with a dusty rose velvet cloth. The table is adorned with numerous stemmed glasses, some filled with a light-colored liquid, possibly champagne or wine. A delicate pearl necklace is casually draped across the surface, alongside a small, ornate silver bowl containing fluffy white stems. A lit candle in a brass holder and a small decorative object are also present. The background includes sheer white curtains and a glimpse of a wintery outdoor scene through a window, with hardwood flooring visible beneath the table.

elnaz/56.jpg.description: A top-down view of a breakfast or brunch spread on a wooden table. There's a laptop partially visible on the left, suggesting someone is working or enjoying a meal while working. A tall glass of orange juice is garnished with mint and a lemon slice. A coconut bowl is filled with a colorful acai bowl featuring bananas, berries, and what appears to be granola or nuts. A glass jar contains a pink yogurt-based dessert with fruit and granola, also garnished with mint. A cup of coffee sits on a saucer, and a spoon is placed below the jar. A napkin is also present.

elnaz/560.jpg.description: A green metal shopping basket is overflowing with a mix of red and yellow tennis balls. A black and yellow tennis shoe is tucked underneath the balls, partially visible. The basket is positioned on a red clay tennis court.

elnaz/57.jpg.description: A stunning view of the Argentinian flag waving proudly in front of a cityscape, likely in Buenos Aires. The sky is filled with dramatic clouds illuminated by the setting or rising sun, casting a warm glow over the buildings and plaza. People stroll along the walkways, adding a sense of life to the scene.

elnaz/58.jpg.description: A breathtaking panoramic view of Perito Moreno Glacier in Patagonia, Argentina. The massive glacier, with its striking blue ice, dominates the landscape, flowing down from the snow-capped mountains. A turquoise lake is filled with icebergs calved from the glacier, and lush green forests line the foreground. A dirt path winds through the hillside, offering a vantage point to witness this natural wonder.

elnaz/59.jpg.description: A vibrant Union Jack (the flag of the United Kingdom) hangs prominently from a white pole against a backdrop of a detailed, ornate building. The building features a clock with Roman numerals and intricate architectural details, including decorative carvings and a stained glass window. The flag is slightly wrinkled, suggesting a gentle breeze. The building's facade is a mix of dark and light stone, with a black and white timber-framed structure visible on the left.

elnaz/6.jpg.description: A selfie featuring two people, a young man and a young woman. The man on the left is wearing a navy blue sweater and glasses, looking directly at the camera. The woman on the right is wearing a white shirt and a white headband with bunny ears, making a peace sign with her fingers. Both are smiling and appear to be enjoying themselves. The background is a muted green wall with a glimpse of another person and a mirror.

elnaz/60.jpg.description: A vibrant photograph captures the iconic Plaza de Mayo in Buenos Aires, Argentina. The Argentine flag proudly waves against a clear blue sky, framed by lush green trees in the foreground. In the background, the Casa Rosada (Presidential Palace) and other historic buildings create a stunning architectural backdrop. The scene evokes a sense of national pride and historical significance.

elnaz/61.jpg.description: A stunning view inside a massive bookstore, likely in South Korea, featuring towering bookshelves filled with books that form a dramatic architectural element. An escalator leads up through the center of the book displays. A woman with long hair is in the foreground, seemingly taking a photo or using her phone, while other patrons browse magazines and books on tables in the foreground. The bookstore's signage is visible at the top, written in Korean.

elnaz/62.jpg.description: A stunning view of the Pula Arena in Croatia, bathed in the warm glow of the setting sun. The ancient Roman amphitheater stands majestically, its stone arches and structure highlighted by the golden light. In the foreground, vibrant lavender and greenery add a touch of natural beauty, while a couple of people stroll along a pathway, providing a sense of scale. The sky is a soft blend of blue and orange, creating a peaceful and picturesque scene.

elnaz/63.jpg.description: A picturesque view in Santorini, Greece, featuring whitewashed buildings with iconic blue dome churches. A cascade of vibrant pink bougainvillea frames the scene, contrasting beautifully with the white walls and overlooking a calm, deep blue sea with a distant sailboat. Stone steps lead downwards, inviting exploration of the charming village.

elnaz/64.jpg.description: A vibrant photograph showcases the iconic Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament in London, with a Union Jack flag prominently waving in the foreground. The image is framed by lush green foliage, adding depth and a natural element to the urban scene. The clock face displays the time, and the architectural details of the buildings are highlighted by the sunlight. A small banner at the bottom reads 'London City Views'.

elnaz/65.jpg.description: A nighttime view of Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament in London, illuminated against a dark sky. A red double-decker bus with route number 453 to Deptford Bridge is partially visible in the foreground, along with a dark-colored car. The wet street reflects the lights, creating a vibrant scene.

elnaz/66.jpg.description: A close-up selfie of a young woman with dark hair pulled back, wearing a tan coat with a dark, curly fur collar. She is smiling and looking at the camera, with visible makeup including red lipstick and long eyelashes. The background shows a European-style street with buildings and a red awning.

elnaz/67.jpg.description: A charming hobbit hole built into a lush green hillside. The entrance features a round wooden door painted a vibrant red, and a stone chimney. A circular blue door is visible below, likely leading to another part of the dwelling. The surrounding landscape is rolling hills covered in vibrant green grass, with a few trees in the distance under a clear blue sky. It evokes a sense of fairytale and tranquility.

elnaz/68.jpg.description: A low-angle shot showcases the magnificent St. Vitus Cathedral in Prague, Czech Republic. The cathedral's intricate Gothic architecture is highlighted, featuring towering spires, ornate facades, and large stained-glass windows. A clock is visible on the central tower, and the building is constructed from grey stone. Numerous tourists are gathered in the square in front of the cathedral, adding a sense of scale and activity to the scene. The sky is overcast, providing soft, diffused lighting.

elnaz/69.jpg.description: A charming scene at Les Deux Magots in Paris, showcasing a table laden with a flaky croissant, a slice of cake adorned with strawberries and blueberries, and a cup of cappuccino with latte art. The iconic café's red awning and traditional bistro chairs create a classic Parisian atmosphere. People are seated at tables enjoying their meals and drinks.

elnaz/7.jpg.description: A laptop displaying a presentation about employee types in a company, with a graph showing a curve representing performance levels. A notebook with handwritten notes is placed in front of the keyboard. The scene is set on a white surface, likely a desk or table.

elnaz/70.jpg.description: A stunning street view is framed by a canopy of blooming jacaranda trees, their purple flowers creating a magical tunnel over the road. The buildings on either side are old and charming, with architectural details visible. Several people are walking along the street, and cars are parked on both sides. The lighting suggests either dusk or dawn, with a beautiful gradient of purple and pink in the sky.

elnaz/71.png.description: A young woman poses in front of the Hagia Sophia in Istanbul, Turkey. She is wearing a white top and a long, golden skirt. The photo is taken from a rooftop, with a metal railing in the foreground and a clear blue sky above. The Hagia Sophia's iconic domes and minarets are prominently featured in the background.

elnaz/72.jpg.description: A woman with long dark hair is swimming underwater, wearing a snorkel mask and fins. She is facing upwards towards the camera, with bubbles surrounding her face. The water is a vibrant blue, and the surface above is distorted with light and reflections, suggesting a sunny day. Her arms are outstretched, and she appears to be enjoying the underwater experience.

elnaz/73.jpg.description: A stunning view of Prague Castle illuminated at dusk, overlooking a river and charming buildings with red tile roofs. The castle's spires and intricate architecture stand out against a dramatic, cloudy sky. Reflections of the city lights shimmer on the water's surface, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

elnaz/74.jpg.description: A vibrant image showcasing the Eiffel Tower in Paris, France, with a French flag prominently displayed in the foreground. The flag, featuring the iconic blue, white, and red tricolor, is waving in the breeze, partially obscuring the lower levels of the tower. The scene is captured from a low angle, likely from a boat on the Seine River, with the water visible in the foreground. The sky is a beautiful blue with scattered clouds, providing a picturesque backdrop to this iconic landmark.

elnaz/75.jpg.description: A Czech flag is prominently displayed in front of a blurred background of ornate architecture, likely in Prague. The flag is divided into a blue and red triangle with a white band, and is attached to a pole. The building behind it features intricate detailing and a greenish-gold spire.

elnaz/76.jpg.description: A picturesque street scene in Paris, France, featuring the iconic Eiffel Tower in the background. The photo captures a narrow street lined with classic Parisian buildings, including a restaurant named 'Il Sorrentino'. The warm light of the setting sun casts a golden glow on the buildings and the tower, creating a beautiful and inviting atmosphere. Flower boxes add a touch of color to the foreground, while cars and pedestrians populate the street.

elnaz/77.jpg.description: An underwater shot of a person snorkeling in clear blue water. The person is wearing a snorkel mask, a red life vest, and appears to be swimming towards the camera. Sunlight filters through the surface, creating shimmering patterns and bubbles in the water. The person's arms are extended, and small fish can be seen in the distance.

elnaz/78.jpg.description: A woman in a red coat is feeding a seagull with a small piece of food. She is smiling and looking at the bird, which is mid-flight and reaching for the food. The photo is taken outdoors, likely on a rooftop or balcony, with a view of Istanbul's skyline including the Süleymaniye Mosque in the background. Other seagulls are also visible in the frame. The word 'HELLO' is written vertically on a nearby surface.

elnaz/79.jpg.description: A smiling woman stands next to a large elephant, embracing its trunk. They are positioned near a metal fence, with palm trees and lush greenery in the background. Another person is riding an elephant in the distance, and a handler in green uniform is visible on the right. The scene appears to be at a sanctuary or park.

elnaz/8.jpg.description: A person is taking a selfie in a mirror while holding a beautiful bouquet of flowers. The flowers are a mix of pastel shades - peach, cream, and light pink - and are tied with ribbons. The person is wearing a white shirt and a black blazer and is holding a phone to capture the moment. The background shows a glossy, dark-colored surface, likely a counter or table.

elnaz/80.jpg.description: A young woman stands between two elephants in an outdoor setting. The elephants are large and gray, with decorative coverings on their heads and backs. They are positioned on either side of a wooden fence, with the woman standing in the middle. The background features lush green vegetation, including tall palm trees, suggesting a tropical location. The ground is wet, indicating recent rain. The woman is wearing a light-colored jacket, a white skirt, and sandals.

elnaz/81.jpg.description: A photograph shows the Malaysian flag, 'Jalur Gemilang', waving in the breeze against a dramatic sky and reflecting in the calm water below. The sun is positioned behind the flag, creating a warm glow and highlighting the flag's red and white stripes, a yellow crescent moon, and a yellow star. The scene appears to be taken near a beach or coastal area with a low tide exposing the seabed.

elnaz/82.png.description: A chef is flambéing a dish at a teppanyaki grill. He's wearing a black uniform and cap, and is focused on the flames as he holds a plate of food. The grill is surrounded by a black metal frame, and there are bottles and decorative stones visible in the foreground. The background shows a modern restaurant setting with other food preparations visible.

elnaz/83.jpg.description: A striking photograph features a person sitting inside the mouth of a massive, moss-covered stone sculpture of a lion's head. The sculpture is built into a hillside, with intricate details forming the lion's face, including eyes and a cavernous mouth. Lush greenery, including vibrant pink flowers, frames the lower portion of the image, while trees and a cloudy sky provide the backdrop. The overall scene is surreal and captivating, blending nature and art.

elnaz/84.jpg.description: A young woman stands next to a large elephant, gently touching its trunk. She is dressed in a light-colored outfit and has long, wavy hair. The scene appears to be outdoors, possibly at a sanctuary or park, with palm trees and lush greenery in the background. Other people and elephants are visible in the distance.

elnaz/85.jpg.description: A woman leans out of a red Istanbul tram car, resting her head and arm on the exterior. The tram appears to be in motion or stopped along a track, with a protective shield around the driver's area. The scene is captured at night, with the tram's lights illuminating the surrounding darkness. The tram car is labeled with '410' and 'Taksim - Tünel'.

elnaz/86.png.description: A wedding announcement featuring a couple embracing in front of a building, with a cassette tape held in the foreground. The announcement reads "WE ARE GETTING MARRIED" and includes text in Russian. The cassette tape has "BEST WISHES FOR YOU" printed on it. The date August 16, 2025 is visible at the top. The overall aesthetic is vintage and romantic.

elnaz/87.jpg.description: A woman is posing in front of ornate architectural details, seemingly a gate or entrance with intricate white carvings. She is positioned in a unique, tilted perspective, almost as if looking down from above. She's wearing a cream-colored knit sweater and grey pants, with her head tilted and one hand raised near her face. The background includes a blue sky with fluffy white clouds and a glimpse of a building. The photo is taken from a low angle, emphasizing the architectural elements and the woman's pose.

elnaz/88.jpg.description: A woman stands in front of the illuminated Eiffel Tower in Paris, wearing a black dress and a fluffy, light pink faux fur shawl. She is looking directly at the camera with a confident expression, wearing red lipstick and earrings. The photo is taken at night, with the Seine River and buildings visible in the background. A metal railing is in the foreground, adorned with locks.

elnaz/89.jpg.description: A woman sits near the Seine River in Paris, with the illuminated Eiffel Tower in the background. She is wearing a black dress and a fluffy white fur coat, and has red lipstick. She is looking off to the side with a relaxed expression, resting her head in her hand.

elnaz/9.jpg.description: A still life featuring a plush Simba toy, a vase with blooming white flowers (likely daffodils or narcissus), and a red box with white lettering. The scene is set against a light gray wall with a black electrical outlet visible. The box has the text "Elmaz ❤️ QM" on it.

elnaz/90.jpg.description: This is a Baroque-era oil painting depicting a young boy dressed in a white, somewhat oversized outfit, possibly a theatrical costume. He stands centrally in the composition, looking slightly dazed or lost. Two other boys, one in a red cap and the other with a matching cap, gaze up at him with expressions of curiosity or amusement. The background is a dark, wooded area with tall trees. The painting is housed in a highly ornate, gilded frame. The lighting in the photograph suggests it's viewed in a museum setting.

elnaz/91.jpg.description: A stunning low-angle shot captures the iconic Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, illuminated against a twilight sky. The towers, with their distinctive Islamic-inspired design, dominate the frame, connected by the Skybridge. Below, the Suria KLCC shopping mall is visible, and a vibrant water fountain display adds a splash of color to the foreground. The image showcases the architectural grandeur and modern cityscape of Kuala Lumpur.

elnaz/92.jpg.description: A young woman is sitting on a sidewalk in what appears to be a themed entertainment area, possibly Universal Studios. She is wearing a black tank top and light-colored shorts, accessorized with a gold necklace and a small, quilted white handbag. The background features a vibrant, stylized street scene with colorful lights and architectural details, including a large, cartoonish light fixture resembling a lightbulb. The overall atmosphere is lively and playful.

elnaz/93.jpg.description: A wide-angle shot captures a large, symmetrical courtyard of the Louvre Museum in Paris. The architecture is grand and classical, featuring a long, ornate building with numerous windows and columns. The courtyard is paved with a mix of stone and concrete, and scattered with people walking around. The sky is overcast, casting a muted light over the scene. The perspective is slightly elevated, looking down into the courtyard.

elnaz/94.jpg.description: A photograph showcases the iconic Winged Victory of Samothrace sculpture at the Louvre Museum. The marble statue of the Greek goddess Nike, missing her arms, stands atop a fragmented base of stone. The sculpture is dramatically lit, highlighting the delicate folds of her drapery and the impressive span of her wings. The surrounding architecture features arched walls and a stone floor, creating a sense of grandeur and historical weight. People can be seen in the background, observing the artwork.

elnaz/95.jpg.description: A view of the Louvre Museum's glass pyramid and surrounding courtyard, framed by the window panes of a building. The scene is overcast and muted, with a somber, atmospheric quality. The window frame creates a strong contrast between the interior darkness and the exterior view. People are visible walking in the courtyard.

elnaz/96.jpg.description: A woman stands in the middle of a bustling street at Universal Studios, looking back towards the camera. She is wearing a black tank top, white skirt, and carrying a small pink purse. The street is lined with buildings and filled with people, with a large, golden, spherical decoration visible overhead. The lighting is a mix of artificial and ambient light, creating a vibrant atmosphere.

elnaz/97.jpg.description: A woman stands in the middle of a bustling street, likely a theme park or entertainment district, with a blurred background of people and colorful lights. She is wearing a navy blue tank top and white shorts, with a small white purse slung across her body. The street is lined with buildings and features a striking overhead structure of metal beams and blue lighting. The image captures a lively and energetic atmosphere.

elnaz/98.jpg.description: A woman stands in the middle of a bustling street, likely at a theme park or entertainment district, with a festive atmosphere. She is wearing a navy blue V-neck top and high-waisted white shorts, accessorized with a crossbody bag. The background features a covered street with a blue illuminated ceiling, lined with buildings and filled with people. The scene is lively and suggests a fun, nighttime outing.

elnaz/99.jpg.description: This image showcases two marble sculptures of sphinxes, likely from the 19th century, positioned on a pedestal. The sphinxes are depicted with the body of a lion and the head of a human, complete with detailed facial features and elaborate wings. They appear to be part of a larger architectural element, possibly a tomb or monument, and are situated near a window with a view of a building exterior. The sculptures are rendered in a classical style, with attention to detail in the carving of the fur, feathers, and facial expressions. The lighting highlights the texture of the marble and the intricate details of the sculptures.

nurlan/1.jpg.description: A close-up photo features an elderly couple standing outdoors with a scenic mountain backdrop. The woman, wearing a pink head covering and a red jacket, looks directly at the camera with a serious expression. The man, beside her, wears glasses and a dark jacket over a tan shirt. Behind them, a young girl in a pink shirt is looking through binoculars. Above, cable cars are visible against a cloudy sky, and lush green mountains fill the background.

nurlan/10.jpg.description: A group of three young men posing for a photo outdoors. The men are standing in front of a green running track with trees and a cloudy sky in the background. The man on the left is wearing a white t-shirt with 'CLASSIC' printed on it and grey pants. The middle man is wearing a black t-shirt and black pants. The man on the right is wearing a plaid blazer over a black shirt and is holding a phone. They all appear to be of Asian descent.

nurlan/100.jpg.description: Two men are posing in front of a dark background, with text overlay in a mix of languages. One man is wearing a black jacket and a beanie, while the other is in a red jacket. There's a pink 'Ask me a question' banner at the top and text at the bottom in what appears to be a mix of Russian and another language. The overall aesthetic is casual and playful.

nurlan/101.jpg.description: A top-down view of a person lying on a gray surface, likely a walkway or platform, with a dramatic backdrop of a steep, wooded hillside. The person is wearing a dark blue puffer jacket, brown pants, black shoes, and a white and black Adidas cap. The scene is bathed in bright sunlight, casting a strong shadow of the person onto the surface.

nurlan/102.jpg.description: A high-angle, almost bird's-eye view of a person standing on a metal grate walkway, likely a bridge. The person is wearing a blue puffer jacket, blue pants, and a red and blue Adidas cap with a white logo. They are looking down, and the background shows a blurred view of trees and a gray surface below the grate.

nurlan/103.jpg.description: A group of six people are posing for a photo from a low angle, seemingly under a bridge or overpass. They are all wearing winter clothing, including jackets, hats, and dark pants. The background shows a snowy landscape with trees and a road above. The photo is taken from a perspective looking upwards, creating a unique and slightly distorted view of the group and their surroundings. The dominant color is blue, from the sky reflected on the road surface.

nurlan/104.jpg.description: A top-down view of three people standing near a ski lift and a snowy mountain landscape. The individuals are dressed in winter clothing, including jackets and hats. A sign and some equipment are visible near the lift's support structure. The sky is a clear, vibrant blue, and the ground is covered in snow and patches of rock. A warning sign is visible in the lower left corner.

nurlan/105.jpg.description: A group of four people are seated at a table in what appears to be a fancy restaurant. They are all dressed up, likely for a special occasion. Three of them are looking towards the camera, while one woman is looking off to the side. Wine glasses are visible on the table, suggesting a celebratory or formal dining experience. The restaurant has ornate decor, including chandeliers and detailed molding.

nurlan/106.jpg.description: A group portrait of three young adults dressed in formal attire, likely attending a special event. The woman in the center wears a dark dress and glasses, flanked by two men in suits. The background is a lush, green forest with tall trees, suggesting an outdoor setting. The man on the left has a small pin or medal on his lapel.

nurlan/107.jpg.description: Two young women pose for a playful photo outdoors, likely at a public space with a grand architectural structure in the background. The woman on the left wears a floral dress and makes a puckered face, while the woman on the right, in a blue striped dress, playfully attempts to kiss her cheek. Both are wearing necklaces and appear to be enjoying a lighthearted moment.

nurlan/108.jpg.description: A group of four people are seated at a table, likely in a restaurant, with wine glasses in front of them. The person closest to the camera is a young man in a vest and tie, winking at the camera. Behind him are two women and another man, all appearing to be enjoying a social gathering. The restaurant has ornate decor, including chandeliers and decorative columns.

nurlan/109.jpg.description: A top-down view of a table setting with two young men in suits and ties, seemingly enjoying a meal. One is holding a small figurine, while the other is looking up with a smile. The table is covered in food remnants, including what appears to be cake and various dishes. Wine glasses and a silver serving dome are also visible. The background shows ornate gold-framed mirrors and decorative columns.

nurlan/11.jpg.description: A group of four people posing for a photo outdoors. From left to right, a young man in a yellow jacket and dark pants with blue sneakers, an older woman in a red patterned top, another older woman in a light-colored patterned shirt and white pants with light-colored shoes, and a young man in a green shirt and dark pants with blue sneakers. They are standing in front of a decorative metal and brick structure, possibly a building entrance or a garden feature. The young men are looking towards the camera, while the women are looking slightly off-camera.

nurlan/110.jpg.description: A blurry image shows a person, likely a young boy, in a dynamic pose resembling a boxing punch. He's wearing a red shirt and gray pants, and appears to be near a wooden chair and a patterned rug. The background includes ornate wallpaper.

nurlan/111.jpg.description: A young boy is reclining on a chair, looking towards the camera with a relaxed expression. He is wearing a red t-shirt and dark pants. A mobile phone is held near his face, seemingly in a recording or selfie position. The background shows a room with patterned wallpaper and a drying rack with clothes.

nurlan/112.jpg.description: A quirky selfie taken from a low angle inside what appears to be a bus or train. Two people are positioned with their heads close together, looking down at the camera. One person is wearing a patterned reddish-brown shirt, while the other is in a blue shirt. The background shows parts of the vehicle's interior, including seats, overhead compartments, and a window with greenery visible outside.

nurlan/113.jpg.description: A view from inside a vehicle driving on a highway approaching a tunnel. Several workers in orange vests are present on the roadside, seemingly engaged in road work or maintenance near the tunnel entrance. Orange traffic cones are placed to delineate the work area. Vehicles are visible on the road, including a black SUV with a spare tire mounted on the back and a white car. A concrete barrier lines the side of the road.

nurlan/114.jpg.description: A striking photograph captures a vibrant sunset viewed through the silhouetted branches of bare trees. The sky is ablaze with shades of orange, red, and pink, creating a dramatic contrast against the dark, intricate network of branches. A rooftop is visible in the foreground, grounding the scene. The overall effect is one of stark beauty and atmospheric intensity.

nurlan/115.jpg.description: A pair of Air Jordan 3 Retro sneakers in a white and black color scheme. The shoes feature a white leather upper with black accents on the sole, toe, and heel. They have white laces and the iconic Jumpman logo on the side. The original hangtag is still attached.

nurlan/116.jpg.description: A close-up shot shows two waffle cones filled with white cream and decorated with small, colorful sprinkles. One cone appears to have a single black sprinkle resembling an eye. The cones are held in a hand, and additional cones are visible in the background, resting on a patterned surface.

nurlan/117.jpg.description: A unique perspective shot taken from underneath a structure, showing five people seemingly 'walking' upside down. They are wearing dark jackets and hats, with their feet visible against a backdrop of a snowy, mountainous landscape. The structure above consists of horizontal beams, creating a grid-like pattern. Metal railings are visible on either side, suggesting a bridge or walkway.

nurlan/118.jpg.description: A heartwarming photo shows a man lying on the floor with a young boy resting on his chest and a baby being held by the boy. The man is wearing a burgundy shirt and jeans, while the boy is in an orange shirt and dark pants with socks. The baby is wearing a white outfit and appears to be looking at the camera. They are all positioned on a wooden floor with a rug visible in the corner and a cabinet in the background. The scene conveys a sense of love, family, and playful interaction.

nurlan/119.jpg.description: A candid shot of a couple seemingly caught in a playful moment during an outdoor event. A man in a dark suit is playfully lifting a woman with a long, curly hairstyle, also dressed in a dark outfit. Another man in a blue suit and sunglasses stands to the side, observing. The scene takes place on a grassy area surrounded by tall trees, suggesting a park or garden setting.

nurlan/12.jpg.description: Two young women in school uniforms are sitting on a bright blue couch. One is lying down and appears to be sleeping, while the other is sitting upright and looking at her phone. They both wear white shirts, navy skirts, and red ties. The setting appears to be indoors, near a window.

nurlan/120.jpg.description: A group of three young people, two women and a man, are posing for a selfie in what appears to be a formal event or venue. The woman on the left is wearing a white dress with delicate detailing, while the woman in the center is in a vibrant red dress. The man on the right is dressed in a dark suit vest and a white shirt. A fourth person in a suit is partially visible in the background. The setting features ornate decor, including a large, decorative chandelier and detailed molding on the walls and ceiling.

nurlan/121.jpg.description: Two young men in suits are inside a vehicle, likely a van or SUV, with one driving and the other appearing to be in thought. The driver is looking forward, while the passenger is resting his chin on his hand and looking off to the side. Both are wearing suits and ties, suggesting a professional setting or event. The interior of the vehicle is visible, including the steering wheel and dashboard. The background shows greenery reflected in the side mirror.

nurlan/122.jpg.description: A young man dressed in a grey patterned suit and black shirt is seated inside a black vehicle, possibly a car or SUV. He is looking off to the side with a serious expression. The photo is taken from a slightly low angle, emphasizing the interior of the vehicle and the man's attire.

nurlan/123.jpg.description: Four women posing for a selfie at an event. The woman on the left is wearing a black outfit with a floral print jacket and black sandals. The woman second from the left is wearing black pants and a black top, and is holding a phone. The woman second from the right is wearing a teal dress and heels. The woman on the right is wearing a pink and gold patterned dress and pink heels. They are in a room with ornate decor, including a chandelier and floral arrangements.

nurlan/124.jpg.description: A photograph features three Asian men dressed in formal attire, likely at an event or gathering. The man on the left wears a navy blue plaid suit with a light purple shirt and a patterned vest. The man in the center is in a black suit with a red tie and a subtle patterned pocket square. The man on the right is wearing a black suit with a patterned shirt and a slight smile. They are positioned close together, with a cityscape and mountains visible in the background under a cloudy sky. The lighting suggests an outdoor setting, possibly a rooftop or balcony.

nurlan/125.jpg.description: Two elderly individuals, a man and a woman, are walking on a snow-covered sidewalk in front of a building. The man is wearing a black puffer jacket with a light-colored sweater underneath and a dark cap, while the woman is wearing a black coat and a patterned headscarf. She is also using a walking stick and carrying a brown handbag. Snowflakes are visible in the air.
