The building behind them appears to be a dental clinic or related healthcare facility, judging by the tooth imagery on the signage.

nurlan/126.jpg.description: A collection of four laminated postcards, likely souvenirs from Thailand. Three of the postcards feature images of people seemingly floating or lying in turquoise water, with one person wearing red shorts and another wearing black shorts. The fourth postcard features a logo for 'Similan Islands' and a picture of a boat with people on it, set against a backdrop of buildings and a harbor. All postcards have a textured, speckled border and the word 'Thailand' printed on them.

nurlan/127.jpg.description: A photograph of three Asian men dressed in formal attire, posing for a picture outdoors. The man in the center wears a black suit with a red tie and a vest, while the man on the left is in a navy blue suit with a brown vest and a white shirt. The man on the right is wearing a black suit with a black tie. They are standing in front of a cityscape with mountains in the background, likely on a rooftop or balcony. The lighting is somewhat overcast.

nurlan/128.jpg.description: A group of students in graduation gowns and caps stand on steps in front of a building, with a woman in a light-colored dress positioned in front of them. The students are holding diplomas or certificates. A banner behind them reads "ВЫПУСКНИК" (Graduates) and mentions "Назарбаев интеллектуальные школы" (Nazarbayev Intellectual Schools). The scene appears to be a graduation ceremony or photo opportunity.

nurlan/129.jpg.description: A group of people are gathered outdoors, likely at a graduation ceremony. Two women in light-colored dresses are in the foreground, with a young man in a graduation gown and cap standing to the right. Other graduates in gowns and caps are visible in the background, walking on a red carpet. A banner with the word "ВЫПУСКНИК" (meaning "graduate" in Russian) is visible in the background, along with a building with orange and white facade. The scene appears bright and sunny.

nurlan/13.jpg.description: Two young people, likely students, are posing for a photo while lying on a colorful rug. They are both wearing school uniforms consisting of navy blue blazers, white shirts, striped ties, and black pants. They are both smiling and appear to be having fun. The rug has a vibrant, abstract design with orange, black, and white colors. One person is positioned above the other, creating a stacked effect.

nurlan/130.jpg.description: Two young women wearing graduation caps and gowns pose for a photo. They are both wearing black gowns with bright green trim and matching caps. The woman on the left is making a peace sign with her hand, while the woman on the right has her hands clasped in her lap and is looking directly at the camera. Several other graduates are visible in the background, also wearing caps and gowns. The setting appears to be an outdoor graduation ceremony.

nurlan/131.jpg.description: A group of young men, likely students, are seated and looking forward, wearing graduation gowns and caps with a bright green trim. The focus is on the three in the front row, with the central figure looking directly at the camera with a serious expression. The background shows other graduates and blue and white structures, suggesting an outdoor graduation ceremony.

The bowling alley is brightly lit with blue and red lighting, and features electronic scoreboards above the lanes. Bowling balls are visible near the lanes and on the floor.

nurlan/205.jpg.description: A photo shows three people posing next to a large, cartoonish statue of a chef holding a platter of food. The chef statue is wearing a chef's hat and a green and white outfit. On the left is a woman wearing a grey jacket and black shoes, looking slightly to the side. In the center is a young man with dark hair, wearing a red shirt and grey pants, partially obscured by the statue. On the right is a woman wearing a black and white striped dress. The background shows a building with a window displaying food items, likely a restaurant. The photo appears to be taken outdoors during dusk or evening.

nurlan/206.jpg.description: A man is interacting with an elephant, seemingly offering it food or a gentle touch. The elephant is large and appears to be enjoying the interaction, with its trunk reaching towards the man. Another man is standing nearby, observing. The scene takes place outdoors on a sunny day, with trees and a paved walkway visible.

nurlan/207.jpg.description: A man is leaning over a railing to interact with an elephant at a zoo or sanctuary. Another elephant is visible behind him, and people are observing. The scene is outdoors with a bright blue sky and trees overhead.

nurlan/208.jpg.description: A candid selfie taken at what appears to be a cultural event or performance. Three older women are in the foreground, smiling and looking towards the camera, with a large audience visible in the background. The women are wearing various head coverings and jackets. A man in traditional attire is visible in the background, seated in the upper rows. The setting is a theater or concert hall with a dark wood interior and recessed lighting.

nurlan/209.jpg.description: A man is interacting with a large elephant, appearing to touch its side. The man is wearing shorts and sandals and is standing next to a wooden structure. The elephant is a grey color with wrinkled skin and a long trunk. The background includes trees and a clear blue sky.

nurlan/21.jpg.description: A group of eight people, likely a family, posing for a photo outdoors. The group consists of several generations, including elderly individuals and a young boy. They are standing in front of a building with a brick facade and a decorative metal structure. The people are dressed in casual clothing, with a mix of colors and patterns. The overall atmosphere appears warm and friendly.

nurlan/210.jpg.description: A unique perspective of a landscape featuring a vibrant blue sky reflected in a body of water, with lush green vegetation and buildings on either side. The reflection creates a symmetrical, almost mirrored effect, blending the natural and built environments.

nurlan/211.jpg.description: A young man sits cross-legged on a wooden chair, appearing to be meditating or in a relaxed pose. He is framed by a unique structure of interwoven dark branches, creating a circular, almost nest-like effect around him. The background shows a beautiful landscape with water, mountains, and a clear blue sky. The photo is taken from a low angle, looking up at the man, which emphasizes the surrounding structure and the scenic backdrop.

nurlan/212.jpg.description: A unique low-angle shot features a young man resting inside a structure built from closely packed, vertical wooden poles. He's wearing a white t-shirt and patterned shorts, with his arms resting along his sides. The perspective is unusual, with the sky and a glimpse of a body of water visible through the gaps in the wooden structure. A small tree branch with green leaves is in the lower left corner, adding a natural element to the scene. The overall effect is quirky and playful.

nurlan/213.jpg.description: A man is lying down and posing within a large, circular structure made of woven branches, resembling a nest or a whimsical frame. He's wearing a white shirt, a baseball cap, and jeans, and appears to be looking at a phone. The structure is positioned in front of a scenic outdoor backdrop with mountains and a bright blue sky. The photo is taken from a low angle, looking up into the woven structure.

nurlan/214.jpg.description: A man and a younger person are lying on a wooden structure, seemingly a platform or bench, framed by twisted branches overhead. The older man is wearing a white shirt and a baseball cap, looking directly at the camera. The younger person is wearing a white t-shirt and patterned shorts, also looking at the camera, and is holding a phone. The background shows a glimpse of water and distant hills, suggesting an outdoor setting.

nurlan/215.jpg.description: A unique perspective shot of a young man meditating or posing in a lotus position. He is seated within a circular structure made of woven branches, framing a view of a lake and mountains. The image is taken from a low angle, looking up through the branches, creating a distorted, almost tunnel-like effect. The man is wearing a white t-shirt and shorts, and appears calm and centered.

nurlan/216.jpg.description: A serene seascape featuring a calm, turquoise sea with several small, lush islands dotting the horizon under a vibrant blue sky with scattered clouds. A weathered wooden post stands prominently in the foreground, partially submerged in the water, adding a sense of depth and perspective to the scene. The islands are covered in dense vegetation and rise dramatically from the water, creating a picturesque and tranquil atmosphere.

nurlan/217.jpg.description: A young man is sitting cross-legged in front of a unique art installation. The installation consists of a circular frame constructed from woven branches, framing a view of a mountainous landscape and water. The man is wearing a white t-shirt and patterned shorts, and is positioned in a meditative pose. The structure appears to be built around a bench or platform.

nurlan/218.jpg.description: A selfie featuring two people, a man and a child, with a scenic backdrop of a mountainous landscape and a light-colored railing. The man is wearing a white t-shirt and looking at the camera, while the child is wearing a hat and also looking towards the camera. The lighting suggests it's a bright, sunny day.

nurlan/219.jpg.description: A young man sits on a wooden bench framed by a woven branch structure, looking at a stunning landscape of mountains reflected in calm water. He's wearing a white t-shirt and plaid shorts. The woven frame creates a natural, artistic border around the view, enhancing the scenic beauty.

nurlan/22.jpg.description: A young man stands on a white sandy beach next to clear turquoise water, holding a pair of snorkeling gear. He is wearing black swim trunks and is looking towards the camera with a slight smile. The bright sunlight casts a long shadow beside him. The image is taken from a high, almost directly overhead perspective.

nurlan/220.jpg.description: Two men are relaxing on a wooden boat, likely during a scenic tour. The man in the foreground is wearing a white t-shirt and sandals, looking towards the camera. The man in the background is lying down, wearing a polo shirt, shorts, and a baseball cap, and is holding a water bottle. Behind them are large, rocky mountains and a calm, blue body of water. The boat appears to be traditional with ropes visible along the side.

nurlan/221.jpg.description: A candid, slightly tilted full-body shot features two individuals – a younger man and an older man – standing close together. The younger man, positioned at the top of the frame, is wearing a white oversized t-shirt with a small logo, dark shorts, and a crossbody bag. He has a serious expression and is looking directly at the camera. The older man, positioned below, is wearing a white polo shirt with a logo, dark pants, and black sandals. He is looking towards the camera with a slight smile. The background consists of a red, white, and blue decorative element and a metal and wood structure, suggesting an outdoor or semi-outdoor setting.

nurlan/222.jpg.description: A high-angle shot captures a person standing behind a cascading waterfall, framed by steep, rocky cliffs. The water flows down a narrow channel between the rocks, creating a dynamic and powerful scene. Sunlight illuminates parts of the rocks and the falling water, creating a contrast between light and shadow. The person appears small in comparison to the natural surroundings, emphasizing the scale of the landscape.

nurlan/223.jpg.description: A high-angle shot captures a person standing near a cascading waterfall, seemingly within a rocky gorge. The water flows down a steep, uneven rock face, creating multiple streams and a misty effect. The person is positioned between the rocks and the falling water, with one arm raised. The surrounding rocks are varied in color and texture, ranging from dark brown to light tan. Vegetation is visible at the top left corner of the frame.

nurlan/224.jpg.description: A person lies on a wooden platform framed by woven branches, gazing upwards at a stunning landscape of karst mountains reflected in calm water under a blue sky with fluffy clouds. The platform appears to be a unique viewing point, offering a framed perspective of the natural beauty. The person is wearing a white shirt and plaid shorts, and is holding a phone.

nurlan/225.jpg.description: A person is standing on a slanted wooden surface, reaching up to touch a rocking horse attached to the ceiling. The ceiling is decorated with various toys and objects. The room appears to be an indoor play area or a uniquely designed space with a playful aesthetic.

nurlan/226.jpg.description: A man sits cross-legged on a wooden platform, seemingly enjoying a scenic view. He's framed by a unique structure – a woven, twig-like archway on the left and wooden planks on the right. The view beyond is a stunning reflection of mountains and greenery in calm water, creating a symmetrical and captivating scene. The man is wearing a white t-shirt and patterned shorts, and appears relaxed and contemplative.

nurlan/227.jpg.description: Three young men are posing for a photo outdoors, seemingly at a scenic overlook. Two are leaning against a railing, while the third is positioned in front, looking at the camera. They are dressed casually in shorts and t-shirts, and some are wearing hats. The background features a bright blue sky and a landscape with islands or hills visible in the distance, possibly a bay or coastline. The railing is red and the ground is tiled.

nurlan/228.jpg.description: Two men are posing for a photo outdoors with a scenic backdrop of mountains and water. The man on top is lying down, leaning on a railing, wearing a pink shirt and patterned shorts. The man below is standing, wearing a white shirt and grey pants, and a cap. Both appear to be enjoying a sunny day with a clear blue sky.

nurlan/229.jpg.description: A person is seen kneeling and looking at their hands, framed by a unique structure made of woven branches and a wooden slat background. The background reveals a scenic view of mountains reflected in water under a cloudy blue sky. The person is wearing a white shirt and plaid shorts, and their bare feet are visible. The framing structure creates a natural, almost nest-like effect around the view.

nurlan/23.jpg.description: A person is partially submerged in a clear, turquoise pool, looking up towards the camera. They are wearing swim goggles and a swimsuit, with their legs visible underwater. The edge of the pool is visible on the left, and a clear blue sky forms the background.

nurlan/230.jpg.description: A group of four people – a young boy in front, an older man, and two younger men – are posing for a photo in front of a distinctive building with a pagoda-like roof. The building is a mix of modern and traditional architectural styles, with a light-colored facade and dark accents. The sky is blue with fluffy white clouds. The people are dressed casually, with jeans, t-shirts, and caps. They are standing on a brick-paved walkway.

nurlan/231.jpg.description: A group selfie featuring a woman in the foreground with three young people behind her. The woman is wearing glasses and a white shirt with a black patterned design. The three young people are wearing light blue t-shirts and caps. They are standing outdoors in front of a modern building with sculptures of animals, including a lion and a horse, visible in the background. The grass is green and well-maintained.

nurlan/232.jpg.description: A woman stands outdoors in a white outfit, consisting of a white shirt and pants, paired with a dark green crossbody bag and gold-toned shoes. She is positioned in front of a tall, ornate building with a distinctive pagoda-style roof, featuring a mix of white and blue architectural details. The scene is bathed in bright sunlight, casting shadows on the paved walkway and surrounding greenery. A black car is partially visible to the right.

nurlan/233.jpg.description: A close-up photo of a couple, a woman and a man, looking towards the camera. The woman is on the left, wearing a white shirt with a musical note design and glasses. The man is on the right, wearing a blue checkered shirt and glasses. They are indoors, with a large window behind them showing a blue sky with clouds and a cityscape in the distance. The architecture suggests they are in a modern building, possibly a tower or observation deck.

nurlan/234.jpg.description: A family of four – a grandfather, grandmother, father, and son – are posing for a photo outdoors in front of a building and a street. The grandfather is wearing a light blue shirt, black pants, and black shoes. The grandmother is wearing a white outfit with a patterned gray bag and white shoes. The son is wearing a white t-shirt, gray shorts, and white sneakers. The father is wearing a light gray t-shirt, dark shorts, and white sneakers. Behind them is a building with a modern design, a street with cars, and a flag-like structure in the distance. The sky is clear and blue.

nurlan/235.jpg.description: A young boy is performing a handstand in a bathroom, with his feet resting against a door and his hands on the floor near a toilet and sink. The bathroom has a patterned tile floor and walls, and a small pink stuffed animal is visible on a shelf.

nurlan/236.jpg.description: Two young men stand indoors, posing near a large window with a cityscape view. The man on the left wears a navy blue sweater and dark jeans, while the man on the right wears a black AC/DC t-shirt, a crossbody bag, and light-wash jeans with white sneakers. Both have their arms crossed and are looking towards the camera. Potted plants flank either side of the frame, and the window offers a view of buildings, greenery, and a partly cloudy sky.

nurlan/237.jpg.description: Two young men stand indoors, looking out a large window with a cityscape visible in the background. The man on the left wears a light blue t-shirt and a black cap, while the one on the right wears a white t-shirt. The window frame is prominent, creating a frame around the scene. The cityscape appears to be in Astana, Kazakhstan, featuring a large park and modern buildings.

nurlan/238.jpg.description: A smiling person with short dark hair is posing indoors, raising one arm in a playful gesture. They are wearing a white t-shirt and appear to be in a modern building with large windows and plants. The background shows a bright, airy space with architectural details and a glimpse of a cityscape outside.

nurlan/239.jpg.description: A group of people, including adults and children, are gathered around and in a swimming pool. Some are partially submerged in the water, while others are sitting on the edge. The pool appears to be indoors, with a beach-themed mural on the wall behind them. Several people are smiling and looking at the camera. One man is sitting on the edge with a pink towel, while others are enjoying the water.

nurlan/24.jpg.description: A man is partially submerged in a clear, turquoise-colored infinity pool. He is wearing blue swim trunks and appears to be resting his arms on the edge of the pool, looking downwards. The water is very clear, and the sky is a bright blue. The perspective is from directly above, creating a unique view of the pool and the man.

nurlan/240.jpg.description: A group of four people – two women and two men – are taking a selfie at an event with a large disco ball in the background. The woman in the front left is smiling at the camera, as is the woman on the right, who has red lighting illuminating her face. The man behind them is wearing glasses and a dark jacket. A young boy is also in the foreground, looking directly at the camera with a more serious expression. The background shows a crowd of people enjoying the event.

nurlan/241.jpg.description: A photo of an elderly couple standing indoors, seemingly in a high-rise building with large windows offering a panoramic city view. The man on the left is wearing a blue button-down shirt, black pants, and glasses. The woman on the right is wearing a white t-shirt, white pants, and a crossbody bag. Both are looking towards the camera with gentle smiles. The building has a modern interior with marble floors and metal railings. The cityscape visible through the windows appears to be a mix of modern and older buildings, with a bright, sunny sky.

nurlan/242.jpg.description: A couple stands in front of the Baiterek Tower in Astana (now Nur-Sultan), Kazakhstan. The man is wearing a blue checkered shirt and dark pants, while the woman is dressed in white. They are standing on a brick-paved pathway lined with trees, with the distinctive tower rising in the background under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.

nurlan/243.jpg.description: Two young men are posing for a photo indoors, seemingly from a high vantage point, with a cityscape visible through a large window behind them. The man on the left is wearing a light blue t-shirt and a black cap, while the man on the right is wearing a white t-shirt. They both appear to be looking directly at the camera. The background shows a park, buildings, and a clear sky.

nurlan/244.jpg.description: A person is leaning against a red wall, appearing to be looking up at a large, decorative spaceship model themed after the movie 'Lightyear'. The spaceship is orange and white with '96' prominently displayed, and features 'Lightyear' logos. The wall is a dark red color and has a slightly textured surface. The person is wearing a black jacket and pants, with a white shirt underneath, and black shoes. A small black bag is on the floor in the foreground.

nurlan/245.jpg.description: Two young men are posing indoors, seemingly in a high-rise building with a large window offering a view of a city. The man on the left is wearing a light blue t-shirt, a black cap, and black pants with red and white sneakers. He's leaning against a marble-like surface. The man on the right is wearing a white t-shirt with a small logo, black pants, and black sneakers, and is holding a white tote bag with a wooden handle. A large potted plant is visible to the right of the second man. The background shows a cityscape with multiple buildings and a cloudy sky.

nurlan/246.jpg.description: A woman stands indoors, near a large window with a panoramic view of a city. She is wearing a grey t-shirt, white pants, and light-colored shoes, with a black shoulder bag. The window frames a cityscape with modern buildings and a distinctive dome-shaped structure in the distance. Potted plants flank either side of her, adding a touch of greenery to the scene. The interior features a white ledge and a modern architectural design.

nurlan/247.jpg.description: Two young men are walking along a paved path lined with trees, with a distinctive, modern tower visible in the background under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. The man in the foreground is wearing a black t-shirt with yellow lettering, light-wash jeans, and white sneakers, and is carrying a white plastic bag. The other man is wearing a light blue t-shirt and jeans, also with sneakers. The scene appears to be outdoors on a sunny day.

nurlan/248.jpg.description: A man stands on a paved walkway in a park, with a distinctive architectural structure in the background. The structure appears to be the Baiterek Tower in Nur-Sultan (Astana), Kazakhstan, characterized by its tall, slender white tower and large golden sphere at the top. The man is wearing a blue checkered shirt, jeans, and dark shoes, and is holding a water bottle. The park is lined with trees and has modern streetlights. The sky is blue with a few white clouds.

nurlan/249.jpg.description: A close-up selfie featuring two people, a man and a woman, outdoors on a sunny day. The woman is in the foreground, wearing sunglasses and a white shirt with a patterned scarf. The man is slightly blurred in the background, wearing glasses and a blue checkered shirt. Modern buildings and greenery are visible in the background, suggesting an urban setting.

nurlan/25.jpg.description: A high-angle shot shows a beach scene with people and equipment, likely a film or photo shoot. The bright blue water contrasts with the sandy beach and lush greenery framing the shot. Several individuals are visible, some holding equipment like cameras and reflectors, while others appear to be actors or models. The composition is framed by overhanging branches and foliage, creating a natural border.

nurlan/250.jpg.description: A young man and an older woman stand on a brick pathway lined with trees, with a distinctive white, lattice-like tower in the background. The man is wearing a black AC/DC t-shirt, jeans, and white sneakers, and has a black bag slung across his chest. The woman is dressed in a white outfit, including pants and a jacket, and carries a black purse. Both are looking towards the camera. The sky is blue with fluffy white clouds.

nurlan/251.jpg.description: A close-up selfie featuring a woman with short dark hair and sunglasses, partially obscuring two other individuals. To her left is a man drinking from a water bottle, wearing glasses and a checkered shirt. To her right is a young boy in a white shirt. Behind them is a modern building with the word "QAZAQSTAN" vertically displayed on its side. The sky is bright blue with fluffy clouds. The scene appears to be outdoors, possibly in a park or urban area with greenery.

nurlan/252.jpg.description: Two young people are posing next to a large, cylindrical Coca-Cola Zero Sugar promotional display designed to look like a rocket or space vessel. The display is pink and purple with the Coca-Cola logo and the word "Intergalactic" on it. It's positioned in front of a large Ferris wheel and a modern architectural structure with a glass dome. The base of the display is made to resemble a rocky, dark surface. The boys are casually dressed and appear to be enjoying a day out.

nurlan/253.jpg.description: A blurry indoor shot shows a person kneeling near a circular light fixture, appearing to be interacting with it. Several children are scattered around the room, some standing and looking towards the person and light. The background features kitchen cabinets and chairs. The room has a light-colored floor and a slightly chaotic feel due to the motion blur.

nurlan/254.jpg.description: A photo shows two young people interacting with a promotional display for Coca-Cola Zero Sugar in front of a large Ferris wheel. One boy is crouching near a large, black, rock-like structure, while another boy stands to the right, extending his arm as if interacting with the display. The Coca-Cola display features the words "Intergalactic Coca-Cola Zero Sugar" and the Coca-Cola logo. The background includes a patterned brick walkway, a few people walking around, trees, and a modern building.

nurlan/255.jpg.description: Two young people are interacting with a pirate-themed photo booth setup. A boy is seated near a wooden cannon on a makeshift ship's deck, while another boy stands nearby, looking at the cannon. The backdrop depicts a stormy sea and a pirate ship. A skull and crossbones flag is visible above the ship's wheel. The setup includes wooden crates and a ship's wheel, creating an immersive pirate experience.

nurlan/256.jpg.description: A photo shows two older adults and a partial view of a third person in what appears to be an aquarium or exhibit with a marine theme. The woman on the left is wearing a patterned grey jacket, black pants, and light-colored sneakers, and is carrying a white shopping bag with Korean text. The man next to her is dressed in a dark blue short-sleeved shirt and black pants. They are both looking forward, seemingly engaged in a conversation or observing something. The background features a large, sculpted depiction of a whale and a dark blue carpet with a speckled pattern. A partial view of a person wearing a red shirt is visible on the right side of the frame.

nurlan/257.jpg.description: Two young people pose in front of a large, black, sculpted camera resembling a Nikon. The camera is a landmark or art installation, with the word 'Nikon' prominently displayed on its body and 'ailand' on the top. The boy on the left is standing and wearing a light blue shirt and black sneakers, while the other boy is seated inside the camera's 'lens' area, looking towards the camera. The background shows a park-like setting with greenery and other people in the distance.

nurlan/258.jpg.description: A photo taken in Istanbul, Turkey, featuring a couple posing in front of the Hagia Sophia. The man is wearing a white button-down shirt and black pants with white sneakers, while the woman is wearing a cropped top and a light pink cardigan with similar pants and shoes. Several tourists are visible in the background, along with palm trees and the iconic architecture of the city.

nurlan/259.jpg.description: A ginger and white cat is lounging comfortably on a slatted wooden surface, likely a bench or railing, with its belly exposed. The cat is stretched out, appearing very relaxed and content. The background shows a metal railing and a blurred view of greenery and a person. The surface the cat is on is gray and appears to be concrete.

nurlan/26.jpg.description: An aerial view shows a person snorkeling in incredibly clear, turquoise water near a rocky coastline. The water's surface is rippled, reflecting sunlight and creating a vibrant blue and teal color palette. A portion of a white inflatable boat or raft is visible in the lower right corner of the frame. The person is wearing snorkeling gear and appears to be exploring the underwater environment.

nurlan/260.jpg.description: A dimly lit photograph shows a statue of a figure, possibly a person or deity, standing on a square pedestal. The statue appears to be made of a dark, textured material, possibly stone or metal, and is illuminated by a green light that casts a long shadow. The background consists of columns and a textured floor, also bathed in green light. The overall atmosphere is mysterious and somewhat eerie.

nurlan/261.jpg.description: A dimly lit interior scene featuring ancient sculptures displayed on a dark platform. Large, cylindrical columns frame the display, and small spotlights illuminate the sculptures and the surrounding area. A person is visible in the background, adding a sense of scale. The scene evokes a museum or archaeological site at night.

nurlan/262.jpg.description: A full-body sculpture of a human figure, appearing to be made of bronze or a similar metal, stands on a dark, circular base. The figure is slender and appears to be male, with a somewhat elongated form. The surface of the sculpture is textured and rough, giving it a raw and organic feel. The lighting is dim and green-tinted, casting shadows and highlighting the sculpture's form. The sculpture is displayed within a brick-walled space, likely a museum or gallery.

nurlan/263.jpg.description: Two young men are standing in a grocery store aisle, smiling at the camera. The person in the foreground is wearing a black t-shirt with anime-style artwork and black shorts with white stripes. The person behind him is wearing a red t-shirt. The aisle is filled with cleaning supplies and various household items, including buckets and mops.

nurlan/264.jpg.description: A young boy is happily riding a small, orange pedal car in a paved outdoor area, likely at an amusement park. Several other people are visible in the background, some standing and talking, and others walking around. A colorful ride structure with orange and green elements is behind the boy. The ground is covered in brick-like paving stones. There are other pedal cars visible, one in the foreground.

nurlan/265.jpg.description: A nighttime view of the illuminated Süleymaniye Mosque in Istanbul, Turkey. The mosque is dramatically lit with warm tones, highlighting its architectural details and minarets. In the foreground, a water feature with green and blue lighting adds a dynamic element to the scene. People are visible around the base of the hill where the mosque is situated, suggesting a lively atmosphere. The dark sky emphasizes the glow of the building and water features.

nurlan/266.jpg.description: Two people stand in front of a beautifully illuminated mosque at night. The mosque is bathed in red light, and a full moon is visible in the dark sky. The foreground features a paved walkway and landscaping with yellow flowers and palm trees.

nurlan/267.jpg.description: A stunning night view of a mosque illuminated in vibrant red light. The mosque features several tall minarets and a large central dome. A crescent moon is visible in the dark sky above. The foreground shows a garden with yellow flowers and a low fence, with people walking in the distance. The overall scene is dramatic and atmospheric.

nurlan/268.jpg.description: A stunning night view of a mosque, illuminated in a vibrant pink light, with its minarets reaching towards a dark sky where a crescent moon is visible. The scene is bustling with people below, suggesting a lively atmosphere. The architecture is intricate and beautiful, highlighted by the dramatic lighting.

nurlan/269.jpg.description: A woman stands in front of a brightly lit mosque at night. She is wearing a light pink t-shirt, a patterned blue and white jacket, and light-colored pants. She has a black shoulder bag. The mosque has several minarets illuminated in red and white. There are people walking in the background, some blurred due to the long exposure. The scene is set on a paved plaza with a metal fence separating the woman from the mosque.

nurlan/27.jpg.description: A stunning aerial view of a tropical beach. The image is split almost evenly between a vibrant turquoise sea and a lush green coastline. The water is incredibly clear, revealing the sandy seabed. A narrow strip of white sand separates the vegetation from the water. The sky is a deep, clear blue, creating a striking contrast with the colors below.

nurlan/270.jpg.description: A photo shows two men standing outdoors. The man on the left is older, wearing a blue collared shirt, gray pants, a white cap with a Jumpman logo, and blue sneakers. He is holding the hand of a younger man on the right. The younger man is wearing a black tank top and yellow plaid shorts, with sandals. Behind them is a red building with the words "BUSFOS" in white lettering. There are other people visible in the background, some seated. The photo appears to be taken on a sunny day.

nurlan/271.jpg.description: A woman is seated outdoors at a table, enjoying a peaceful moment. She is wearing a pink oversized shirt, a straw hat with a dark ribbon, and a watch. She is resting her arms on the armrests of a dark wicker chair. A cup and saucer sit on the table in front of her. The background is lush with greenery, including bushes and trees, and a glimpse of a building and power lines can be seen in the distance. The lighting suggests an overcast day.

nurlan/272.jpg.description: A woman is sitting outdoors, enjoying a drink from a white cup. She is wearing a pink shirt, grey pants, and a light-colored hat with a small logo. She is also wearing a smartwatch. The background features lush greenery, including a well-maintained lawn and various plants and trees. A black table with a blue surface is visible in the foreground, with a plate on it.

nurlan/273.jpg.description: A photo shows two men standing in front of a large, ornate building with a dome, likely a mosque in Istanbul, Turkey. The younger man on the left is wearing a tank top and plaid shorts, while the older man on the right is dressed in a button-down shirt and pants. Both appear to be looking towards the camera. There are other people walking in the background, and a decorative metal fence separates the walkway from the building. The ground is paved with brick.

nurlan/274.jpg.description: A woman walks down a narrow cobblestone street lined with white buildings. She is wearing a light pink sweater, grey pants, a straw hat, and a crossbody bag. The street is enclosed by high white walls with dark-framed windows, and a view of greenery is visible at the end of the path.

nurlan/275.jpg.description: A view from a ferry or boat, looking out over a calm, blue sea towards a distant coastline. The foreground shows wooden benches and a life preserver attached to a metal railing. A person wearing a white shirt is seated, facing away from the camera. The coastline features a low, concrete structure and a line of trees. The sky is a pale blue with a slight haze.

nurlan/276.jpg.description: A view from a boat, likely a ferry or tour boat, looking towards a coastline. The foreground shows the boat's railing, a life preserver, and the wake of the boat in the water. The background features a rocky coastline with buildings and trees, under a hazy, bright sky. The water is a deep blue with visible waves.

nurlan/277.jpg.description: Two women are seated on a red bench, likely on a ferry or boat, with a view of water and a distant structure (possibly a lighthouse or building) visible through a window. The woman on the left is older, wearing a striped shirt, light gray pants, and a straw hat. She is holding a black bag. The woman on the right is wearing a hijab and a tan jacket, also with light gray pants, and is holding a water bottle and some papers. Both appear to be looking forward.

nurlan/278.jpg.description: A photo of a couple standing in front of the Blue Mosque in Istanbul, Turkey. The man is wearing a blue checkered shirt, a white baseball cap, grey pants, and sunglasses. The woman is wearing a white top, a straw hat, a small crossbody bag, and a colorful patterned skirt. Both are looking towards the camera. There are many other tourists visible in the background, and trees frame the top of the image. The sky is clear and blue.

nurlan/279.jpg.description: A vibrant row of colorful buildings in what appears to be a historical district. The buildings are painted in bright shades of red, blue, and white, with traditional architectural details. A low wall with a decorative metal railing runs along the front, and a few traffic cones are visible in the foreground. The scene is bathed in bright sunlight, suggesting a clear day. There are signs in Turkish on the buildings.

nurlan/28.jpg.description: A high-angle view shows a person swimming in clear, turquoise water near a rocky cliff and the side of a boat. The swimmer is wearing a wetsuit and appears to be snorkeling or diving, with a snorkel visible. The water is a vibrant blue, contrasting with the gray rock face and the boat's white and gray exterior. The sun is shining, creating ripples and reflections on the water's surface.

nurlan/280.jpg.description: A couple stands in front of a spectacular fountain show at night. The fountain jets are illuminated in vibrant purple and pink hues, creating a dramatic backdrop. Behind them is a beautifully lit building with a dome and a tall spire, likely a historical landmark. The couple is dressed warmly, suggesting a cool evening. The man wears a dark jacket and glasses, while the woman has on a light pink sweater and a patterned coat. They appear to be enjoying the show.

nurlan/281.jpg.description: Three young men are posing for a photo in front of a large, ornate framed painting depicting a historical battle scene with soldiers on horseback. The men are seated on a green bench. The man on the left wears a light blue sweater and jeans, with a black jacket draped over his lap. The middle man wears a white t-shirt with the word "CLASSIC" printed on it and black pants. The man on the right wears a black puffer jacket and black pants. The painting dominates the background, featuring a dramatic scene of warriors and horses.

nurlan/282.jpg.description: A high-angle view of a beach scene with a vibrant blue sky and ocean. In the foreground, a red kayak rests on a wooden boardwalk alongside a blue kayak. Palm trees line the boardwalk, leading towards a beach dotted with sunbeds and umbrellas. In the distance, the waves of the ocean crash onto the shore. A sign for 'Marin Beach Hotel' is visible amidst the beachside amenities.

nurlan/283.jpg.description: A collage showcasing diverse scenes from Turkey. The top left image features a vibrant waterfront view with ornate boats and mosques. The top right shows the Galata Tower in Istanbul, with a distinctive conical roof and a white bird in the foreground. The bottom left displays a beautifully illuminated mosque at night, likely in Istanbul. Finally, the bottom right depicts a beach scene, possibly in Antalya or another coastal city, with sunbeds, umbrellas, and palm trees.

nurlan/284.jpg.description: A collage of images showcasing scenes from Istanbul, Turkey. The top left shows a couple walking in front of the Hagia Sophia and Sultan Ahmed Mosque (Blue Mosque). The top right displays a close-up of ornate, reddish-orange architectural details, possibly from a historical building. The bottom left features a detailed view of a column with intricate carvings and a shadow cast upon it. Finally, the bottom right shows a ginger cat lounging on a wooden bench.

nurlan/285.jpg.description: A young boy stands amidst lush greenery, looking up towards the camera. He is wearing a long-sleeved navy jacket over an orange t-shirt and light-colored shorts. The surrounding area is filled with dense vegetation, including trees and tall grasses, suggesting a forest or natural outdoor setting. The lighting is bright, with the sun visible through the trees.

nurlan/286.jpg.description: A calico cat is lounging on a wooden surface, seemingly mid-yawn or vocalizing. The cat has a striking coat of white, black, and orange fur. It appears relaxed and comfortable, with its eyes partially closed. The background shows a red corrugated metal wall and wooden slats.

nurlan/287.jpg.description: A young boy is crouching on a rocky, white surface with a mountainous landscape in the background. He is wearing a black hoodie with red accents, light-colored shorts, dark socks, and sandals. He's looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. The sky is overcast, and the landscape features green hills and rocky cliffs.

nurlan/288.jpg.description: A group of four young people, dressed in formal attire, are riding in the back of a vehicle. The person in the foreground, a young man, is taking a selfie. He's wearing a pinstripe suit with a light blue shirt and a patterned tie. Behind him are three others: a young man in a dark suit, a young woman in a floral print top, and another young woman with her hair pulled back. They appear to be on their way to or from an event.

nurlan/289.jpg.description: A German Shepherd lies resting on a patterned tile floor. The dog is mostly black with tan legs and appears to be sleeping or deeply relaxed, with its head down. The floor is composed of interlocking tiles in a floral or clover-like design, alternating between red and gray.

nurlan/29.jpg.description: A man sits cross-legged on a wooden bench, looking directly at the camera. He is wearing a white t-shirt and shorts. The photo is taken from a unique perspective, with a curved frame of branches surrounding the image and a distorted view of the sky and greenery in the background. The bench appears to be constructed from weathered wooden planks.

nurlan/290.jpg.description: A person is lying on a brightly colored seesaw in a park, looking up at the camera. They are wearing a black jacket and a black beanie with a face mask, partially obscuring their face. The seesaw is primarily yellow with blue and red supports. In the background, there are trees and a multi-story building under a clear blue sky.

nurlan/291.jpg.description: A calico cat is curled up and sleeping on a striped green and white cushion. The cushion is placed on a concrete surface next to wooden planks and a mat. The cat appears very comfortable and relaxed.

nurlan/292.jpg.description: A striking sunset scene featuring a silhouetted tree against a vibrant, layered sky. The clouds are a mix of deep reds, oranges, and yellows, creating a dramatic and fiery effect. Below, a dark landscape with hints of buildings and vegetation is visible, adding depth to the composition. The overall mood is one of peaceful intensity.

nurlan/293.jpg.description: A young boy is lying on the floor, holding an accordion. He is wearing a light-colored shirt, dark pants, and black shoes. A woman in a white dress is partially visible, lying next to him. The background includes a red and white decorative element and a white air conditioning unit.

nurlan/294.jpg.description: A calico cat is curled up and sleeping, resting its head on the wooden armrest of a chair. The cat has a beautiful coat of white, black, and orange fur. It appears very comfortable and peaceful.

nurlan/295.jpg.description: A couple is captured in a dynamic, celebratory moment, likely during a wedding or engagement party. The bride, in a flowing white gown, is leaning towards the groom who is in a suit. Confetti and bubbles fill the air around them, illuminated by vibrant purple and pink lighting. The scene appears to be indoors, with decorative elements visible around the couple, suggesting a festive atmosphere. The image is taken from a slightly overhead angle, adding to the sense of movement and excitement.

nurlan/296.jpg.description: A calico cat is lying on its side, seemingly asleep or very relaxed. It has a striking coat of white, black, and orange fur. The cat's paws are curled up towards its body, and it appears comfortable on a light blue textured surface, possibly a bed or cushion. A wooden structure is visible in the background.

nurlan/297.jpg.description: Two young boys are posing with a Roland AX-Synth keyboard. One boy is lying on his side, playfully holding up a small black object (possibly a phone or toy), while the other is seated at the keyboard, appearing to play or pose with it. The background includes a red rug and a white piece of furniture.

nurlan/298.jpg.description: A distorted, low-angle view of a person in a white dress, possibly a wedding dress, with intricate lace detailing on the bodice. The image is heavily affected by a purple and pink color cast, likely from lighting, and appears to be viewed through a warped or curved surface, creating a surreal and abstract effect. A person's face is visible, looking down towards the dress.

nurlan/299.jpg.description: A blurry, low-angle shot appears to show a person in a white shirt, possibly dancing or engaged in a performance, illuminated by purple and pink lighting. The image is somewhat obscured and lacks sharp focus, with other people and objects visible in the background. There's a sense of movement and energy, possibly within a club or event space.

nurlan/3.jpg.description: A woman wearing a straw hat and patterned shirt is kneeling in a field of vibrant red poppies. She is looking directly at the camera with a gentle expression. A wooden fence and lush greenery form the background under a clear blue sky.

nurlan/30.jpg.description: A close-up, overhead shot shows a crude drawing of a face in the sand. The face is formed by digging into the light-colored sand, creating dark lines and shapes to represent eyes, a nose, and a mouth. The sand is textured and grainy. A portion of a beach chair and blue water are visible in the lower left corner, and a shadow falls across the right side of the image.

nurlan/300.jpg.description: A child is enjoying a seesaw at a playground. The seesaw is brightly colored with blue, yellow, and red elements, designed to look like a smiling face. An adult is assisting the child, likely providing balance or guidance. Both are wearing winter clothing, suggesting a cool temperature. The playground surface appears to be a soft, rubberized material.

nurlan/301.jpg.description: A young boy is crouching in a wooded area, making a playful gesture with his hands near his eyes, as if mimicking binoculars or 'looking' at the camera. He's wearing a red t-shirt, a black jacket, and khaki shorts, with dark socks and shoes. The background is filled with lush green vegetation and trees, suggesting a natural outdoor setting.

nurlan/302.jpg.description: A group of three children are posing for a photo outdoors, likely in a wooded area. The child on the left is wearing a black and white jacket and a baseball cap. The child in the middle is wearing a black t-shirt with text and a red and black patterned skirt. The child on the right is wearing an orange long-sleeved shirt and grey pants. They all appear to be looking at the camera.

nurlan/303.jpg.description: A blurry, low-light image appears to show a small dog, possibly a puppy, with a dark coat and white markings around its muzzle. It seems to be interacting with a person, possibly receiving a treat or being held. The image is out of focus, making details difficult to discern, but the dog's eye is visible.

nurlan/304.jpg.description: Two silhouetted figures stand on a grassy hill against a soft, muted sky at dusk or dawn. They are posed with arms outstretched, appearing joyful and free. The foreground is filled with textured vegetation, and a distant horizon line suggests a rural or open landscape. The overall mood is peaceful and contemplative.

nurlan/305.jpg.description: Two people, likely students in school uniform, are lying down inside a wooden structure resembling a playhouse or a large, angled box. One person is lying on their back, looking up, and wearing a light blue face mask, a white shirt, and a dark vest. The other person is lying on their side, with their head near the first person's torso, wearing a white shirt, a dark skirt, and red and black striped socks. They are both inside a structure made of angled wooden planks, creating a geometric pattern around them. The lighting is somewhat dim, with sunlight filtering through the wooden slats.

nurlan/306.jpg.description: A top-down view of a person wearing a black suit and a white mask, appearing to be adjusting something in their jacket pocket. The lighting is pink and somewhat dim, with a window and a dark blue object visible in the background.

nurlan/307.jpg.description: A first-person view looking down as a person vacuums a patterned rug. The person is shirtless, wearing dark pants, and using a yellow and black vacuum cleaner with a long, flexible hose. A second person wearing a tan shirt and cap is visible in a mirror, seemingly assisting or observing. The scene takes place indoors, with white baseboards and a glimpse of a bed.

nurlan/308.jpg.description: A man is suspended in the air using a complex system of straps and inflatable supports. He is wearing shorts and appears to be undergoing some form of physical therapy or rehabilitation. The setup includes a yellow inflatable support and a black apparatus with straps, all connected to a frame or structure above. The scene takes place indoors, with a bed and furniture visible in the background.

nurlan/309.jpg.description: A low-angle shot shows a person, likely a child, partially obscured by the branches and apples of a tree. The person is wearing a patterned shirt, a pink headscarf, and appears to be reaching for or interacting with the apples. The view is from within the tree, looking upwards towards the apples and the person.

nurlan/31.jpg.description: A man is sitting cross-legged on a wooden platform, appearing to be in a meditative or relaxed pose. He is wearing a white t-shirt and patterned shorts. The photo is taken from a unique perspective, looking down at him while incorporating a distorted reflection of the sky and landscape within a curved, vine-like structure framing the image. The wooden platform is constructed of slats.

nurlan/310.jpg.description: A group of young men are indoors, seemingly having a playful moment. The person in the foreground is wearing a green shirt and has cream smeared all over their face, and is smiling widely at the camera. Several other men are visible in the background, some looking at the person with the cream, and one appears to be filming with a camera. There's a table with various items on it, and the room has a casual, lived-in feel.

nurlan/311.jpg.description: A young man in a black suit and tie walks through an art museum. The museum features a polished wooden floor, gray walls adorned with paintings, and sculptures displayed on pedestals. The ceiling is a grid of metal beams and lighting fixtures. The man is looking off to the side, creating a sense of contemplation or purpose as he navigates the space.

nurlan/312.jpg.description: A young man in a black suit and tie stands in an art gallery, looking towards the artwork. The gallery has a high, industrial-style ceiling with visible metal supports and track lighting. The walls are lined with paintings, and several sculptures are visible in the foreground. The floor is polished wood.

nurlan/313.jpg.description: A man in a black suit stands in an art museum, looking at a painting of a canal scene. The walls are a deep red color, and several other paintings and a bust are visible in the background. The ceiling is a modern grid with track lighting. The floor is polished wood.

nurlan/314.jpg.description: A man in a black suit and vest stands in front of two classical portrait paintings in a museum or art gallery. He has his hands on his hips and is looking slightly to the side. The wall is a deep red color, and the floor is made of wood. The paintings are framed in ornate gold and silver frames.

nurlan/315.jpg.description: Two young men in dark suits stand in front of a large, ornately framed oil painting depicting a chaotic battle scene with horses and figures in red. They are in a museum or art gallery, with polished wooden floors and neutral-colored walls. One of the men is wearing a backpack.

nurlan/316.jpg.description: An overhead shot shows two people assembling furniture, likely IKEA cabinets, in a room. The cabinets are a mix of white and teal colors. One person is standing and holding a piece of the cabinet frame, while the other is kneeling and working on the lower portion. A rug is visible on the floor, and a purse is resting on a nearby piece of furniture. The scene suggests a DIY project in progress.

nurlan/317.jpg.description: A person is lying inside a large, white, sculpted animal, possibly a whale or a similar marine creature. The sculpture appears to be an art installation in a park or outdoor space, with greenery and a modern building visible in the background. The person is looking at a phone and has a purse nearby.

nurlan/318.jpg.description: A low-angle shot shows a young boy enjoying a colorful spring rider at a playground. He's wearing a black beanie, a black and red jacket, and dark jeans. The spring rider is red, blue, and yellow, with handles he's gripping. The background includes a paved area and other playground equipment.

nurlan/319.jpg.description: A person is lying down, seemingly inside or under a large, white, sculpted structure resembling a boat or shell. They are wearing sunglasses and a white t-shirt with a graphic design, and a watch. The background includes a bright blue sky with fluffy clouds and lush green foliage. The perspective is from directly above, looking down at the person.

nurlan/32.jpg.description: A man is sitting in a meditative pose, legs crossed, with his hands resting on his knees. He is lying on a wooden pallet-like structure, framed by a circular structure made of woven branches and vines. The background shows a bright, sunny day with a glimpse of a building and a blue sky. The photo is taken from a unique perspective, looking down at the man from within the circular frame.

nurlan/320.jpg.description: A person is lying inside a large, white, sculpted form resembling a whale or other marine animal. They are looking upwards with their eyes closed, seemingly enjoying the unique perspective. The sculpture is positioned outdoors, with greenery and buildings visible in the background under a bright blue, cloudy sky. The perspective is from directly above, looking down into the sculpture.

nurlan/321.jpg.description: A person is lying underneath a large, white sculpture of a whale, looking up at the camera. The whale appears to be suspended or supported in a way that allows the person to comfortably lie beneath it. The background includes greenery, a modern building with a distinctive facade, and a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds. The person is wearing a light blue t-shirt and appears to be enjoying the unique art installation.

nurlan/322.jpg.description: A vibrant landscape featuring a steep mountainside covered in lush green vegetation and dark evergreen trees, contrasted against a clear, deep blue sky. A faint moon is visible in the lower left corner of the sky. The composition is split vertically, with the sky dominating the left side and the mountainside and vegetation on the right.

nurlan/323.jpg.description: A candid indoor shot shows a group of people gathered in a room, seemingly engaged in a casual activity. A woman in a lavender shirt is holding a bottle and spraying something, possibly hairspray or a similar product, towards another woman with glasses who is looking at her. A third person in a red shirt is looking up at the action. The room has a modern aesthetic with white cabinets, a patterned wall, and a decorative chandelier. A table with a patterned tablecloth is visible, and another person is partially visible in the lower left corner.

nurlan/324.jpg.description: A person is lying down and looking at a tablet, with a reflection in a mirror showing another person and a chandelier overhead. The person is wearing a lavender shirt and black shorts, and holding a colorful object in one hand. The scene appears to be indoors, possibly in a salon or waiting area.

nurlan/325.jpg.description: A blurry overhead shot shows a child lying on a surface, possibly a sidewalk or patio, with a black t-shirt that appears to have text on it. The child is wearing shorts and has a small object, possibly a toy or snack, in their hand. There's greenery and a vehicle visible in the background.

nurlan/326.jpg.description: A woman in a black t-shirt and shorts is holding a pink box decorated with flowers, seemingly presenting it to someone. Another person, partially visible, is looking up at her, wearing a pink shirt. They are standing outdoors in front of a building with greenery and parked cars.

nurlan/327.jpg.description: A high-angle shot shows a young boy interacting with a large, dark-colored sculpture of a bear. He is leaning over the bear, appearing to touch or pet its nose. The boy is wearing a white and gray hooded sweatshirt and blue jeans with black shoes. The sculpture is positioned on a red brick surface.

nurlan/328.jpg.description: Two young men in suits pose for a candid, slightly blurry photo with a vintage film aesthetic. The man in the foreground is looking towards the camera with a serious expression, while the man in the background is smiling and appears to be in motion. The photo has a warm, muted color palette and includes simulated film border markings.

nurlan/329.jpg.description: A nighttime scene shows a group of people relaxing around a campfire. The photo is taken from a high angle, looking down at the fire and the people surrounding it. Several individuals are lying or sitting near the fire, with their legs and feet visible. The fire is bright and central, with sparks flying upwards. The surrounding area is dark, emphasizing the warmth and light of the fire.

nurlan/33.jpg.description: A man sits cross-legged on a wooden platform, appearing to be meditating or in a relaxed pose. He is wearing a white t-shirt and patterned shorts. The photo is taken from a unique perspective, looking down at him with a distorted view of the landscape reflected in what appears to be a circular structure made of branches surrounding him. The background shows a hilly landscape with a blue sky and clouds.

nurlan/330.jpg.description: A young man dressed in a formal black suit, vest, and tie stands in a spacious art gallery. He is looking towards the artwork on the wall, with sculptures visible in the foreground. The gallery features a polished wooden floor and a grid-like ceiling with lighting fixtures. Paintings line the walls, creating a sophisticated and cultured atmosphere.

nurlan/331.jpg.description: A nighttime scene shows a group of people gathered around a crackling campfire. The photo is taken from a high angle, looking down at the group and the fire. Several individuals are lying or sitting around the fire, some wearing light-colored clothing. Sparks are flying from the fire, illuminating the surrounding darkness. The fire is contained within a stone or brick enclosure.

nurlan/332.jpg.description: A scenic outdoor shot featuring two green camping tents pitched on a grassy hill under a clear blue sky. A large evergreen tree stands to the right, partially casting a shadow over the tents. In the background, rolling hills are visible, and a person is seated on a bench near the tree. The scene evokes a sense of peacefulness and outdoor adventure.

nurlan/333.jpg.description: A person is taking a selfie next to a large, curved mural depicting a blue underwater scene with whales. The photo is taken from a low angle, making the mural appear to dominate the frame. The person is wearing a cap and looking towards the camera. The background shows a modern urban setting with buildings and pedestrian walkways.

nurlan/334.jpg.description: A family of four poses for a photo indoors, likely at a university or large public building. There are two men and two women. The taller man on the left wears a grey Columbia jacket and black pants, while the other man on the right wears a black shirt and dark pants. The two women are positioned between them. The woman in the middle wears a light-colored outfit and denim jacket, while the woman on the right is partially obscured. A large red heart-shaped decoration and a water feature are visible in the background, along with banners and a bright, open ceiling. A blue bag is visible on the floor.

nurlan/335.jpg.description: A group of three people – two men and a woman – are posing for a photo in a large, modern indoor space. The space features a high, grid-like ceiling with hanging banners and a large red heart-shaped sculpture with the letter 'I' in front of it. A shallow pool of water surrounds a white platform where the sculpture is placed. The people are dressed in casual clothing. The man on the left wears a navy jacket and black pants, the woman in the middle wears a denim jacket and light-colored pants, and the man on the right wears a black jacket and pants with white sneakers. A black bag is visible on the floor near the rightmost man.

nurlan/336.jpg.description: A person is posing with two bronze statues in front of a modern building. The statues are of athletes, dressed in athletic wear and holding items related to sports. The person is wearing a white t-shirt and shorts, and is leaning against the statues. The scene is outdoors on a sunny day with a clear blue sky. There's a small wooden structure with information on it to the right of the person.

nurlan/337.jpg.description: A group of four people are seated on a red bench in a brightly lit, modern lobby. The lobby features a high ceiling with a green and black color scheme, and a large, spherical chandelier. An 'EXIT' sign is visible above a doorway. The floor is a light-colored wood, and a small, white circular table sits in front of the bench.

nurlan/338.jpg.description: A top-down view of a group of people enjoying a meal, likely a casual gathering. Several hands are holding partially eaten sandwiches, appearing to be Vietnamese banh mi, with various fillings visible. There are also small dishes containing side items like carrot and radish pickles. The table is white and there are glimpses of clothing and other food items around the central focus of the sandwiches.

nurlan/339.jpg.description: Two young men are lying down, embracing in a tender moment. The person on the bottom is wearing a black shirt and black pants, while the person on top is wearing a white t-shirt. They appear to be resting or sleeping, with the top person's head resting on the other's chest. The background consists of a teal and blue surface, possibly a mat or gym floor.

nurlan/34.jpg.description: A slightly distorted, low-angle photo shows a man reflected multiple times in a shiny surface, likely a polished floor or a reflective wall. The man is wearing a dark shirt and what appears to be a red and black plaid jacket. The reflections create a repeating pattern of his face and upper body. The background is blurred and shows some lights and a pale surface.

nurlan/340.jpg.description: An overhead view shows two people in a waiting area. One person is lying down, partially on a maroon armchair and the floor, while the other is seated in a similar armchair, looking down. A red carpet runs along the floor. The room has light-colored walls and tiled flooring.

nurlan/341.jpg.description: An overhead, slightly distorted view shows three figures, likely action figures or dolls, arranged on a tiled floor. The figures are posed in dynamic positions, suggesting movement or interaction. The top figure wears a dark red shirt and shorts, and a black cap, and is leaning forward, appearing to be looking at the other two. The middle figure is lying down, wearing grey pants and a dark shirt with a harness. The bottom figure is lying down as well, wearing a light green shirt and red plaid pants. A digital clock in the upper left corner displays '05:20'. The scene is lit with a cool, slightly bluish tone.

nurlan/342.jpg.description: A group of young people are crammed inside what appears to be a tent or small enclosed space, taking a selfie. The lighting is dim, and the camera is angled upwards, capturing the faces of several individuals. Some are smiling and making peace signs, while others are looking directly at the camera. The space is defined by a teal-colored fabric overhead.

nurlan/343.jpg.description: A slightly distorted, overhead view shows a person looking up into a mirror. The mirror is framed with white molding and is positioned in what appears to be a dark-colored alcove or hallway. The person is wearing a black t-shirt and appears to be holding the mirror or adjusting its position. The reflection shows the person's face and upper body, with the background appearing dark and slightly blurred.

nurlan/344.jpg.description: A group of friends are gathered around a small, round table in a restaurant, enjoying a meal. Several bowls of noodles and small plates of food are visible on the table. Some individuals are eating with chopsticks, while others are looking at the camera. The restaurant has a modern interior with red and white accents, and a unique lighting system with white cables overhead. Some people are wearing masks.

nurlan/345.jpg.description: A young boy in a red vest, black beanie, and blue jeans is looking at and seemingly talking to a bronze statue of a sea lion. They are both standing on a paved area made of reddish-brown, irregularly shaped stones. The boy appears to be engaged with the statue, possibly telling it something. A bicycle is partially visible in the background.

nurlan/346.jpg.description: A person is taking a selfie in a mirror, partially obscured by a digital emoji overlay. The person is shirtless and wearing blue shorts, with another person in the background wearing a white t-shirt. The image is taken from a slightly overhead angle, showing the mirror framed within a white wall and a partially visible door.

nurlan/347.jpg.description: A brightly lit dorm room with three young men. One is holding a suit jacket and wearing shorts and a t-shirt, another is standing near a window in a white shirt and pants, and the third is bending over, adjusting something near a bed. The room has two beds, a desk, a shelf, and a patterned rug. A window shows a view of buildings outside.

nurlan/348.jpg.description: A slightly distorted, high-angle view shows a person lying on the floor, looking at a tablet. They are wearing a black t-shirt with the word "BOOM" printed on it. The floor is white and appears to be part of a hallway or entryway, with a decorative metal railing on the right and a partial view of a living room with a couch and various items scattered around in the background. The image has a somewhat unusual perspective, likely taken from a security camera or a very low angle.

nurlan/349.jpg.description: A top-down view of three people standing on a grassy area near a building. Two of the individuals are wearing backpacks, and all are wearing face masks. One person is wearing dark pants and black shoes, another is wearing a plaid shirt and dark pants, and the third is wearing a blue uniform with white shoes. The building has orange and white exterior walls.

nurlan/35.jpg.description: Two men in suits stand outdoors on a snowy, dimly lit street at night. One man wears a dark suit with a plaid shirt, while the other wears a reddish-brown suit with a similar plaid shirt. They appear to be engaged in conversation, with a slightly blurred background of streetlights, trees, and snow-covered surfaces.

nurlan/350.jpg.description: An overhead view shows two individuals dressed in what appears to be a formal uniform, likely for a ceremonial or official purpose. They are wearing white shirts with gold trim, black pants with gold detailing, and caps with visors. They are positioned on a light blue floor with a metal ladder structure in front of them. The background includes white walls and small windows.

nurlan/351.jpg.description: A unique perspective shot of a person walking towards the camera on a paved pathway, with a modern building and a blue sky with clouds in the background. The image is taken from a very low angle, creating a distorted, almost fisheye effect, making the building appear tilted.

nurlan/352.jpg.description: A young man is wearing a unique and humorous outfit. He has a large, pillow-like object shaped like a face with a mouth and eyes draped around his neck, seemingly as a fashion statement. He's also wearing a black robe-like garment with red and blue accents, and a white shirt underneath. A black scarf is wrapped around his neck, and he appears to be at an outdoor event, possibly a festival or performance, with a building and a tree visible in the background.

nurlan/353.jpg.description: A close-up shot of a young woman with dark hair, seemingly smiling or making a playful expression. She appears to be wearing a headband with heart-shaped decorations. The background is slightly blurred, suggesting an indoor setting.

nurlan/354.jpg.description: A group selfie taken at a restaurant, likely a pizza place, with three people making peace signs and smiling at the camera. The restaurant has a modern, industrial aesthetic with dark walls, exposed ductwork, and black furniture. Menus are visible on the table in front of them.

nurlan/355.jpg.description: A young boy is lying down next to a bronze statue of a bear, resting his head on the bear's snout. He is wearing a red vest over a grey shirt and blue jeans. The scene is outdoors on a paved area with a decorative pattern. The boy appears to be interacting with the statue in a playful manner.

nurlan/356.jpg.description: A praying mantis is perched on a person's hand. The mantis is a pale green color and its legs are visible as it walks across the skin. The background is a blurred green field, likely grass, illuminated by sunlight. The person's hand has neatly manicured nails.

nurlan/357.jpg.description: A person is climbing over a black metal fence next to a raised walkway or platform. The fence is constructed of horizontal and vertical bars. The ground around the fence is covered in leaves and grass. Tree branches are visible overhead, and the sky is bright.

nurlan/358.jpg.description: A group of four young people are taking a selfie inside a vehicle, likely a van or bus, judging by the interior. The camera is angled upwards, showing the ceiling of the vehicle with air vents and a window. The people are looking towards the camera, with varying expressions. One person is wearing a face mask. The person in the front is wearing a black and white checkered jacket.

nurlan/359.jpg.description: A group of young people are in a room with blue floors and white walls. The person in the foreground is wearing glasses and a black shirt, looking directly at the camera. Behind them is a person in a white shirt, and another person is lying down on the right side of the frame. There are pictures and decorations on the wall. A window is visible on the left.

nurlan/36.jpg.description: A playful, first-person perspective shot of a person dressed in a quirky, vintage-inspired outfit. They are wearing a dark cap, glasses, a white shirt, black suspenders, and a bow tie, with a paper mustache adhered to their upper lip. The photo is taken from directly above, looking down at the person and their attire against a plain, light-colored background.

nurlan/360.jpg.description: A cute calico cat is curled up and sleeping on a light green textured surface. A handwritten note is placed near the cat, written in a language that appears to be Russian, with a simple drawing of a cat's face. The note reads "ИЖЫБЯС ЧИТА" (likely a playful or nonsensical message).

nurlan/361.jpg.description: A candid, slightly blurry photo shows two people embracing in what appears to be a bedroom. One person, wearing a black and white plaid shirt, is hugging another who is in a red and white striped shirt. The person in the plaid shirt is facing forward, while the other is leaning into the hug with their eyes closed. A metal clothing rack is visible on the left, and a white wall with a small shelf is in the background. The image has a warm, intimate feel.

nurlan/362.jpg.description: A slightly distorted, upside-down view from what appears to be a window or reflective surface. A person wearing a face mask is visible, seemingly looking down. The background shows a blurred outdoor scene with trees and a fence, under a cloudy or overcast sky. The image has a strong horizontal element due to the window frame or reflective surface.

nurlan/363.jpg.description: An overhead shot of a volleyball court during a game. Several players are visible, some in motion. The court has a blue and white patterned floor with marked zones. A net divides the court, and there's a railing visible in the background. The image appears slightly blurry due to motion.

nurlan/364.jpg.description: A unique perspective shot from above shows two people lying down, facing each other. One person is wearing a blue face mask and has dark hair. The other person is wearing glasses and a striped white and black shirt. Both are extending their arms and hands towards the camera, creating a playful and symmetrical composition. The background is a neutral, light beige color.

nurlan/365.jpg.description: A photograph shows a person climbing on a large bronze sculpture of an animal, likely a bear or similar creature, in an outdoor public space. The sculpture is highly detailed and appears to be a popular attraction, as evidenced by people interacting with it. The background shows a paved area, trees, and buildings, suggesting a park or plaza setting. The sky is clear and blue.

nurlan/366.jpg.description: A digitally altered image features a person wearing a traditional-looking outfit with a patterned white and red sweater and a black cap with a blue brim. They are holding what appears to be a small, black board with the word "МУЗЭКАНТ" (which appears to be a Cyrillic spelling of "musician") written on it in yellow letters. The background is a futuristic, digital-looking scene with glowing blue lines and what seem to be fluctuating graphs or waveforms. The image has a playful, somewhat surreal quality.

nurlan/367.jpg.description: A digitally altered image features a person with a muscular physique, seemingly a man, positioned in front of a background resembling a stock market chart with fluctuating lines. He is holding a small chalkboard that reads "СПАРЦІМЕНКА" in Cyrillic script. The image has a digital art style with a dark color scheme and glowing blue lines representing the chart.

nurlan/368.jpg.description: A woman in a black blazer stands in front of a digital background displaying fluctuating line graphs, likely representing stock market data or financial trends. She is pointing towards the graphs with one hand, and a small chalkboard with the word "ПРИЗДЕНД" (likely meaning "Dividend" in Russian) is positioned near the graphs. The image appears to be a promotional or educational video still related to finance or investment.

nurlan/369.jpg.description: A digitally manipulated image features a man in a suit holding a dollar bill, with a chalkboard displaying the word "БЫЗНЕСМЭН" (businessman in Russian, but mirrored) hovering above his head. The background consists of a dark, futuristic setting with glowing blue line graphs resembling stock market charts. The image appears to be a humorous or ironic commentary on business or finance.

nurlan/37.jpg.description: A group of graduates in black gowns and green hoods are celebrating their graduation by throwing their mortarboards into the air. They are standing in front of a building with orange and white accents, surrounded by tall, green trees. The sky is a clear, bright blue.

nurlan/370.jpg.description: A digitally manipulated image shows a person dressed as a farmer, wearing a straw hat and blue overalls, holding a basket overflowing with fresh vegetables like tomatoes, cucumbers, and peppers. In the background, there's a stock market-like chart, and the person is holding a small blackboard with the Cyrillic word "ПРИЗИДЕНД" (which appears to be a playful misspelling of "President"). The image seems to be a humorous commentary on agriculture, economics, or politics.

nurlan/371.jpg.description: This image shows a benchmarking chart comparing the performance of an individual investment portfolio against the S&P 500 and NASDAQ 100 over a period up to October 29, 2025. The individual portfolio (white line) significantly outperforms both the S&P 500 (blue line) and NASDAQ 100 (green line) over the displayed timeframe. The chart allows selection of different timeframes (1M, YTD, 1Y, 3Y, 5Y, Max). Performance percentages are displayed for each benchmark: 29.88% for the individual portfolio, 16.89% for the S&P 500, and 26.22% for the NASDAQ 100. The data is sourced from FactSet and visualized by getquin.

nurlan/372.jpg.description: A man is posing for a photo with two women dressed in elaborate carnival costumes. The women are wearing large, colorful feathered headdresses and sparkly outfits. The man is smiling and looking at the camera, while the women are flanking him, one on each side. The photo appears to be taken at night, with blurred lights in the background. There are laughing emojis at the bottom of the image.
