nurlan/373.jpg.description: A collage of photos showcasing a person's life from childhood to adulthood, featuring various moments with family and friends. The images depict the individual at different ages, in different settings, and with varying expressions, suggesting a journey through time and experiences.

nurlan/374.jpg.description: A low-angle shot shows two people posing near a sculpture. The person on top is wearing a pink hat, sunglasses, a dark jacket, and black pants with white shoes. They are looking down at the person below. The person below is wearing a black puffer jacket, a black beanie, and a white face mask. They are also wearing black pants. Between them is a wooden sculpture, possibly a hand, with sunlight casting a shadow on it. The background is a paved surface.

nurlan/375.jpg.description: A first-person view of two people on a ski lift, both wearing winter gear including red beanies, goggles, and black jackets. The image is taken from a phone, showing the time and battery status in the top right corner. The goggles in the foreground are reflecting the snowy landscape.

nurlan/376.jpg.description: This is a Kazakhstan Identity Card (Жеке куәлік / Удостоверение личности). It displays the holder's information in both Kazakh and Russian languages. The card includes the holder's name (Нұрлыбай Нұрлан Мауленұлы), date of birth (02.06.2004), place of birth (Алматы), nationality (Қазақ), a unique identification number (040602501457), and the card's validity period (16.05.2023 - 15.05.2033). The issuing authority is the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan (ҚР ІШКІ ІСТЕР МИНИСТРЛІГІ). It also features a holographic stripe and security features.

nurlan/377.jpg.description: A photo shows two people, a woman and a man, posing indoors. The woman is on the left, wearing a white t-shirt and black sheer stockings. The man is on the right, wearing a black outfit and a black hat. They are both looking towards the camera with smiles. Text on the image reads "Вип казашка Нурил" and includes a playful emoji. The background is a dark, possibly black, wall.

nurlan/378.jpg.description: A close-up video still shows a person with dark hair lying down, seemingly looking at their feet. The image is taken from a low angle, with a focus on the person's face and the reddish-brown surface below, likely a blanket or clothing.

nurlan/379.jpg.description: An image featuring a headline in Russian that translates to "High school student committed coming out". Below the headline are hands holding a rainbow flag. A portrait of a smiling man is positioned in the lower left corner, partially obscured by a stylized 'Э' symbol (likely representing the Russian news outlet 'Ekspress'). The background is a dark grey.

nurlan/38.jpg.description: A slightly angled, overhead shot shows two men in suits reflected in a rectangular mirror. The mirror is mounted on a wall next to a light-colored cabinet or wall unit. One man is wearing a tie and appears to be adjusting the other man's collar or jacket. The background visible in the mirror shows a doorway and a glimpse of another room.

nurlan/380.jpg.description: A group photo of what appears to be the Japanese national team, likely in a sport like volleyball or basketball, wearing black jerseys with a white logo. They are posing in front of a metal grate or fence. The text at the bottom of the image reads "сборная Японии" which translates to "Japan national team" in Russian.

nurlan/381.jpg.description: A blurry image shows a young man with dark hair wearing a white collared shirt and dark pants. He appears to be in a candid, possibly paparazzi-style photo, with a slightly downward gaze. The image quality is low, making details difficult to discern.

nurlan/382.jpg.description: A digitally altered image shows a person with a face superimposed onto a body wearing a suit and tie. They are pointing at a stock market-style chart with fluctuating lines. The person is holding a small blackboard that reads "ПРИЗИДЕНТ" (President in Russian). The background is a dark teal color with glowing lines resembling a financial data display.

nurlan/383.jpg.description: A young boy wearing a black knit cap and a red vest is interacting with a large, bronze sculpture of a bull's head and horns. He is positioned low, looking up at the camera, and appears to be gripping the horns. The background shows a park-like setting with trees, a paved walkway, and other people in the distance. The photo is taken from a low angle, emphasizing the size of the sculpture and the boy's interaction with it.

nurlan/384.jpg.description: A close-up portrait of a man with dark hair and a black shirt, overlaid with a digital graphic of a fluctuating line chart and a small, black-framed sign displaying the text "БАРЕЦ" in yellow. The background is a dark teal with glowing blue lines resembling a digital interface.

nurlan/385.jpg.description: A digitally rendered image features a cartoonish depiction of a young girl resembling a princess, holding a small black chalkboard that reads "ПРЕНЦЕСКА" in Cyrillic script. She is dressed in a purple gown with white floral details and a tiara. The background is a dark teal with glowing, abstract line graphs resembling stock market charts or data visualizations. The overall aesthetic is somewhat surreal and playful.

nurlan/386.jpg.description: A candid photo shows three young people playfully posing for a picture. A person wearing a white sweatshirt with a graphic design stands on top of the heads of two others. The person on top has their arms extended, seemingly 'holding' the others' heads. The person on the left is wearing a light green hoodie, and the person on the right is wearing a black shirt. They all appear to be indoors, with a plain white wall as the background.

nurlan/387.jpg.description: A digitally altered image shows a person in a security guard uniform with a cap, seemingly monitoring a fluctuating stock market graph displayed on a green background. A black frame above the person's head displays the text 'МУДРЕТС' (MUDRETS) in Cyrillic script. The image appears to be a humorous or satirical take on financial monitoring or security.

nurlan/388.jpg.description: A close-up shot of a young boy smiling widely, revealing missing front teeth. He has dark hair and a joyful expression, with crinkled eyes indicating a genuine smile. The lighting is somewhat dim, casting shadows and highlighting the texture of his skin.

nurlan/389.jpg.description: Two young boys are engaged in physical activity at a school playground. One boy is hanging from a pull-up bar, demonstrating strength and coordination, while another stands nearby observing. They are both dressed in formal attire, including suits and dress shoes, which is unusual for a playground setting. The background features a multi-story school building with a red and white facade.

nurlan/39.jpg.description: A nighttime scene featuring two silhouetted figures walking along a snow-covered path. The figures appear to be holding hands or walking closely together. Streetlights and bare trees line the path, creating a moody and atmospheric image. The snow banks are substantial, suggesting a winter setting. The image is slightly distorted, possibly due to being taken through a window or reflective surface.

nurlan/390.jpg.description: A person is lying on their back, partially visible, with their legs and upper torso in the frame. They are wearing dark shorts and a dark shirt with a patterned design. The background includes a patterned rug and a glimpse of furniture and a wall.

nurlan/391.jpg.description: A person is lying on the floor next to a patterned cushion, appearing distressed or possibly unconscious. They are wearing shorts and their head is tilted back. The scene appears to be indoors, with a wooden floor and a patterned rug visible.

nurlan/392.jpg.description: Two young men are walking in a hallway, both wearing white shirts and dark blazers with red and white striped ties. The person in the foreground is smiling and making a peace sign with their hand, while the other is walking ahead and looking forward. A green chalkboard with a chemical equation is visible in the background.

nurlan/393.jpg.description: A group of young people, likely students in uniform, are posing for a selfie. They are close together, with several making silly faces and gestures like pinching their noses with their fingers. The group appears to be having fun and enjoying each other's company. Some are wearing school uniforms with ties, while others are in more casual attire like sweaters and caps.

nurlan/394.jpg.description: A group of students, dressed in school uniforms, are holding certificates and red ribbons, likely after receiving awards. They are standing in a line against a blue wall with a digital clock displaying '20:00' in the background. The students appear to be of Asian descent and are wearing uniforms consisting of black blazers, white shirts, and striped ties. Some are looking towards the camera, while others are looking forward.

nurlan/395.jpg.description: A group of four young men, all wearing black GIVOVA t-shirts, are gathered around a table enjoying a meal. The photo is a selfie taken from a low angle, showing the men from the chest up. They appear to be in a casual setting, possibly a shared living space, with a wooden table holding plates of food and a basket of bread. Two of the men are smiling and making playful gestures.

nurlan/396.jpg.description: A group of students, likely high schoolers, are posing for a photo in what appears to be a school hallway. They are all wearing similar uniforms consisting of light blue shirts, navy blue ties with a gold emblem, and dark pants. Several students are standing, while others are kneeling or squatting in the front row. They are smiling and appear cheerful. The hallway has a yellow and white color scheme, with windows in the background.

nurlan/397.jpg.description: A photograph shows three people outdoors on a bright day. A man is giving a piggyback ride to a child, while another man stands to the left, looking at the camera. The man giving the ride is wearing a brown beanie, black pants, and black shoes. The child on his back is wearing a black winter coat and a black beanie with red accents. The man on the left is wearing a gray and black puffer jacket and jeans. They appear to be in front of a building with columns and ornate architecture.

nurlan/398.jpg.description: A family of three, a woman and two children, are posing for a photo in front of a grand, columned building. All three are wearing face masks and winter clothing, including hats and puffy jackets. The woman is on the left, a young boy is in front, and a young man is on the right. The building behind them appears to be a park entrance with Cyrillic text above the columns.

nurlan/399.jpg.description: Three young people are posing for a photo outdoors. Two boys are sitting on a large, sculpted bear head, while a third stands to the right, looking at the camera. The bear head appears to be part of a larger rock formation or exhibit. The boys are dressed in casual winter clothing, including jackets, jeans, and a beanie. The background features trees and a rocky landscape, suggesting a park or outdoor attraction.

nurlan/4.jpg.description: A woman is lying in a field of orange poppies, looking up at the camera. She is wearing a wide-brimmed straw hat, a patterned long-sleeved shirt, dark leggings, and has a black wristband. The poppies are scattered throughout the lush green grass.

nurlan/40.jpg.description: An overhead view of a partially constructed brick building with a unique, angular roofline. The building appears to be in a rural or natural setting, with snow and bare trees visible around it. The structure has several window openings, but lacks glass or complete finishing. The roof is a dark color, contrasting with the red brick walls. A person is visible on the top level.

nurlan/400.jpg.description: A sunny outdoor scene shows a brick-paved area with fallen leaves. A person is crouched down, seemingly interacting with a small dog. In the background, several people are seated at tables, appearing to be in a cafe or restaurant setting. There are trees with bare branches visible, and a building structure with white pillars on the right side of the frame. The sun is creating a bright glare in the upper right corner of the image.

nurlan/401.jpg.description: A high-angle shot shows a person lying on a red brick or stone surface, seemingly engrossed in something out of frame. They are wearing a black jacket with white lettering and a white cap with a red logo. Their arm is extended, and they appear to be looking down at something. The composition is dominated by the red surface and the person's clothing.

nurlan/402.jpg.description: A young boy stands outdoors, holding a long, dark-colored object that appears to be a rifle or similar long gun. He is wearing a black beanie, a red vest over a black shirt, and dark pants. He has a serious expression and is looking directly at the camera. The background shows a brick pathway and some greenery. The sun is shining brightly, creating glare in the image.

nurlan/403.jpg.description: A group of four students, dressed in formal attire, are walking down a hallway. Three of the students are wearing suits with ties, while the fourth is wearing a dark vest and skirt. The hallway has lockers lining one side and a pale green floor. The students appear to be in a school or institutional setting.

nurlan/404.jpg.description: A candid shot from inside a car shows a young boy engrossed in a smartphone while two other children sleep on either side of him. The children appear to be wearing school uniforms. The background visible through the car window shows a gas station and a bright, daytime setting.

nurlan/405.jpg.description: A group of young people, likely students, are posing for a photo. They are dressed in formal attire, with many wearing suits and ties, and some in skirts and blouses with ties. They appear to be a choir or musical ensemble, standing in a somewhat organized arrangement. The background suggests they are in a school or auditorium.

nurlan/406.jpg.description: A large group of students, mostly wearing dark blue suits and white shirts with ties, are posing for a photo in front of a modern school building with orange and white accents. Some students are standing, while two are kneeling in the front. Many are holding flowers, suggesting a celebratory occasion like graduation or a special event. The background shows other students and a bright, sunny day.

nurlan/407.jpg.description: A group of three people – a young man, a child, and an older woman – are seated at a white picnic table, enjoying a meal outdoors. The young man on the left is actively eating from a paper bag, while the child in the middle is looking at a mobile phone. The woman on the right is holding a red cup and appears to be observing the others. A plastic bottle of water and various food items, including bread and packaged snacks, are on the table. The background shows a park with trees and what appears to be a colorful inflatable structure or ride.

nurlan/408.jpg.description: Two students, one in a suit and the other with a backpack, appear to be in a classroom or school setting. The student in the suit is standing and seems to be talking to the other student, who is seated. The room has white and light yellow walls, with desks and chairs arranged for learning. A whiteboard is visible in the background.

nurlan/409.jpg.description: A photograph taken during a volleyball game. A player wearing a black jersey with the number 10 is facing away from the camera, looking towards the net. Above the net is a banner that reads "HOME OF THE TIEN SHAN NOMADS". To the left of the frame is an American flag. Other players are visible in the background, and the indoor volleyball court has a metal support structure overhead.

nurlan/41.jpg.description: Three young men are sitting on the floor in what appears to be a public space, possibly an airport or train station. The man on the left is wearing a black sweater and pants with black shoes, and is leaning against a blue wall. The man in the middle is wearing a plaid shirt, a brown beanie, and black pants, and is looking down. The man on the right is wearing a red puffy jacket and black pants, and is also looking down, possibly at his phone. A backpack is leaning against the wall next to the middle man. The floor is tiled in a light gray color, with yellow tactile paving near the wall.

nurlan/410.jpg.description: A young boy is sitting on a bronze statue of a fox in a public space. He is wearing a black knit cap, a grey and black jacket with a red collar visible underneath, and blue jeans with black shoes. He is looking slightly off-camera with a serious expression. The statue is detailed, showing the fox's fur and form. The ground is paved with a pattern of light and dark stones.

nurlan/411.jpg.description: A group of people, likely a sports team and coaches, are posing for a photo indoors. The background features a banner with the Haileybury school crest and motto. The team members are wearing a mix of athletic wear, including black and blue jerseys and shorts. Some are standing, while others are kneeling or squatting in the front row. There's a diverse group of individuals, suggesting a multicultural team. The floor is a green indoor sports surface with white lines.

nurlan/412.jpg.description: A group of nine young men, likely a volleyball team, posing for a photo indoors. They are wearing black and white athletic uniforms with a logo on the chest. Several are holding a volleyball. The background features a basketball hoop, flags of Kyrgyzstan and Turkey, and a sign that reads "To the Yurt". The floor is a light wood color.

nurlan/413.jpg.description: A young boy is dressed in formal attire, consisting of a black vest, a pink collared shirt, and a black tie. He is facing forward with a slight smile, and the background features a patterned wall.

nurlan/414.jpg.description: A young girl is mid-stride on a green artificial turf field, appearing to be in motion, possibly running or jumping. She is wearing a dark green hooded jacket with fur trim, a dark skirt, and black leggings with boots. There's a pile of clothing and a bag near her feet. In the background, other people are visible, some standing and some walking, along with a building with a red roof and black fencing. The lighting suggests it's either early morning or late afternoon.

nurlan/415.jpg.description: Two students, one in a white shirt and red tie, and another in a dark suit jacket, are intensely focused on a document and a smartphone on a wooden table. The student in the suit jacket appears stressed, resting his head in his hand. The document is covered in text and appears to be a worksheet or exam paper. The setting seems to be a classroom or study area.

nurlan/416.jpg.description: A candid shot of three people – a young man, a child, and an older woman – enjoying a meal outdoors at a white picnic table. The young man is focused on eating, while the child is drinking from a can. The woman is holding a cup, seemingly engaged in conversation. The table is covered with food packaging, a water bottle, and disposable utensils. The background features a park with trees and a distant amusement park ride.

nurlan/417.jpg.description: Two young men are sitting at a wooden picnic table outdoors, enjoying a meal. The man on the left is wearing a gray puffer jacket and looking off to the side, while the man on the right is focused on eating a piece of food. There's food, including what appears to be sandwiches or burgers, and a water bottle on the table. The setting seems to be a casual outdoor dining area, possibly a park or cafe, with other tables and people visible in the background. The lighting suggests a sunny day.

nurlan/418.jpg.description: Two young men are engaged in a playful wrestling or grappling interaction on a green artificial turf field. One is wearing a white sweater and black pants, while the other is in a button-down shirt with a tie and black pants, holding a volleyball. The sun is low in the sky, creating a warm glow and long shadows. There are other individuals blurred in the background, and some athletic equipment is visible near the edge of the frame.

nurlan/419.jpg.description: A beautifully ornate, white stone archway frames a view of the sea and a distant cityscape. The arch is highly decorated with intricate carvings and floral motifs. Below the arch, a clear glass panel allows a direct view of the water. The sea is a vibrant blue, and the cityscape appears as a cluster of buildings on the horizon. The sky is a clear, bright blue.

nurlan/42.jpg.description: Two people, a woman and a young man, are sitting on swings in a snowy park. The woman on the left is wearing a red coat and a black beanie, and is making a peace sign with her hand. The man on the right is wearing a brown beanie and a dark blue puffer jacket over a red shirt. Behind them are parked cars and bare trees covered in snow. The swing set is painted green and yellow.

nurlan/420.jpg.description: A young boy in a black jacket and blue jeans is interacting with a bronze bull statue. He is gently touching the bull's nose with his right hand. Behind him, a child in a red coat and jeans is visible, along with other people in the background. The scene is set on a brick-paved area.

nurlan/421.jpg.description: A man stands on a lush green lawn, looking towards the right of the frame. He's wearing a black tank top, yellow and brown plaid shorts, a black baseball cap, and white sneakers. He has a red lanyard around his neck. Behind him is an ornate white pillar and a decorative metal fence overlooking a blue body of water. Trees frame the top of the image, creating a natural border.

nurlan/422.jpg.description: A woman stands on a lush green lawn in front of an ornate white fence and a decorative pillar, with a bright blue sea visible beyond the fence. She is wearing a wide-brimmed sun hat, a blue cardigan, a patterned skirt, and white sneakers. She has a black shoulder bag and appears to be enjoying a sunny day outdoors. A weeping tree partially frames the scene.

nurlan/423.jpg.description: A grand, ornate white gateway structure stands prominently overlooking the sea. The gateway features intricate carvings and decorative elements, with columns supporting a highly detailed archway. A delicate metal chain connects the gateway to surrounding pillars. People are visible around the structure, some resting on the steps and along the low walls. In the background, a cityscape and several ships are visible on the calm, blue water under a clear, bright sky.

nurlan/424.jpg.description: A wide shot captures a grand, ornate building with intricate sculptural details, likely a palace or significant public structure. The building is framed by lush greenery and a clear blue sky. A wide, paved pathway leads towards the building, with a few people walking along it. In the background, modern skyscrapers rise, creating a contrast between historical architecture and contemporary urban development. The scene is bathed in bright sunlight, casting shadows on the pathway.

nurlan/425.jpg.description: A slightly blurry, close-up shot of a woman wearing a light-colored straw hat and a white t-shirt with red lettering. She is looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. A patterned strap is visible across her chest. The background shows a blurred street scene with a person walking in the distance.

nurlan/426.jpg.description: A high-angle shot shows bare feet standing near a pair of black and white Nike sneakers. The feet and shoes are positioned on a floor that transitions from red mats to a speckled grey and green surface. Two smartphones lie on the floor nearby.

nurlan/427.jpg.description: A woman stands on a brick-paved walkway, framed by a stunning cascade of purple flowers covering a building. She is wearing a white sun hat, a light-colored jacket over a white shirt, a plaid skirt, and a crossbody bag. The flowers appear to be jacaranda, creating a vibrant and picturesque scene. The building behind is light-colored with a red door and a small red chair visible. The scene is bathed in bright sunlight.

nurlan/428.jpg.description: A charming street scene featuring colorful, ornate buildings, likely in a historic district. The buildings are painted in pastel shades of pink and yellow, with intricate architectural details like balconies and decorative trim. Lush greenery, including flowering vines and potted plants, adorns the street and buildings. A red awning shades an outdoor seating area, suggesting a cafe or restaurant. The street is paved with gray bricks, and a clear blue sky provides a bright backdrop.

nurlan/429.jpg.description: A person is lying on the ground, looking up at the camera with a wide smile. They are wearing a black jacket with red accents, a white shirt with a design, and blue jeans. They are positioned on a patterned surface, partially on a large circular reddish-brown area. The photo appears to be taken from a very low angle, almost directly below the person.

nurlan/43.jpg.description: A blurry image appears to show a person lying on a light-colored floor. The person is partially obscured by dark clothing, likely pants, and is in a somewhat contorted position. The image is significantly blurred, making details difficult to discern.

nurlan/430.jpg.description: A white and orange tabby cat is comfortably resting inside a bright green, metal-framed cart or wagon. The cat is lying on a patterned fabric cushion within the cart, with its head resting on the edge, appearing relaxed and content. The cart's green frame has a textured surface with small holes. The image is well-lit, casting shadows that highlight the cart's structure and the cat's form.

nurlan/431.jpg.description: A view from a boat, looking out at the ocean. A sailboat with a white sail is visible in the distance, under a clear blue sky. In the foreground, the backs of people are visible, with a child being held up to see the sailboat. The image is framed by the boat's structure, including a white ceiling and a red railing.

nurlan/432.jpg.description: A man wearing a yellow polo shirt and a white baseball cap is sitting on a boat, with a Turkish flag waving behind him. He is looking towards the camera with a calm expression. The background shows a bright blue sky, calm turquoise water, and a coastline with buildings and other boats.

nurlan/433.jpg.description: A black and white cat is curiously investigating a one dollar bill held by a hand. The cat is leaning down, focused on the money, with its whiskers extended. The scene appears to be indoors, with a wooden surface and a metal frame visible in the background.

nurlan/434.jpg.description: A black cat is lying on a black tiled surface, seemingly 'guarding' a $100 US bill held by a hand. The cat's green eyes are visible, and it appears to be playfully interacting with the money. The tiles have circular indentations and metal accents.

nurlan/435.jpg.description: A vibrant photograph captures the wake of a boat cutting through the water, with a clear blue sky above. The swirling white foam of the wake dominates the foreground, contrasting with the deep blue of the sea. In the distance, a cityscape is visible, including prominent buildings and what appears to be a mosque with its distinctive minarets. A single seagull flies in the clear sky. The image evokes a sense of movement and travel.

nurlan/436.jpg.description: A woman stands in front of an ornate, decorative gate with a water view in the background. She is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a blue cardigan, a patterned skirt, and sneakers, and has a small bag slung across her body. The gate is made of a light-colored material with intricate metalwork and is flanked by pillars. The sky is a clear, bright blue.

nurlan/437.jpg.description: A man stands with his back to the camera, looking out over a calm, blue body of water. He is wearing a black cap, sunglasses, a dark grey sleeveless shirt, and yellow shorts. He has a lanyard around his neck. A decorative white railing with ornate detailing frames the view, and a small seagull is perched on the railing. In the distance, a coastline with buildings and boats is visible under a clear blue sky.

nurlan/438.jpg.description: A unique perspective shot from a climbing wall, showing two people seemingly defying gravity. One person is positioned horizontally, appearing to 'walk' on the wall, while the other is below, also clinging to the wall. The wall is gray with colorful climbing holds. The bright blue sky is visible in the background, suggesting a sunny day. The image has a playful, almost surreal quality due to the unusual angle.

nurlan/439.jpg.description: A young man stands in front of a decorative white railing overlooking a bright blue sea. He is wearing a black tank top, yellow plaid shorts, a black cap, and white sneakers. He has a black shoulder bag and a red lanyard around his neck. The sky is clear and blue, indicating a sunny day. The railing casts a shadow on the stone wall he's standing on.

nurlan/44.jpg.description: A group of people are enjoying a winter day at a park. One person is swinging on a swing set, while another stands nearby with their arms crossed, and a third person is partially visible on the right, holding a hat. In the background, there are cars and trees with some snow covering the ground. The swing set is red and green, and the people are wearing winter clothing.

nurlan/440.jpg.description: A photo of a couple standing outdoors on a sunny day. The woman on the left is wearing a blue jacket, a floral patterned skirt, a straw hat, and sneakers. She has a camera strap across her body. The man on the right is wearing a yellow polo shirt, a white cap, grey pants, and blue sneakers. They are holding hands and appear to be enjoying a day out. In the background, there's a waterfront view with a bridge and buildings, and lush greenery surrounding them.

nurlan/441.jpg.description: A woman in a blue shirt and white sun hat stands near a decorative white railing, looking out over a calm, blue sea. In the distance, a coastline with buildings and a tall tower is visible under a clear, bright blue sky. The railing partially obscures the view, creating a framed perspective of the seascape.

nurlan/442.jpg.description: A group of four people – two adults and two children – are in a swimming pool, playfully flexing their muscles. They are partially submerged in the clear, turquoise water, with the edge of the pool visible as a tiled border. The background shows a tiled area and what appears to be lounge chairs. The scene is brightly lit, suggesting a sunny day.

nurlan/443.jpg.description: A person is lying in bed, asleep. They are on their side with their face partially obscured by their arm and hand. They are wearing a blue t-shirt and appear to be resting comfortably.

nurlan/444.jpg.description: A man is demonstrating a bicep curl, flexing his arm while looking towards the right. He is wearing a black t-shirt with white lettering over a patterned shirt and a red lanyard. The background includes a glass partition and a doorway with a green exit sign.

nurlan/445.jpg.description: A group of students, likely graduating, posing for a photo on a set of stairs. They are dressed in formal attire – suits for the boys and light-colored shirts with dark skirts or pants for the girls – and many are wearing sashes. Some students are holding bouquets of flowers. The background features draped green and white fabric, suggesting a celebratory or ceremonial setting. The overall atmosphere is joyful and celebratory.

nurlan/446.jpg.description: A photograph captures a graduation ceremony taking place outdoors. A graduate in a black gown and cap is receiving a diploma or certificate from a person in a white shirt. They are standing on a red carpet under a blue canopy. In the background, there's a building with orange and white facade, and other people are visible, some observing the ceremony. The scene is brightly lit, suggesting a sunny day.

nurlan/447.jpg.description: A high-angle view captures a vibrant beach scene with a long stretch of sandy shore bordered by rocky cliffs and turquoise water. Numerous people are enjoying the beach, swimming and sunbathing. A line of buildings and palm trees sits atop the cliffs, contrasting with the dramatic clouds in the blue sky. The foreground features a rocky outcrop, providing a unique perspective.

nurlan/448.jpg.description: A selfie taken in a grocery store featuring a woman in the foreground with two young men behind her. The woman is wearing glasses and has long brown hair. The two men are looking towards the camera, one wearing a beanie and the other a black jacket with a white panel. The background shows shelves stocked with water bottles and various food items.

nurlan/449.jpg.description: A child lies on their back, suspended in a circular rope swing. They are wearing a puffy pink and black winter jacket and a black beanie. The swing is made of blue rope and is positioned over a red rubberized surface.

nurlan/45.jpg.description: A close-up, slightly tilted view shows two people embracing. The person in the foreground has dark hair and is holding a white object (possibly a piece of fabric or a small pillow) close to their face. The other person, lying above, is wearing a white sweater with the brand 'DOLCE&GABBANA' visible in reverse on the waistband. Both individuals appear to be smiling or have relaxed expressions, suggesting a moment of affection or comfort.

nurlan/450.jpg.description: A man is partially submerged in clear, turquoise water, looking towards the camera with a slight smile. He's wearing blue swim trunks and appears to be near a rocky shoreline with vegetation. The photo is taken from a low angle, looking up at the man and the clear water, with a bright blue sky visible.

nurlan/451.jpg.description: A man is partially submerged in a clear, turquoise pool, appearing to lean against the edge. The photo is taken from a low angle, with a bright blue sky filling the upper left portion of the frame. The water is clear enough to see distortions and reflections, and a dark object (possibly a tree or structure) is visible along the edge of the pool.

nurlan/452.jpg.description: A top-down view shows two people interacting with a large elephant. The person on top, wearing a white polo shirt, baseball cap, and blue shoes, is leaning against the elephant's side. Below them, another person in a black cap and shorts is lying down, seemingly also interacting with the elephant. The elephant is dark gray and takes up a significant portion of the frame. A wooden fence is visible in the lower left corner.

nurlan/453.jpg.description: An aerial view of a pristine beach with turquoise water and lush green vegetation. The beach is a narrow strip of white sand separating the forest from the clear, shallow water. A few people are visible enjoying the beach.

nurlan/454.jpg.description: A heartwarming scene of two people interacting with elephants. An older man in a white polo shirt and gray pants stands beside an elephant, appearing to pet its trunk. A younger person in a pink shirt and a cap leans against another elephant, also seemingly interacting with it. Both elephants are large and appear healthy, with visible skin texture. The background shows a road, greenery, and a bright blue sky.

nurlan/455.jpg.description: A high-angle, almost split-screen view of a tropical beach. On the left, a rocky cliff covered in lush green vegetation dominates the frame. On the right, turquoise water stretches out, revealing a sandy beach and the seabed below. The clear blue sky occupies the upper left corner, contrasting with the vibrant water.

nurlan/456.jpg.description: A unique perspective of a coastal scene, split between a dramatic sky and rocky shoreline. The left side of the image showcases a cloudy sky with patches of blue, framed by lush green trees. The right side features dark, jagged rocks extending into clear, turquoise water, with small figures of people enjoying the water. The composition is a striking contrast between the natural elements of sky, land, and sea.

nurlan/457.jpg.description: A unique perspective from a boat or dock, showing a reflection of a rocky island or cliff in the calm, turquoise water. The sky is a vibrant blue with fluffy white clouds. The wooden planks of the boat or dock are visible on the right side of the frame, creating a strong diagonal line. The image captures a serene and picturesque scene, likely in a tropical or coastal environment.

nurlan/458.jpg.description: A slightly blurry, vintage-looking photograph shows three people standing outdoors in a snowy landscape. Two women are in the foreground, with a child positioned slightly to the right and behind them. The woman on the left wears a dark blue parka with a fur-trimmed hood, while the woman in the center has a pink knitted hat. The child is wearing a dark coat and a blue cap. Behind them is a large building decorated with colorful flags, and a snow-covered hill. The overall scene suggests a cold, winter environment, possibly a ski resort or winter sports venue. The photo appears to be taken through a window or glass surface, contributing to the blurriness.

nurlan/459.jpg.description: A collage of three photos shows a group of graduates celebrating their achievement. The first photo features a playful pose with one graduate carrying another on his back, all wearing graduation gowns and caps with bright green accents. The second photo shows the graduates lined up, posing for a group photo. The third photo shows a larger group of graduates posing in front of a building with signage, also in their gowns and caps. The overall mood is celebratory and joyful.

nurlan/46.jpg.description: A group portrait of three people – a young man in a suit, an elderly woman in traditional embroidered clothing and a headscarf, and a woman in a yellow dress – posing outdoors on a rooftop or balcony. The background features a cityscape with mountains in the distance under a cloudy sky. The setting appears to be a special occasion, possibly a celebration or event.

nurlan/460.jpg.description: A wide shot captures a bustling waterfront scene in Istanbul, Turkey. Several ornate boats are docked along a pier, with a prominent, elaborately decorated vessel in the foreground. In the background, the skyline is dominated by the Yeni Mosque (New Mosque) with its distinctive minarets and a dome. People are visible walking along the pier and on the boats. The water is a deep blue, with gentle ripples reflecting the sunlight. The sky is a pale blue with a few scattered clouds. The overall impression is one of a vibrant and historic city.

nurlan/461.jpg.description: A black and tan dog is lying on its back in a patch of green grass, looking up at the camera. The dog has white paws and a pink nose. The photo is taken from directly above, giving a unique perspective.

nurlan/462.jpg.description: A collage of four photos featuring a group of students in school uniforms, likely for a promotional or commemorative purpose. The backgrounds include signage for 'Fascinating Biology'. The students are posed in various arrangements – standing, sitting, and leaning – and appear to be engaged and cheerful. The color scheme is dominated by white, navy blue, and a touch of pink from the signage and some clothing accents. The photos are well-lit and professionally composed.

nurlan/463.jpg.description: A young man is lying on a sandy surface near a wooden structure and vegetation, playfully making a peace sign with his hand. He is wearing swim trunks and a sandal, with a camera attached to his shorts. The photo is taken from a high angle, looking down at him.

nurlan/464.jpg.description: A medium-sized dog with a black and tan coat lies on a gravel and dirt surface next to a patch of green grass. The dog is looking up at the camera with a curious expression. It appears to be a mixed breed, possibly with German Shepherd lineage, and has some white markings on its face and chest. The background includes a paved area and some sparse vegetation.

nurlan/465.jpg.description: A young boy wearing a white cap, grey long-sleeved shirt, and camouflage pants stands outdoors, holding a small object in his raised hand. He is smiling and looking towards the camera. Behind him is a building with a red roof and a stone structure with a dog statue on top. There's a large puff of what appears to be steam or smoke to his left, and his shadow is visible on the ground.

nurlan/466.jpg.description: A woman stands on a rocky outcrop overlooking a stunning turquoise bay filled with boats. Lush green hills frame the bay, and the clear water reveals the seabed below. The scene is bathed in bright sunlight under a clear blue sky.

nurlan/467.jpg.description: A low-angle shot shows a person lying beneath a large bronze sculpture of a seated figure. The sculpture appears to depict a man, and the person is positioned as if resting in the sculpture's lap. The background is a clear, bright blue sky. The sculpture's surface has a textured, weathered appearance.

nurlan/468.jpg.description: A man is lying on a sandy beach, looking towards the camera, with lush green foliage framing the left side of the image. The beach has turquoise water and a long, narrow strip of sand. A small boat is visible in the distance. The man is wearing black shorts and sandals.

nurlan/469.jpg.description: A high-angle, almost bird's-eye view of a beach scene. The image is divided diagonally between a bright blue sky and a white sandy beach. A narrow strip of turquoise water separates the sand from the rocky cliff face. Several small figures of people are visible in the water, enjoying the beach. The right side of the image features a close-up of textured sand and a rocky outcrop.

nurlan/47.jpg.description: A person is lying on their back, seemingly taking a selfie with a child who is playfully positioned above them. The child is smiling and appears to be partially obstructing the camera lens. The photo is taken indoors, with a bed and a storage unit visible in the background, and a reflection in what appears to be a dresser or cabinet below.

nurlan/470.jpg.description: A high-angle view of a pristine white sand beach meeting the turquoise waters of a calm sea. Several people are enjoying the water, some appearing to be floating on their backs. The sky is a clear, vibrant blue. Footprints are visible in the sand, indicating recent activity. The composition is divided roughly into thirds, with the blue sky, the turquoise water, and the white sand each occupying a significant portion of the frame.

nurlan/471.jpg.description: A high-angle view overlooking a stunning turquoise bay with numerous boats scattered across the water. The coastline features rocky cliffs and a sandy, beige-colored foreground. The water transitions from a deep blue to a vibrant turquoise closer to the shore, revealing a clear view of the seabed. A clear blue sky dominates the upper portion of the image.

nurlan/472.jpg.description: A stunning high-angle view of a turquoise bay with numerous boats and jet skis. Lush green hills frame the bay, and large rocks are visible in the foreground. The water is incredibly clear, revealing the seabed. Several boats are creating wakes as they move across the water under a clear blue sky.

nurlan/473.jpg.description: A young man is sitting cross-legged on a rocky surface near the water, appearing to meditate or relax. He is shirtless and wearing shorts and sandals. The background features a vibrant blue body of water and a steep, green hillside. A bag and some foliage are visible in the foreground.

nurlan/474.jpg.description: A young man is lying on a rocky surface near turquoise water, looking directly at the camera. He is shirtless, wearing blue swim trunks and black sandals. Lush green vegetation is visible on the left side of the frame, and a sign is partially visible on the right. The photo is taken from a slightly elevated, angled perspective.

nurlan/475.jpg.description: A breathtaking aerial view of Maya Bay in Thailand. Turquoise water contrasts with the lush green cliffs and a small white sand beach. A warning sign is visible on a large rock in the foreground, likely cautioning against dangerous activities. Several boats are visible in the bay.

nurlan/476.jpg.description: A man is hanging onto a rope course, suspended against a textured, light-colored wall. He's wearing shorts and appears to be enjoying a recreational activity. In the background, a beautiful coastal scene with turquoise water and a blue sky is visible. The rope course is secured to the wall with multiple ropes, and lush green foliage frames the left side of the image.

nurlan/477.jpg.description: A slightly distorted, wide-angle view from within the water looking towards a beach. The clear, turquoise water dominates the frame, with a sandy beach running along the right edge. Several people are visible on the beach, some sunbathing, others walking. A line of green vegetation borders the beach on the left. The perspective is unusual, as if the photo was taken while partially submerged.

nurlan/478.jpg.description: A low-angle shot shows a person positioned between the outstretched arms of a bronze statue depicting two men. The person is wearing a black beanie and a light-colored jacket with dark sleeves, and appears to be looking upwards. The statue's bronze finish is highlighted by the sunlight, and a clear blue sky forms the backdrop. The statue's faces are visible, framing the person.

nurlan/479.jpg.description: A unique perspective from underwater, showing a person partially submerged in clear, turquoise water. The view splits the image horizontally, with the upper half showing a sandy beach lined with green trees and people enjoying the sun. The lower half is dominated by the water's surface and the submerged individual. The water is clear enough to see the sandy bottom and the distortion of the beach through the surface.

nurlan/48.jpg.description: A heartwarming close-up shot shows a young child being held by an adult. The child, wearing a cream-colored sweater with 'DOLCE & GABBANA' written on it, is nestled against the adult's shoulder, appearing to be looking at something with curiosity. The adult is holding a white cloth or tissue near the child's face. Both individuals have fair skin and appear to be enjoying a tender moment.

nurlan/480.jpg.description: A first-person perspective shot from the water looking up at a beach. The clear turquoise water reveals the sandy shore and people relaxing on the beach. Lush green vegetation lines the edge of the beach. The sun creates shimmering light patterns in the water.

nurlan/481.jpg.description: A high-angle shot captures a man partially submerged in crystal-clear turquoise water at a beach. The water is so clear that the sandy bottom is visible. A white sandy beach stretches along the left side of the frame, bordered by lush green trees. Several other beachgoers are visible in the distance, enjoying the sunny day. The sky is a bright, cloudless blue.

nurlan/482.jpg.description: A person is partially submerged in clear, turquoise water, looking directly at the camera. The water's surface creates a distorted view, and a distant shoreline is visible on the left side of the frame. The sky is a clear blue, contrasting with the water's color.

nurlan/483.jpg.description: A young boy is floating on his back in clear, turquoise water, looking up at the camera. He is wearing a snorkel and mask and has a wristband on one arm. The water is very clear, allowing a view of the bottom. The sky is a bright blue, and a portion of a wooden structure is visible at the top left corner of the image.

nurlan/484.jpg.description: An overhead shot of a man swimming in incredibly clear, turquoise water. He is wearing goggles and appears to be enjoying a sunny day. The water is so clear that the bottom is visible, and the contrast between the blue water and the sky is striking. A small patch of greenery is visible on the left side of the frame.

nurlan/485.jpg.description: A man is partially submerged in clear, turquoise water, likely in a tropical location. He is facing towards the camera, with only his head and upper torso visible above the waterline. He is wearing a dark-colored strap around his neck. The water is very clear, allowing visibility of the seabed. A small portion of land or rocks is visible in the upper left corner, and a patterned object (possibly a towel or clothing) is visible in the lower left corner.

nurlan/486.jpg.description: A unique perspective from underwater looking towards a beach. The image shows a person swimming in clear, turquoise water, with a view of the sandy beach and people relaxing on the shore. Lush green trees line the beach, contrasting with the bright blue sky. The water's surface creates interesting light patterns and distortions.

nurlan/487.jpg.description: An overhead shot of a man swimming in a turquoise-colored infinity pool. The pool appears to have no visible edge, blending seamlessly with the horizon. The water is clear, allowing sunlight to play on the pool floor and the swimmer's body. The sky is a clear, bright blue, contrasting with the pool's color.

nurlan/488.jpg.description: A man and a child are lying on a climbing wall structure in a park. The man is wearing a dark jacket and a black beanie, and the child is wearing a black outfit and a black beanie. They are positioned on a slanted, gray climbing wall with colorful climbing holds. The background shows a clear blue sky and bare tree branches.

nurlan/489.jpg.description: A close-up photo shows an older couple seated at a table in what appears to be a restaurant or pub. The man on the left is wearing a red and blue plaid shirt and looking slightly to the side, while the woman on the right is wearing a cream-colored, textured sweater and looking directly at the camera. The background features a high ceiling with exposed beams and numerous warm-toned lights strung across. There's a plate of fries visible in the foreground, suggesting they are enjoying a meal.

nurlan/49.jpg.description: A young boy is lying on his stomach, propped up on his elbows, and looking at the camera with a smile while holding a smartphone. He is wearing a cream-colored sweater with black trim and black pants. The photo is taken from a high angle, showing a glimpse of a room with a pink patterned rug, a cardboard box with items inside, and a few bottles nearby.

nurlan/490.jpg.description: A group of four people are taking a selfie outdoors, likely in a cold climate given their winter attire. They are positioned close to a building with a white exterior and a dark roof. The individuals are wearing hats, coats, and glasses. The lighting suggests it's either a cloudy day or dusk.

nurlan/491.jpg.description: A close-up portrait of an older couple. The man on the left is wearing a burgundy vest over a blue and red checkered shirt. The woman on the right is wearing a mustard-colored sweater and a delicate gold necklace. They both have serious expressions and are looking directly at the camera. The background shows a modern ceiling with exposed beams and string lights, and a red cushioned wall behind them.

nurlan/492.jpg.description: A group of ten young men are posing for a photo indoors. They are all wearing white t-shirts with colorful abstract designs on the front. Several of them are making hand gestures. The background includes a white board, a clock, and a wall with a light-colored trim. The room appears to be a classroom or meeting space.

nurlan/493.jpg.description: Three young men are standing on an outdoor ice rink, with a snowy mountain backdrop. The ice is slightly rough and shows skate marks. The man on the left is wearing a black Oxford University sweatshirt and jeans, and has skates on. The man in the middle is wearing a grey sweater and a beanie. The man on the right is wearing a black coat and light grey pants, also with skates on. They appear to be enjoying a day of ice skating. There's a small black object in the foreground and a colorful structure visible in the background.

nurlan/494.jpg.description: Two young people are silhouetted against a dusky blue and orange sky while sitting on the roof of a playground structure. One is wearing a mask and a light-colored jacket, while the other is in a t-shirt and pants. The image is taken from a low angle, emphasizing the structure and the sky.

nurlan/495.jpg.description: A unique underwater perspective shows two swimmers in a pool, likely during training or competition. Both are wearing swim caps and goggles, and appear to be looking towards the camera. Bubbles are visible in the water, indicating they are submerged. The image is taken from below, looking up at the swimmers.

nurlan/496.jpg.description: A group of six young people are posing for a photo outdoors, likely at a school or recreational facility with black metal fencing in the background. They are dressed casually in t-shirts and athletic shoes. One person is holding a yellow and white volleyball. Several are making playful poses and gestures, including thumbs-up and resting their heads on their hands. The lighting suggests it's either late in the day or a shaded area.

nurlan/497.jpg.description: A young boy is lying down next to a large, ornate marble sculpture of a lion or mythical creature. He is wearing a black cap, a red vest with white lettering, a dark grey long-sleeved shirt, and blue pants. He appears to be playfully posing with the sculpture, resting his head near it. The sculpture features intricate details, including a mane and what appears to be a pipe or cylindrical object held by the creature.

nurlan/498.jpg.description: A photograph shows two men standing outdoors at night. On the left is an older man wearing a dark jacket with white stripes down the sleeves, black pants, and blue shoes. He has his arms crossed and is looking towards the camera. On the right is a younger man wearing a light gray sweatshirt, plaid shorts, white socks, and white sneakers. He is looking off to the side. The background shows a paved area, a decorative metal fence, trees, and blurred figures of people in the distance, suggesting a public space like a park or plaza.

nurlan/499.jpg.description: A vibrant beach scene at Marin Beach Hotel. A young child in a pink shirt is swinging on a white wooden swing frame decorated with white fabric, positioned in front of the hotel's sign. The beach is sandy with sunbeds and umbrellas, and the turquoise sea stretches out to the horizon under a clear blue sky. Several people are relaxing on the beach in the background.

nurlan/5.jpg.description: A close-up selfie featuring two young men wearing glasses. The person in the foreground is making a peace sign with their fingers, while the person behind them has a slightly puckered lip expression. Both are looking towards the camera. A third person is partially visible in the background wearing a blue shirt. The background appears to be a brightly lit indoor space with white walls and a tiled ceiling.

nurlan/50.jpg.description: A man and a young boy are posing for a selfie. The man is wearing a light-colored zip-up hoodie with dark lettering, and the boy is wearing a dark sweater. They are both looking at the camera. A cabinet with a red interior is visible to the left, and a glimpse of another room is visible in the background.

nurlan/500.jpeg.description: A photo shows two Asian men sitting at a table with a box of donuts. The man on the left is wearing glasses and a black shirt, looking directly at the camera. The man on the right is wearing a black shirt and looking towards the donuts. A bottle of water and the donut boxes are on the yellow tray. The background features red and green decorative elements, suggesting a festive or public space like a mall.

nurlan/501.jpg.description: A group of three people, likely friends or family, posing for a selfie outdoors at night. The person in the foreground is making a peace sign with their hand. All three are wearing glasses and casual clothing. The background appears to be a park or recreational area with fencing and greenery.

nurlan/502.jpg.description: A group of four young people are posing on the roof of a unique, curved wooden structure that resembles a large barrel or a section of a ship. The structure is surrounded by a grassy area and appears to be part of a park or public space. The sky is a beautiful gradient of blue and orange, indicating either sunrise or sunset. One person is standing on top, while the others are seated or leaning on the roof's edge. One person is wearing a face mask.

nurlan/503.jpg.description: A group of nine people posing for a photo in a dimly lit, modern space with green and yellow lighting. The room features curved walls and reflective surfaces. Several individuals are dressed in suits, while others wear more casual attire. Two people are in the front row, kneeling, while the rest stand behind them. There's a playful, energetic vibe to the photo.

nurlan/504.jpg.description: An Instagram story featuring three people in front of a vanity mirror with lights. The person taking the photo initially thought their camera lens was dirty, but realized it was the mirror itself. The story tags two Instagram accounts: @elixir_altynsarina and @myata_altynsarina. The caption in Russian translates to "I thought the mirror was dirty, but it turned out to be my camera 😅".

nurlan/505.jpg.description: A man wearing a winter coat, a white knit cap with fur trim, glasses, and a gray scarf stands beneath a dazzling canopy of twinkling Christmas lights and large decorative ornaments. He is looking slightly upwards and to the side, seemingly captivated by the light display. The background shows a pedestrian walkway and decorated trees.

nurlan/506.jpg.description: A group of young people, likely students, are posing for a photo. Many are wearing traditional Kazakh clothing, featuring ornate embroidery and headwear. The clothing includes elements of green, red, and white, with intricate designs. Some are wearing suits and ties. They are standing in front of a white surface, possibly a projection screen, with a projector mounted on the ceiling. The room has red walls and a window with blinds.

nurlan/507.jpg.description: A group of people are gathered in a room, seemingly engaged in a playful or interactive activity. Several individuals are crouched or kneeling around a small, dark-colored table, while others are seated or standing nearby, observing or participating. The room has a unique interior design with textured walls and artwork. The people are dressed in casual clothing, including t-shirts, shorts, and hoodies. The atmosphere appears lighthearted and fun.

nurlan/508.jpg.description: A man in a camouflage jacket and white beanie stands in front of a dazzling display of Christmas lights. He is looking directly at the camera. Behind him, a woman holds a baby, and other people are visible enjoying the festive atmosphere. The lights consist of numerous strands of small, warm-toned bulbs, with larger red ornaments suspended from above.

nurlan/596.jpg.description: A slightly blurry, tilted photo shows a young boy looking at the camera while holding onto a railing. He's wearing a black jacket and a white cap. In the background, there's a statue of horses and a building with trees. The photo is dated September 10, 2010.

nurlan/597.jpg.description: A heartwarming photo shows two young children, likely siblings, lying close together. The older child, wearing a dark shirt, is looking at the camera with a sweet smile. nurlan/599.jpg.description: A photograph shows a man and two young boys, likely a father with his sons. nurlan/60.jpg.description: An overhead shot shows a tree with golden-yellow foliage, seemingly in autumn, with white specks resembling falling petals or light snow. nurlan/600.jpg.description: A photograph shows a woman standing with two young children. The woman is dressed in a black suit with a white shirt and appears to be smiling. nurlan/601.jpg.description: A candid, slightly blurry photograph shows a group of young children, likely in a daycare or school setting, outdoors. A person, presumably a caregiver, is lying on their back, holding a baby or toddler in their arms. Another child is lying on their back, also being held by the caregiver. Several other children are visible in the background, some appearing to be sleeping or resting. The caregiver is wearing a white shirt and black pants with a sash across their chest that has writing on it, possibly identifying the school or event. The scene is bathed in sunlight, casting shadows from nearby chairs or benches. The photo has a vintage or slightly faded quality.

nurlan/602.jpg.description: A charming vintage photograph of a young child, likely a toddler, standing and looking directly at the camera. The child is wearing a light-colored knitted cardigan over a striped shirt and matching striped pants. They have bright green shoes. The background features a dark, ornate rug and a wooden object resembling a paddle or tool hanging on the wall. The lighting is warm, suggesting an indoor setting.

nurlan/603.jpg.description: A group of young men, likely a sports team, posing for a photo indoors. They are dressed in athletic wear, including shorts, t-shirts, and some are wearing jerseys with numbers. Several are holding a volleyball or basketball. The background consists of padded walls, suggesting a gymnasium or training facility. The overall mood is cheerful and energetic.

nurlan/604.jpg.description: A vintage photograph shows a man and a young child seated at a table with food and drinks. The man, wearing a light grey sweater, looks directly at the camera with a somewhat somber expression. The child, dressed in pink, is positioned in front of him and appears to be looking slightly to the side. A green bottle and a jar filled with a yellow liquid are prominent on the table, along with plates of food and what appear to be small snacks or desserts. nurlan/605.jpg.description: A young boy with a shaved head is sitting at a table covered with a colorful tablecloth featuring fruits and geometric patterns. He is wearing a white tank top and looking directly at the camera. The background consists of reddish-brown wooden paneling.

nurlan/606.jpg.description: A candid photograph shows a group of four people – a young child, and three women – gathered around a table covered with a white tablecloth. The table is laden with food and drinks, including bottles, glasses filled with liquid, and various dishes. The women appear to be enjoying a meal or gathering. The background features a radiator and a large, ornate rug with a red and black pattern. The photo has a slightly faded, vintage quality, suggesting it was taken some time ago.

nurlan/607.jpg.description: A photo shows two young people interacting with a Coca-Cola Zero Sugar promotional installation in front of a large Ferris wheel. One boy is crouching near a large, black, rock-like structure with the Coca-Cola logo, while another boy stands to the right, pointing towards the installation with a plastic bag in his hand. The background features a patterned brick plaza, other people, and a partly cloudy sky. The Ferris wheel is a prominent feature, with its white structure and colorful gondolas visible.

nurlan/608.jpg.description: A group of three people – a young man, an older man, and an older woman – are posing for a selfie-style photo. The woman is in the foreground wearing a sun hat, while the two men are positioned behind her. The background features a rustic wooden structure with visible beams and what appears to be a weathered exterior. The older man is wearing a white cap and glasses, and the young man has a strap across his shoulder. The overall scene suggests a casual outing or travel experience.

nurlan/609.jpg.description: Three people are ice skating on an outdoor rink. The rink appears to be located in a stadium or park, with stadium seating visible in the background. The person in the foreground is wearing a white beanie and black clothing, and is looking forward while skating. Another person is to the left, wearing a cap and dark clothing, and a third person is to the right, wearing a black coat and a black beanie. The ice is smooth and white, and the lighting suggests a sunny day.

nurlan/61.jpg.description: A group of friends are taking a fun selfie, many making 'kissing' faces with puckered lips. The group is diverse in appearance, with varying ethnicities and styles.

nurlan/610.jpg.description: A selfie taken in the water featuring a man and a woman. The man is shirtless with wet hair and appears to be looking directly at the camera. The woman is wearing a pink rash guard, a straw hat, and sunglasses. The background shows a clear blue sky with some clouds and the ocean.

nurlan/611.jpg.description: Three young men are posing for a photo outdoors. One man is sitting on top of a low, white structure, with his legs dangling. The background features a modern architectural structure with curved white and green elements, and some greenery. The lighting suggests it's either dusk or nighttime.

nurlan/612.jpg.description: A heartwarming portrait of four generations posing together. An elderly man with a white shirt and blue cap stands in the center, flanked by three younger family members. The youngest, a boy, is in the front wearing a patterned shirt and khaki pants. To his left is a young man in a grey t-shirt and to his right, another young man in a green t-shirt. They all appear to be looking at the camera, creating a touching family photograph.

nurlan/613.jpg.description: A young boy stands outdoors, leaning against a large evergreen tree. He's wearing a red shirt with white stripes and denim jeans. In the background, a person walks away on a paved path, and there are streetlights visible. The photo is dated October 8, 2010.

nurlan/614.jpg.description: A young boy wearing a cap is riding a black horse decorated with a pink blanket and red pom-poms. A man in a white shirt and tie is lying on the ground near the horse, appearing to be interacting with the boy. The photo appears to be taken outdoors, possibly near a fence or building, with some green foliage visible. The date 'Aug. 2010' is printed on the bottom left corner of the image.

nurlan/615.jpg.description: A family portrait featuring three generations. A young boy in a red shirt is nestled between his mother, who is wearing a pink and white shirt, and his grandfather, who is wearing a dark shirt and a traditional Malay head covering (songkok). The boy is holding a yellow teddy bear. The background is a mix of red, blue, and purple.

nurlan/616.jpg.description: Two young people are working outdoors at a table covered with a floral patterned tablecloth. One is peeling pears with a knife, while the other is sorting them into a purple bowl. Pears are also scattered on the table and a cutting board. The background features a corrugated metal wall and a wooden structure.

nurlan/617.jpg.description: Three people are standing on a large frozen surface, likely an outdoor ice rink. The background features a hillside covered in snow and trees, with a building visible on the right. Two of the individuals are wearing winter hats and coats, and one is wearing a baseball cap. They appear to be enjoying a winter activity, with ice skates visible on their feet or held in their hands. The ice surface is relatively smooth, with some visible imperfections.

nurlan/618.jpg.description: A top-down view of a young child, likely a baby or toddler, sitting on a surface that appears to be a deck or patio. The child is wearing a white shirt with a colorful cartoon design and blue pants. They are holding a bowl filled with dark-colored berries, and their hands are stained with the juice, indicating they've been enjoying them. The child is looking up at the camera with a slightly messy face.

nurlan/619.jpg.description: A man is sitting on a stone bench in front of a stunning, intricately decorated building with a large arched entryway. The building features a vibrant blue and turquoise tile pattern around the arch and along the walls. The man is wearing a grey t-shirt, jeans, and a baseball cap, with a shoulder bag slung across his body. He appears to be resting and enjoying the architecture. The courtyard is paved with brick, and a few vendors are visible in the background.

nurlan/62.jpg.description: A group of young people are gathered around a red object, likely a table or game board, and are all making the "peace sign" gesture with their hands, positioned around the camera as if taking a selfie from above. They are wearing casual clothing, including jackets, hoodies, and glasses. The lighting is dim, creating a cozy and playful atmosphere.

nurlan/620.jpg.description: A close-up portrait of a woman outdoors. She is wearing a light-colored head covering, dark sunglasses, a black t-shirt, and a light green knitted cardigan. She is standing near a tree with lush green foliage, and a park-like setting is visible in the background. The lighting is bright, with some shadows cast on her face.

nurlan/621.jpg.description: A group of friends are posing for a selfie while wearing cowboy hats inside a store. They are all smiling or making playful expressions, and the photo is taken at a close range, creating a slightly distorted, fun perspective. The store appears to be a retail outlet with various items visible in the background.

nurlan/622.jpg.description: A woman stands on a paved walkway next to a large body of water, likely a lake or pond. She is wearing a blue shirt, a patterned skirt, and light-colored shoes. She also has a light-colored head covering. The background features buildings, greenery, and a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds. She is leaning slightly against a metal railing.

nurlan/623.jpg.description: A group of people are playfully posing for a photo, each wearing a different yellow emoji mask – a crying laughing face, a smiling face with hearts, and another crying laughing face. They are wearing white shirts with what appear to be event lanyards and one person has a decorative black skirt with gold detailing. A golden trophy is visible in the background.

nurlan/624.jpg.description: A group of young people are posing for a photo in front of a brick wall with a sign that reads "ПЛАТФОРМА 9%" (Platform 9%). nurlan/625.jpg.description: A young man with dark hair is embracing a woman, both wearing red hoodies. They are standing in front of a white wall with a radiator and a small potted plant on a windowsill. A framed image with a world map is visible behind them.

nurlan/626.jpg.description: A group of five people are posing for a photo in front of a building with a dark red and gray facade. The building has a plaque with text in a non-English language (likely Kazakh). The people are dressed in casual to semi-formal attire, with some wearing coats and lanyards. nurlan/627.jpg.description: A group of people in traditional costumes are performing on a stage. The backdrop features a banner with the number '15' and doves. nurlan/628.jpg.description: A selfie taken by a young man holding a certificate, surrounded by a group of people, likely after an event or competition. nurlan/647.jpg.description: A group of people are gathered around a long table, seemingly enjoying a meal with pizza boxes and drinks visible. nurlan/648.jpg.description: A man dressed in a white outfit is performing on stage, bathed in purple and blue lighting with visible smoke or fog effects. nurlan/649.jpg.description: A group of people are riding in a van or bus. Several individuals are visible, some looking at the camera and others engaged in their own activities. nurlan/651.jpg.description: A group of people, seemingly a team, are practicing or competing in a sport that involves hitting a ball over a net. nurlan/654.jpg.description: A group of four people – two young boys, a woman, and a young man – are posing for a photo in a park during autumn. The ground is covered in fallen yellow leaves. nurlan/656.jpg.description: Two people wearing protective gear, including helmets and vests, are pictured outdoors, likely after or during an ATV or dirt bike ride. nurlan/657.jpg.description: Two young riders stand with their dirt bikes in a lush, green outdoor setting. nurlan/658.jpg.description: Two individuals stand with their electric trial bikes on a rocky, elevated terrain overlooking a vast, mountainous landscape under a bright, slightly cloudy sky. nurlan/659.jpg.description: Two individuals, both wearing protective gear including helmets, goggles, and body armor, stand near dirt bikes. Both are wearing gloves and appear to be preparing for or have just finished a ride.

nurlan/660.jpg.description: A person with long dark hair is partially visible in the background, seemingly looking at a laptop screen. The screen displays a file explorer window with a list of files and folders. A portion of a person's face and dark hair is in the foreground, obscuring part of the view.

nurlan/661.jpg.description: Two children are playfully posing in what appears to be a disorienting or illusion-based room. One child is positioned horizontally against the wall, seemingly defying gravity, while the other is 'falling' towards them, creating a humorous and surreal scene. A potted plant is between them. nurlan/662.jpg.description: Two young boys are posing in front of a large historical painting depicting a battle scene with horses and soldiers. They are both wearing casual clothes – jeans and t-shirts – and sneakers. The painting is a prominent feature of the background, with warm tones and a dynamic composition.

nurlan/663.jpg.description: A photograph shows a room designed to create an optical illusion. A person appears to be walking on the ceiling, while in reality, the room is built at an angle. nurlan/664.jpg.description: A playful and surreal image shows two people seemingly defying gravity in a kitchen. One person is upside down, supporting another who is also inverted above them, creating a stacked, floating effect. A third person is partially visible, also appearing to be upside down. A small table with a plate of fruit and cups sits in the foreground, adding to the whimsical scene. The kitchen features white cabinets, a stainless steel range hood, and a wooden floor.

nurlan/665.jpg.description: A playful and surreal image shows multiple people seemingly defying gravity, hanging from the ceiling of a room. One person is centered, hanging directly below a light fixture, while others are positioned around the periphery of the frame. The room has a warm, cozy feel with wooden floors and neutral-colored walls.

nurlan/666.jpg.description: A young boy is lying in a patch of greenery, seemingly posing for a photo from a high angle.
