nurlan/824.jpg.description: A group of people are playing a game that appears to be a variation of volleyball or a similar net-based sport in a large indoor sports hall. The floor is green with white and pink lines marking the playing areas. Several players are in motion, some appearing to be actively playing while others are waiting. They are wearing matching black and red athletic wear. There are multiple nets set up, suggesting multiple games are happening simultaneously. The hall has a high ceiling with visible lighting and ventilation systems.

nurlan/825.jpg.description: Three young boys are posing with oversized wooden chairs. The boy on the left is sitting on top of a large chair, wearing a gray beanie, a gray sweatshirt, and jeans with turquoise sneakers. The boy in the middle is sitting in a similar chair, wearing a maroon shirt and jeans. The boy on the right is sitting on the floor next to a chair, wearing a navy blue tracksuit. They are all looking towards the camera with varying expressions.

nurlan/826.jpg.description: A collage of graduation portraits featuring 20 Kazakh students. Each student is pictured in a head and shoulders shot, wearing a dark suit jacket over a white shirt, and a black cap and gown. The background is a dark green chalkboard with the word "GRADUATION" written in white chalk. The names of the students are printed below their portraits. At the bottom center of the collage is the text "ЖАС ҰРПАК 2022" (meaning "Young Generation 2022").

nurlan/827.jpg.description: A group of people, including adults and children, are standing close together in what appears to be a public square or plaza. The group is diverse in age and appearance. The people are dressed in casual clothing, mostly jeans and t-shirts. There's a large crowd of people visible in the background, suggesting a festival or event is taking place. The lighting is bright, indicating it's daytime. The foreground individuals are looking towards the camera, some with serious expressions.

nurlan/828.jpg.description: A tilted selfie featuring two people. The person in the foreground is wearing glasses and a light pink shirt, looking towards the camera. Behind them, another person wears a straw hat and a patterned scarf, also looking towards the camera. The background shows a bright outdoor scene with palm trees and buildings, viewed through what appears to be a glass or plastic covering.

nurlan/829.jpg.description: A group of six people posing for a photo indoors. The group consists of several generations, including older adults and younger individuals. They are standing on a patterned tile floor with sheer, colorful drapery in the background. The individuals are dressed in a variety of clothing, ranging from casual jeans and jackets to more formal attire. One woman is wearing a black and white striped tunic, and another is wearing a light orange sweater. One man is wearing a hat and a suit jacket. An elderly woman is using a walking stick.

nurlan/83.jpg.description: A group selfie featuring three people. A woman with medium-length, two-toned hair (dark roots with blonde highlights) is in the center, wearing a black dress and a silver necklace with a pendant. She is looking directly at the camera with a slight smile. To her left is a man in a black shirt, looking slightly downcast. To her right is another man in a white shirt, looking at the camera with a subtle smirk. The background appears to be a wall with dark trim and a window with green accents.

nurlan/830.jpg.description: A person is holding a freshly cut coconut with a straw, seemingly enjoying a drink on a beach. The photo is taken from a low angle, showing the coconut in the foreground and a long stretch of beach with people and colorful umbrellas in the background. The person is wearing a pink shirt, a cap, and sunglasses. Palm trees frame the top of the image.

nurlan/831.jpg.description: A low-angle, close-up portrait of a man outdoors on a sunny day. He is looking up with the sun positioned to the left of the frame, creating a bright glare. The background shows a clear blue sky, palm trees, and a building. The man appears to be shirtless and has short dark hair.

nurlan/832.jpg.description: A high-angle view of a calm, clear turquoise bay with three traditional longtail boats moored near a lush, green hillside. The right side of the frame shows a sandy beach with visible footprints. The sky is a vibrant blue, contrasting with the colors of the water and vegetation.

nurlan/833.jpg.description: A high-angle view of a sandy beach with people enjoying the sun and water. The beach curves along a coastline with a forested hillside in the background. Several boats are visible in the water, and people are scattered along the shore, some swimming and others relaxing on the sand. The sky is blue with a few clouds.

nurlan/834.jpg.description: A group of three young boys are posing for a photo outdoors. The boy on the left is wearing a black cap and a dark shirt. The boy in the middle is wearing a red shirt and is looking at the camera with a slight smile. The boy on the right is wearing a red shirt with a graphic design, denim shorts, and black shoes. Another boy is in the foreground wearing a grey shirt with a graphic design and dark pants. They are standing in front of a vibrant flowerbed with red and yellow flowers and a low stone wall.

nurlan/835.jpg.description: A wide-angle, low-perspective photo shows three boys in a park. The central boy is carrying a smaller boy on his back, while a third boy stands in front, looking up with a smile. All three are wearing casual clothing – shorts and t-shirts. Behind them is a vibrant flowerbed with red and yellow flowers, and trees with autumn foliage. The photo appears to be taken outdoors on a slightly overcast day.

nurlan/836.jpg.description: A group of people are taking a selfie while on a ride, likely a train or similar amusement park attraction. The camera is pointed downwards, capturing faces from a low angle. The background is filled with lush green trees. The people are wearing casual clothing and hats, and some are making playful gestures towards the camera.

nurlan/837.jpg.description: A group of three young boys are playfully posing for a photo outdoors. One boy is giving a piggyback ride to another, while the third stands beside them, looking at the camera with a smile. They are surrounded by colorful flowerbeds and trees. The boys are dressed casually in shorts and t-shirts.

nurlan/838.jpg.description: A photo taken from a slightly high angle shows two people posing in front of a decorative archway with the word "Тебе" (which translates to "to you" in Russian) written in large, green, stylized letters. The archway is white and framed by a red background. One person, wearing a white tank top and dark pants, is positioned in the foreground, looking towards the camera. Another person, wearing a dark shirt and pants, is partially visible next to them. In the background, a line of people can be seen walking along a railing.

nurlan/839.jpg.description: A stunning sunset over calm water, with the sun reflecting as a bright, elongated shimmer on the surface. The sky is a gradient of orange and yellow, and a shoreline is visible in the distance. Gentle waves ripple towards the viewer, catching the golden light.

nurlan/84.jpg.description: A slightly angled, overhead shot shows a MacBook Pro displaying a Facebook profile. The profile appears to belong to a young woman holding a phone, with a group photo as the cover image. The desktop background is a cluttered arrangement of icons, mostly folders labeled with dates. The laptop is on a wooden surface, with a black object partially visible in the foreground and a ceiling with visible tiles above.

nurlan/840.jpg.description: A photograph shows three people sitting on a beach, wrapped in blankets. The foreground features a young man in a maroon shirt holding a camera, and a younger boy in a navy blue hooded jacket. Behind them stands another person, mostly obscured, wearing a tan hooded jacket. The beach is sandy, and the sea is visible in the background under a hazy sky. The overall mood is calm and contemplative.

nurlan/841.jpg.description: A group selfie featuring several people of different ages, likely a family, posing outdoors in front of a historical site with a large crowd of people in the background. The individuals are dressed in casual clothing, with hats and scarves visible. The person taking the selfie is on the right, wearing a white shirt and a tan cap with earbuds. A woman with a green headscarf is in the center, and several children are also included in the photo, one of whom is sticking out his tongue.

nurlan/842.jpg.description: A group of three people, likely a family, are posing for a photo with a large, decorative frame. The frame is white with green lettering in a Cyrillic script at the top, and it appears to be positioned to frame a view of a city or landscape. The people are standing near the frame, with two of them partially visible within the frame's opening. The background shows a cityscape with buildings and a bright sky. The ground is paved with dark, rectangular tiles.

nurlan/843.jpg.description: A close-up shot shows a man with a wide-brimmed hat looking up at a large snake that is draped around his arm and extending towards the camera. Another man in a white shirt with the word "SINCHA" printed on it is visible in the background, observing the snake. The scene appears to be a demonstration or interaction with a reptile, possibly at a zoo or wildlife park. The snake is dark in color and has a textured scale pattern.

nurlan/844.jpg.description: A person stands near a railing, looking towards the camera, with a vibrant blue sky and lush greenery reflected in a glass surface behind them. The reflection creates a distorted, mirrored effect of the landscape, including trees and what appears to be a road or pathway. The person is wearing a pink shirt, shorts, and sunglasses.

nurlan/845.jpg.description: A close-up, slightly tilted portrait of a young man with short dark hair and glasses. He's wearing a pink t-shirt and appears to be outdoors, with palm trees and a blue sky with clouds visible in the background, reflected in what appears to be a glass surface.

nurlan/846.jpg.description: A group of five people are seated around a wooden table in what appears to be a restaurant or cafe. The setting is decorated with draped pink and teal fabrics, creating a cozy and somewhat enclosed space. The individuals range in age, with a mix of younger and older adults. They are all looking towards the camera. The floor is tiled with a dark geometric pattern. The table is made of wood and has a slightly worn appearance.

nurlan/847.jpg.description: A person stands near a waterfront pathway lined with palm trees, wearing a pink t-shirt and patterned shorts. They are looking towards the camera with sunglasses on, and wearing sandals. The background features a bright blue sky and a glimpse of water.

nurlan/848.jpg.description: A first-person perspective photo shows a man with gray hair and glasses looking towards a beach. The beach is visible in the background, with people and colorful beach chairs. The sky is cloudy and reflected in the wet sand.

nurlan/849.jpg.description: A photo shows an elderly couple sitting on a bench in what appears to be a large, modern airport or transportation hub. They are positioned in front of a large palm tree, with other palm trees visible in the background. The building has a high, arched ceiling and large windows, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. People are walking in the background, suggesting a busy environment. The couple appears relaxed and content.

nurlan/85.jpg.description: A close-up image shows the dorsal side of a human foot, resting on a yellow towel. The foot appears to be slightly elevated, with the toes curled upwards. Veins are visible on the top of the foot, and the skin tone is fair. The background includes a plain off-white wall and a glimpse of a patterned fabric (possibly a sock or blanket) at the bottom right corner.

nurlan/850.jpg.description: A group of three men are seated on a bench in a large, indoor space with a high ceiling and artificial palm trees. The space appears to be a public area, possibly a shopping mall or transportation hub, with visible storefronts and banners in the background. The men are looking forward, seemingly waiting or resting. The artificial palm tree dominates the foreground, with its large fronds extending towards the camera.

nurlan/851.jpg.description: A young boy stands indoors, facing the camera, with a large window behind him showcasing a modern building and outdoor courtyard. The window is framed by curved metal supports and a yellow floor. The boy is wearing a cream-colored long-sleeved shirt with text on it. The building in the background is light-colored with many windows and appears to be a hotel or institutional building. The courtyard has play equipment and shaded seating areas.

nurlan/852.jpg.description: A young boy stands inside a circular structure with a large window, looking towards the camera. The structure appears to be part of a modern building or play area, with curved yellow and green elements framing the window. Through the window, a cityscape is visible with buildings and a cloudy sky. The boy is wearing a cream-colored long-sleeved shirt with text on it.

nurlan/853.jpg.description: A photograph shows a family of three sitting on a wooden bench in a bright, spacious indoor area resembling a large atrium or airport terminal. A young boy wearing a white sweatshirt with the word 'EXCITING' is seated on the left, a woman in a blue patterned dress is in the middle, and an older man in a jacket is on the right. All three are looking towards the camera. Palm trees and greenery are visible throughout the space, along with tiled flooring and a modern architectural design with glass windows and metal supports. The scene appears calm and relaxed.

nurlan/854.jpg.description: Four young men are posing playfully on and around a modern, geometric sculpture in a park at night. The sculpture is constructed from bright green and white rectangular forms. One man is lying with his head near the base of a green pillar, seemingly looking upwards. Another is standing on a white section, leaning slightly forward. A third man stands behind him, and the fourth is positioned at the highest point of the sculpture, wearing a black t-shirt with a graphic. They all appear to be casually dressed, with jeans and t-shirts. The background is dark, suggesting it's nighttime, with some greenery and a lamppost visible.

nurlan/855.jpg.description: A group of six people are seated around a large wooden table in a room with pink walls and a decorative arched window. The table is laden with food and drinks, suggesting a shared meal. The individuals appear to be of varying ages, and are engaged in conversation or enjoying their food. The room has a rustic feel with wooden chairs and a patterned floor.

nurlan/856.jpg.description: A group of people are interacting with a colorful, geometric art installation at night. The installation consists of various angled, brightly colored surfaces, and people are sitting, standing, and pointing at different parts of it. The lighting is dim, highlighting the colors of the installation and the subjects. Some people are looking up, seemingly captivated by something above.

nurlan/857.jpg.description: Three young women pose for a photo in front of brightly colored geometric structures at night. The woman in the middle is seated on a pink structure, wearing a hoodie and black pants, and looking at the camera with a smile. To her left, another woman is making a 'finger guns' gesture, and to her right, a third woman is leaning in and smiling, wearing a denim jacket and a white top. All three are wearing black sneakers.

nurlan/858.jpg.description: A group of young people are navigating a colorful, multi-level obstacle course or interactive installation. The setup consists of platforms in shades of pink, green, and blue. One person in a blue shirt is prominently positioned, seemingly leading or demonstrating the course, while others follow or observe. The background is dark, highlighting the brightly colored structures and the participants. Some are pointing, looking up, or engaged in the activity.

nurlan/859.jpg.description: Two young men are posing playfully in an outdoor setting at night. One man is sitting on a tall orange pillar, while the other is lying down with his feet resting on the pillar where the first man is seated. The setting appears to be a modern park or public space with colorful geometric structures and trees. The man on the pillar is wearing a black t-shirt and dark pants with pink and white sneakers, while the other man is wearing a blue button-down shirt and grey pants. The lighting is dim, highlighting the colorful structures and the subjects.

nurlan/86.jpg.description: A close-up selfie featuring three young adults. The person in the center is a woman with medium-length, wavy blonde hair, wearing a black dress and a silver necklace with a pendant. She has noticeable makeup. To her left is a young man in a black shirt, and to her right is another young man in a white shirt. They are all looking towards the camera. The background appears to be a large screen displaying a cloudy sky.

nurlan/860.jpg.description: Two people are lying on the ground on a street corner. One person is wearing a black cap with the word "SPICY" in white letters and a dark shirt, while the other is wearing a tan jacket and dark pants. Both have their arms outstretched. The scene appears to be at night, with streetlights visible.

nurlan/861.jpg.description: A group of three friends playfully pose around a circular road sign with a left-turn arrow. The photo is taken at night, with artificial lighting illuminating the scene. The friends are dressed in casual clothing, including sweaters and black jackets. The sign is surrounded by black and white striped barriers.

nurlan/862.jpg.description: Two people are lying on the ground in what appears to be a staged or simulated injury scenario. One person is embracing the other, who is lying prone with arms outstretched. The scene takes place on a paved road or parking lot at night. The person on top is wearing a plaid shirt and a black cap with white lettering, while the person underneath is wearing a dark shirt. The image suggests a possible demonstration, performance art, or a mock accident.

nurlan/863.jpg.description: A group of friends are playfully interacting in a street at night. Three individuals are positioned on the ground, appearing to be crawling or playing a game, while a fourth person stands and seems to be directing or observing them. The scene is illuminated by streetlights, and a modern building, possibly a hotel (with 'Hilton' visible), forms the backdrop. The setting appears to be a relatively quiet street or road.

nurlan/864.jpg.description: A group of six friends posing for a photo at night near a road sign. They are sitting and standing around a traffic bollard with a left-turn arrow sign. The group is diverse in age and style, with varying outfits including casual wear like hoodies, t-shirts, and sweatpants. The background is dark with streetlights and a blurred view of buildings or trees. The overall mood is cheerful and relaxed.

nurlan/865.jpg.description: A group of six people, likely a family, posing for a photo indoors. There are three generations represented, with elderly individuals, adults, and a child. They are standing in front of decorative sheer curtains in shades of green, pink, and purple. The floor is tiled with a geometric pattern. The people are dressed in a variety of clothing, including suits, jeans, and a striped dress. One elderly woman is holding a walking stick.

nurlan/866.jpg.description: A blurry photo shows two young people at night. One person is giving a piggyback ride to the other. The person giving the ride is wearing a black shirt and a cap, while the person being carried is wearing a pink shirt and black pants with white shoes. The background includes a building with lit windows and a street lamp.

nurlan/867.jpg.description: A person with long dark hair and glasses is making a 'finger heart' gesture above a white pot with a patterned design. The pot is likely in a store, surrounded by various cookware and price tags. The person is wearing a black t-shirt.

nurlan/868.jpg.description: A young man stands in front of a large window, looking towards an interior courtyard of a building. The courtyard features multiple levels with green and gray tiling, white spherical objects, and a yellow and red track resembling a miniature golf course. The building has a modern architectural style with white structural elements and green accents. The man is wearing a white shirt and a dark vest, and appears to be looking directly at the camera.

nurlan/869.jpg.description: A person with short dark hair is looking out a large window. They are wearing a light-colored long-sleeved shirt with graphic text. The view outside shows buildings and a cloudy sky. The window frame is thick and black, and the interior wall is a light green color.

nurlan/87.jpg.description: A group of people are gathered in a room, seemingly attending a presentation or workshop. A man in a dark shirt and glasses is speaking while facing a seated audience. The room has a modern aesthetic with a large mandala-style artwork on the wall and a balloon decoration. There's a table with food items visible on the right side of the frame. The lighting is bright, with overhead panel lights illuminating the space.

nurlan/870.jpg.description: A low-angle shot shows a young person relaxing in an orange armchair within a modern, multi-story building. The architecture features a striking design with white structural elements and green accents, including plant life and seating areas on multiple levels. A skylight illuminates the space, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. The person is looking towards the camera with a relaxed expression, wearing a white t-shirt and dark pants.

nurlan/871.jpg.description: A blurry photo shows a person lying on the ground in a street, seemingly having been kicked or pushed by another person who is mid-stride and blurred, suggesting motion. The scene is at night, with a building and streetlights in the background. The person on the ground is lying flat with arms outstretched.

nurlan/872.jpg.description: A group of young people are crammed together, taking a selfie from a low angle. They appear to be at a concert or event, with various clothing styles including black shirts, a white shirt with red lettering, and a blue jacket. Some are making playful gestures towards the camera, like holding up peace signs. The background is dark, with glimpses of metal barriers and other concert-goers.

nurlan/873.jpg.description: Two people are lying on the asphalt road in a playful pose, mimicking a human starfish or airplane. They are positioned near a crosswalk and a modern building at night. One person is lying on their back with arms outstretched, while the other is lying on top of them in a similar pose. The scene is illuminated by streetlights.

nurlan/874.jpg.description: A man is casting his vote in what appears to be a polling station. He is wearing a red shirt and a baseball cap, and is in the process of placing a folded ballot into a clear, plastic ballot box adorned with the national emblem of Kazakhstan. The polling station is set up with blue curtains for privacy and has posters on the walls. There are other ballot boxes visible in the foreground.

nurlan/875.jpg.description: A group of young people are taking a selfie on what appears to be a party bus or similar vehicle. The person in the foreground, a young woman with glasses, is holding her hand up with fingers forming a gesture. Several other people are visible behind her, some also making hand gestures or smiling. The bus interior has metal poles and a dark atmosphere, possibly with lighting effects. They all seem to be enjoying themselves.

nurlan/876.jpg.description: A person is lying prone in the middle of a street at night. They are wearing a light-colored shirt and dark pants with red shoes. The background shows a modern building, possibly a hotel (with 'Hilton' visible), a crosswalk, and street signs. The scene appears to be urban and well-lit.

nurlan/877.jpg.description: A close-up, slightly tilted perspective shot shows two people wearing sunglasses and hats, seemingly taking a selfie at a beach. The person in the foreground is wearing a pink shirt and a straw hat with a black chin strap, while the person behind them wears a white cap with a Jumpman logo. The background reveals a sandy beach and turquoise water with people enjoying the sun.

nurlan/878.jpg.description: A wide-angle shot captures two shirtless men standing on a sandy beach under a clear blue sky. The man in the foreground is younger, wearing dark shorts and sandals, while the man behind him is older, with a towel draped around his neck and also wearing shorts and sandals. Several other beachgoers are visible in the background, some wearing hats and carrying water bottles. The beach appears crowded, with people relaxing and enjoying the sunny weather.

nurlan/879.jpg.description: A man is doing a pull-up on a bar installed on a large granite rock formation overlooking a vibrant turquoise sea and lush green forest. He is wearing blue shorts and appears to be enjoying a challenging workout in a scenic outdoor location. The perspective is from directly above, emphasizing the height and precariousness of the exercise.

nurlan/88.jpg.description: A slightly distorted selfie-style photo shows a young person holding the camera, with two other children in the background. One child is lifting the other, who appears to be playfully 'testing' their strength. The setting is outdoors, likely near a large, curved structure (possibly part of a building or attraction) with a metal surface and a Ferris wheel visible in the distance. The scene is bathed in bright sunlight, casting strong shadows on the platform where the children are standing. The platform has metal railings.

nurlan/880.jpg.description: A first-person perspective shot looking down from a rocky cliffside towards turquoise water and a distant coastline. The cliff face dominates the frame, with a warning sign visible on the right side of the image. The sky is a clear, bright blue.

nurlan/881.jpg.description: A man is lying near the edge of a rocky cliff, seemingly posing for a photo with a dramatic perspective. The photo is taken from a low angle, looking down towards a vibrant turquoise sea and a lush green hillside. The man is wearing blue shorts and is partially obscured by the rocky foreground and a wooden railing. The lighting is bright and sunny, highlighting the colors of the water, vegetation, and rock.

nurlan/882.jpg.description: A young man is lying on a rocky surface near a railing, seemingly at a scenic overlook. He is shirtless and wearing swim trunks and sandals. The background shows a beach and lush greenery. The photo is taken from a high angle, looking down at him.

nurlan/883.jpg.description: A vibrant and energetic photograph captures a young man with a wide grin, mid-dance at a party or event. He's wearing a dark gray shirt, a bow tie, and suspenders, with his arms raised in a joyful pose. The background is a blur of lights and other partygoers, suggesting a lively atmosphere. Other people are visible, including a woman in a red dress and others in more formal attire. The image is dynamic and full of energy, showcasing a moment of pure enjoyment.

nurlan/884.jpg.description: A man stands on a rocky outcrop, seemingly near a cliff edge, with a body of water and forested hills visible in the background. He is shirtless and wearing blue shorts. The photo is taken from a low angle, looking up at him, creating a dramatic perspective. A wooden railing is visible to his right.

nurlan/885.jpg.description: A man is stretching on a large, flat, light-colored rock overlooking a beautiful turquoise bay. Several boats are visible in the water, and lush green hills frame the scene. The man is wearing blue shorts and appears to be enjoying a sunny day. His sandals are casually placed near his feet.

nurlan/886.jpg.description: A high-angle, slightly tilted perspective shot shows a person lying on a concrete surface near a cliff overlooking a vibrant turquoise sea. The person is shirtless and wearing dark blue shorts, with one arm extended towards the edge. Several boats are visible in the water below, and the sky is a clear, bright blue. The concrete surface is a light beige color, and the cliff face is rocky and textured.

nurlan/887.jpg.description: A young man is posing for a photo near a rocky coastline with turquoise water. He is shirtless and wearing swim trunks, looking directly at the camera with a slight smile. The photo appears to be taken from a low angle, creating a distorted perspective. Several small boats are visible in the distance on the water. The ground is a light-colored concrete or stone surface.

nurlan/888.jpg.description: A unique perspective shot of a person lying on a flat surface, seemingly pressed against a wall or large rock, with their head facing towards a vibrant blue ocean and rocky coastline. The person is shirtless and has their arms extended, creating a playful illusion. Several boats are visible in the water.

nurlan/889.jpg.description: A photo taken from a low angle shows two people walking along a paved path near a body of water. The man in front is wearing black shorts, sandals, and a white cap, and is shirtless. The woman behind him is wearing a pink shirt, a patterned jacket, a hat with a brim, and sandals. A blue body of water and greenery are visible on one side, while the paved path extends to the right. The sky is a clear, bright blue.

nurlan/89.jpg.description: A young man in a graduation gown and cap stands with a woman, likely his mother, in front of a building decorated for a graduation ceremony. The man is wearing a traditional academic robe, a light blue shirt, and a green sash. The woman is wearing a patterned light-colored shirt and a crossbody bag. Many other graduates and attendees are visible in the background, some also wearing graduation attire. The building has a modern architectural style with large windows and a banner that reads "ВЫПУСКНИК" (meaning "Graduate" in Russian).

nurlan/890.jpg.description: A man in swim trunks stands near a curved gray wall and lush green foliage under a clear blue sky. The photo is taken from a low angle, looking upwards, which makes the man appear small in the frame. A large, rounded rock is visible in the foreground.

nurlan/891.jpg.description: A low-angle shot shows two men standing on a sandy beach with a vibrant turquoise sea and rocky coastline in the background. The man in the foreground is wearing a white cap and black swim trunks, holding glasses in his hands. Behind him is a younger man in blue swim trunks. Both are looking towards the camera. Several boats are visible in the water.

nurlan/892.jpg.description: A high-angle, wide shot shows a person lying on a rocky surface, looking down towards a vibrant blue body of water with several boats visible. The person is shirtless, wearing blue swim trunks, and has their arms outstretched. The rocky surface is a light gray color, contrasting with the deep blue water. The sky is a clear, bright blue. The perspective is unique, almost as if the viewer is looking straight down from above.

nurlan/893.jpg.description: A vibrant, high-angle shot showcasing the contrast between lush green vegetation and pristine white sand. The image is divided diagonally, with a dense cluster of trees and foliage on the left and a wide expanse of textured sand on the right, all under a clear, deep blue sky. The sand appears to be very fine and almost blindingly white, with subtle patterns created by wind or footprints. A few people are visible in the distance near the tree line.

nurlan/894.jpg.description: A man is lying on a rocky outcrop overlooking a beautiful turquoise bay and lush green forest. He is shirtless, wearing blue and black swim trunks and sandals, and appears to be posing for a selfie-style photo taken from a low angle. He's leaning on the rocks with one hand and holding a water bottle with the other. The scene suggests a tropical vacation or adventurous outing.

nurlan/895.jpg.description: A large group of young people posing for a photo on what appears to be an artificial turf field, likely at a university or college campus. The photo is labeled 'dorm' with a heart, suggesting they are residents of a dormitory. They are casually dressed and appear to be enjoying themselves. A volleyball is visible in the foreground.

nurlan/896.jpg.description: A collage of photos capturing various moments, likely from a school or group event in January 2022. The images show students engaged in activities like basketball, running, receiving awards, and posing for group photos. There's also a shot of students studying or working indoors. The overall feel is one of camaraderie and achievement.

nurlan/897.jpg.description: A photo shows two young athletes celebrating, likely after a successful play in a handball or similar sport. The athlete in the foreground is wearing a black jersey with the number 7 and the name 'ALMATY' above it, and 'MIS CB' below. He has his arms raised in a celebratory gesture, with a smaller athlete jumping in front of him, also with arms raised. Both are wearing black shorts and athletic shoes. The background features a blue wall and other athletes in similar uniforms.

nurlan/898.jpg.description: A photo captures a playful moment outdoors, likely a schoolyard or sports field, as the sun sets. Two students are engaged in a dynamic pose: one is carrying another on their back in a somewhat awkward, but fun, manner. Both are dressed in dark clothing with one wearing a light-colored jacket. Other students are visible in the background, some standing and observing. The setting appears to be a cool, possibly late afternoon or early evening, with a golden light from the setting sun.

nurlan/899.jpg.description: A low-light photograph shows a wall-mounted light fixture casting a warm, circular glow onto a dark surface. The light appears to be a modern design with a ring-shaped element around the bulb. The surrounding areas are mostly in shadow, emphasizing the light source.

nurlan/9.jpg.description: A person is lying down, seemingly in a hospital bed, with their head turned towards the camera and arms raised. They are wearing a black t-shirt with a leopard print shawl or jacket over it, and plaid pants. They have a medical bracelet on their wrist and a necklace. A hair clip is visible in their hair. The photo is taken from a high angle, looking down at the person.

nurlan/90.jpg.description: A young man wearing a graduation cap and gown, holding a circular award or plaque. He is looking directly at the camera with a slight smile. The gown is black with green trim, and he's wearing a white shirt underneath. The background appears to be a brightly colored banner or decoration.

nurlan/900.jpg.description: A group of three young men posing for a photo in what appears to be an airport or transportation hub. They are smiling and making playful gestures. The man on the left is wearing a grey jacket and jeans, with a shoulder bag. The middle man is in a teal hoodie and white pants, pointing forward. The man on the right is wearing a black shirt and pants, making a fist. The background shows a modern architectural space with metal beams and a ceiling fan. There are other people visible in the background, including a woman sitting on a bench.

nurlan/901.jpg.description: A woman wearing a straw hat is tending to a garden of vibrant orange poppies. She is looking towards the camera with a gentle expression, and appears to be kneeling or crouching amongst the flowers. A wooden fence is visible in the background under a clear blue sky.

nurlan/902.jpg.description: A group of graduates in black gowns and mortarboards with green trim are seen outdoors on a bright day. Two young men are prominently in the foreground, with one looking slightly off-camera and the other looking directly at the camera with a subtle smile. A woman is visible in the background, holding up a peace sign. The scene suggests a graduation ceremony or celebration.

nurlan/903.jpg.description: An overhead shot shows a man seemingly interacting with miniature figures arranged on a colorful rug. The rug depicts a vibrant, detailed scene with buildings and various elements. Three small figures dressed in school uniforms are positioned on the rug, and the man is leaning down, appearing to engage with them. The setting is a room with white tiled floors and walls, and a glimpse of a green cabinet or furniture is visible in the background. A light source and some cables are also present, suggesting a setup for photography or filming.

nurlan/904.jpg.description: A low-angle, close-up shot features three individuals in graduation attire. The central figure, a young man, looks directly at the camera with a neutral expression, wearing a white shirt and a black graduation cap with a green trim. Two other individuals are partially visible, one above and one below him, also wearing graduation caps. The background is a bright, slightly overexposed sky, suggesting an outdoor setting during daylight. The image captures a celebratory moment, likely immediately following a graduation ceremony.

nurlan/905.jpg.description: Two young men in formal attire pose for a photo in front of a building decorated with green and white streamers. The man on the left is wearing a navy suit with a red shirt and tie, striking a pose with his hands up as if framing the viewer. The man on the right is wearing a white shirt with a green ribbon and dark pants, also posing with his hands up. Behind them, another person in a red uniform is partially visible. The building has a modern architectural style with a curved glass roof and a column.

nurlan/906.jpg.description: A person lies in a field of vibrant orange poppies, wearing a straw hat and patterned clothing. They are looking up towards the camera with one hand gently touching a poppy. The scene is bathed in bright sunlight, highlighting the lush green grass and the vivid color of the flowers.

nurlan/907.jpg.description: A top-down view of a person eating at a table. The person has long, dark hair and is wearing a light beige sweater. They are using a fork to eat food from a white plate. There's a table number '2C' with a small flower arrangement, and a smartphone is visible on the right side of the frame. The table is white and the chairs appear to be red.

nurlan/908.jpg.description: This image shows two people in suits seemingly suspended in mid-air within a brightly colored, surreal installation. The background is a vibrant pink, with geometric shapes like cubes and rectangles scattered around, some checkered. Hanging plants add a touch of nature to the artificial environment. The installation is labeled with the words "Amazing Chemistry" above, suggesting a playful, conceptual art piece. The perspective is from below, looking up at the scene, which enhances the feeling of disorientation and wonder.

nurlan/91.jpg.description: A young man in a graduation gown and cap stands with a woman, presumably his mother, in front of a building with white and green accents. Both are smiling at the camera. The man is holding a small white gift bag. Several other people in graduation attire are visible in the background, along with white tents. The scene appears to be a graduation celebration outdoors on a sunny day.

nurlan/92.jpg.description: A young man in a black graduation gown with a green sash and a woman stand posing for a photo in front of a building decorated for a celebration. The building has banners with text including "ТҮЛЕК 2022" and "NIS". The woman is wearing a patterned blouse and a cardigan, while the man has a serious expression. A bouquet of yellow and white flowers sits on a column between them.

nurlan/93.jpg.description: A selfie featuring a young man and an older woman, likely a mother and son, standing outdoors in front of a building with a festive atmosphere. The woman is on the left, wearing a patterned green shirt and a black head covering. The young man is on the right, wearing a light blue shirt. There are people and decorations visible in the background, suggesting a public event or celebration. The sky is clear and blue.

nurlan/94.jpg.description: A group of three people – two men and a young boy – are posing for a photo outdoors on a sunny day. They are standing in front of a modern architectural structure resembling a bird in flight, likely a landmark in Nur-Sultan (Astana), Kazakhstan. The boy is in the center, wearing a white t-shirt and shorts, with a black shoulder bag. The men flank him, one in a yellow shirt and jeans, the other in a light blue shirt and jeans, both holding water bottles. The background features white columns and a clear blue sky.

nurlan/95.jpg.description: A close-up portrait of a woman wearing sunglasses and a white shirt with a black patterned collar. She is outdoors, seemingly in a city square, with notable landmarks in the background including the Bayterek Tower and modern skyscrapers. The sky is blue with fluffy clouds.

nurlan/96.jpg.description: A paved pathway lined with trees leads towards the Bayterek Tower in Nur-Sultan, Kazakhstan. Two people are walking along the path, appearing to be engaged in conversation. The tower, a prominent landmark, is visible in the distance, framed by the lush greenery of the park. The sky is blue with a few clouds.

nurlan/97.jpg.description: A group photo taken outdoors in front of a modern cityscape, likely in Astana, Kazakhstan, featuring a woman in the foreground with three young people around her. The woman is wearing glasses and a patterned shirt, and appears to be taking a selfie. The young people are of varying ages and are dressed casually. In the background, a distinctive architectural structure resembling a tall, curved tower is visible, along with other buildings and a bright blue sky with fluffy clouds.

nurlan/98.jpg.description: Two young boys stand in front of a kitchen with white cabinets and a dark tiled backsplash. The kitchen features a modern design with built-in appliances and decorative elements. Both boys are wearing jeans and casual tops, looking towards the camera.

nurlan/99.jpg.description: A young boy stands in front of two large lion statues, one appearing more traditional and the other with mechanical elements. He is wearing a light-colored t-shirt, dark shorts, and sneakers, and is holding a water bottle. The statues are positioned on a raised platform surrounded by lush greenery. The background features a modern building with glass windows and architectural details.
